summary.zh: 精选55+个知名网站的DESIGN.md设计系统文档，为AI编码代理提供纯文本规范以生成像素级完美UI。完整定义视觉主题、色彩、排版、组件样式及响应式行为，无需Figma或JSON等复杂工具，显著提升AI驱动前端开发的效率与一致性。
summary.en: A curated collection of 55+ DESIGN.md files from popular websites, capturing complete design systems in plain text. Enables AI coding agents to generate pixel-perfect UIs by defining visual themes, colors, typography, components, and responsive behavior. Eliminates Figma exports or JSON schemas, streamlining AI-powered frontend development with LLM-friendly markdown format.

metadata.name: Shadowbroker
metadata.description: Open-source intelligence for the global theater. Track everything from the corporate/private jets of the wealthy, and spy satellites, to seismic events in one unified interface. Hook an AI agent up to have it parse through data and find previously unseen correlations. The knowledge is available to all but rarely aggregated in the open, until now.

summary.zh: ShadowBroker是实时多域开源情报平台，聚合60+公开数据源包括航班ADS-B、船舶AIS、卫星遥测及地震信息。基于Next.js与MapLibre GL构建交互式地图，支持35+数据层切换与右键地理情报查询。采用自托管架构确保隐私，面向分析师提供全球威胁监控与研究工作。
summary.en: ShadowBroker is a real-time OSINT platform aggregating 60+ public data sources including aircraft ADS-B, maritime AIS, satellite telemetry and seismic events. Built with Next.js and MapLibre GL, it provides 35+ interactive data layers and geospatial analysis tools. Self-hosted deployment ensures privacy for analysts tracking global threats and conducting open-source intelligence research.

metadata.name: QwenPaw
metadata.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.

summary.zh: QwenPaw是自主可控的个人AI助手，支持本地或云端部署确保数据隐私。提供日程管理、PDF/Office文档处理、新闻摘要等内置技能，支持自定义扩展。具备多智能体协作能力，可创建独立代理处理不同任务。跨平台连接多种聊天应用，技能决定功能边界，无供应商锁定风险。
summary.en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant under your control, deployable locally or in the cloud to ensure data privacy. It features built-in skills including scheduling, PDF/Office document processing, and news digests, with support for custom extensions. Enables multi-agent collaboration by creating independent agents for different tasks. Connects across multiple chat platforms with extensible capabilities and no vendor lock-in.

metadata.name: hotmail_register
metadata.description: hotmail register

summary.zh: 这是一个基于Python的Outlook/Hotmail自动化注册工具，采用ruyiPage库驱动Firefox浏览器实现全流程自动化。支持批量注册、代理IP、验证码服务集成及无头模式，可生成虚假注册信息并保存账号凭证。适用于测试研究等非商业场景，采用PolyForm非商用许可证。
summary.en: This Python automation tool leverages ruyiPage library to control Firefox browser for fully automated Outlook/Hotmail account registration. Key features include bulk account creation with configurable delays, proxy server support for IP rotation, integration with 2captcha for automated captcha solving, headless mode operation, and fake identity generation using Faker library. Designed specifically for testing and research purposes under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license, it automatically saves credentials to text files with comprehensive logging and screenshot capture capabilities.

metadata.name: architecture-diagram-generator
metadata.description: Generate beautiful dark-themed system architecture diagrams as standalone HTML/SVG files. Works as a Claude AI skill.

summary.zh: 通过Claude AI技能，将自然语言描述自动转换为专业深色主题架构图。输出独立HTML文件，无需设计工具，支持实时迭代修改。适用于系统设计评审、技术文档可视化，显著提升架构沟通效率与团队协作体验。
summary.en: The Architecture Diagram Generator is a Claude AI skill that automatically converts natural language descriptions into professional, dark-themed system architecture diagrams. It outputs self-contained HTML files that can be opened in any browser without specialized software. Users can easily iterate on designs through conversational prompts, adding components or adjusting layouts instantly. This tool is ideal for system design reviews, technical documentation, and architecture presentations, dramatically improving communication efficiency and team collaboration while eliminating the need for manual diagramming tools and design expertise.

metadata.name: PLFM_RADAR
metadata.description: Open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz PLFM phased array RADAR system

summary.zh: AERIS-10是一款开源低成本10.5GHz相控阵雷达系统，提供3km和20km两种探测距离版本。系统采用脉冲线性调频(PLFM)技术，支持±45°电子波束扫描，集成FPGA实现脉冲压缩、多普勒处理、MTI和CFAR等先进信号处理。模块化设计包含电源管理、频率合成和射频主板，搭载Python GUI地图界面和GPS/IMU实时校正。面向无人机开发、科研教育和雷达爱好者，提供完整的硬件原理图、PCB布局和开源软件，旨在降低相控阵雷达技术门槛。
summary.en: AERIS-10 is an open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz phased array radar system with 3km and 20km range variants. It features Pulse Linear Frequency Modulation (PLFM) and ±45° electronic beam steering. The FPGA handles advanced signal processing including pulse compression, Doppler FFT, MTI, and CFAR. Its modular architecture comprises power management, frequency synthesis, and RF main boards, complemented by a Python GUI with map integration and GPS/IMU support. Designed for drone developers, researchers, and radar enthusiasts, it provides complete schematics and software to democratize phased array radar technology.

metadata.name: agency-agents
metadata.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供一套生产就绪的AI代理团队，涵盖前端、后端、移动开发等专业领域。每个代理具备独特人格、专业工作流和可量化交付物，支持Claude Code、GitHub Copilot等主流工具。通过标准化提示工程与自动化脚本，将通用AI助手转化为具备领域专长的虚拟员工，实现软件开发全流程的智能化升级。
summary.en: This repository delivers a production-ready AI agent team covering frontend, backend, mobile development, and more. Each agent features unique personality, specialized workflows, and measurable deliverables, compatible with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and other mainstream tools. By standardizing prompt engineering with automation scripts, it transforms generic AI assistants into domain-specialized virtual employees, enabling intelligent upgrades across the entire software development lifecycle.

metadata.name: Freebuff2API
metadata.description: 🚀 OpenAI-compatible Freebuff proxy with dynamic free-agent tracking, token rotation, and ready-to-use Docker deployment.

summary.zh: Freebuff2API 是一个 OpenAI 兼容代理服务器，将 Freebuff 免费 AI 模型转换为标准 OpenAI API 格式。支持多账号 token 自动轮换提升调用额度，动态模拟官方 SDK 指纹规避检测，并提供 Docker 快速部署。适用于开发者在不更换现有 OpenAI SDK 代码的前提下，零成本调用 Freebuff 的 AI 模型服务。
summary.en: Freebuff2API is an OpenAI-compatible proxy server that transforms Freebuff's free AI models into standard OpenAI API endpoints. It features automatic multi-token rotation for higher throughput, dynamic client fingerprinting to mimic official SDK behavior, and Docker deployment. Enables developers to use Freebuff's AI services with any OpenAI-compatible client without code changes.

metadata.name: auto-subs
metadata.description: On-device subtitle generation that connects directly to DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, and After Effects.

summary.zh: AutoSubs 是一款基于 Tauri 框架的跨平台 AI 字幕生成工具，本地运行 Whisper 等模型实现高精度语音转录。支持说话人分离、多语言翻译，可导出 SRT 或直接导入 DaVinci Resolve 进行高级样式定制。无需云端订阅，保障数据隐私，为视频创作者提供高效、可定制的自动化字幕解决方案。
summary.en: AutoSubs is a cross-platform desktop application that generates AI-powered subtitles locally on user devices without cloud dependencies. Built on Tauri framework with React frontend and Rust backend, it leverages state-of-the-art models including Whisper, Parakeet and Pyannote for accurate transcription, speaker diarization and translation. The tool offers one-click export to SRT or direct integration with DaVinci Resolve, featuring per-speaker styling and real-time editing capabilities. Designed for video creators and post-production professionals, it delivers privacy-preserving, efficient subtitle workflows with full customization options.

metadata.name: WebAI2API
metadata.description: WebAI2API: 基于 Camoufox 的网页 AI 转 API 工具，支持 LMArena/Gemini等，多窗口并发与账号隔离。 | Web AI to OpenAI API via Camoufox. Supports LMArena/Gemini and more, multi-window concurrency & account isolation.

summary.zh: WebAI2API是基于Camoufox的网页AI服务转API工具，支持LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT等20+平台。通过拟人化操作模拟规避检测，提供OpenAI格式接口，支持多窗口并发与账号级浏览器隔离，内置任务队列和故障转移机制，配备可视化管理界面，实现高效稳定的AI服务调用。
summary.en: WebAI2API converts web-based AI services (LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT etc.) into OpenAI-compatible APIs using Camoufox. It simulates human-like interactions to bypass detection, supports multi-window concurrency with account isolation, and includes task queuing, failover mechanisms, plus a web management interface for stable AI service integration.

metadata.name: manifest
metadata.description: Connect Your Agents And Harnesses With Any Provider 🦚

summary.zh: Manifest 是为个人AI代理设计的智能模型路由中间件，可节省高达70%的LLM调用成本。它通过23维评分算法（<2ms）自动评估请求复杂度，将简单任务路由至廉价模型，复杂问题导向高性能模型。支持自动故障转移、预算管控和可视化监控，适用于OpenClaw、Hermes等AI代理。提供Docker自托管和云服务两种部署方式，无需修改现有代码即可集成。
summary.en: Manifest is a smart model router for personal AI agents that cuts LLM costs by up to 70%. It sits between agents and providers, using a 23-dimension scoring algorithm (under 2ms) to route requests to the cheapest capable model tier—simple, standard, complex, or reasoning. Key features include automatic fallbacks, budget controls, and a monitoring dashboard. Designed for agents like OpenClaw and Hermes, it supports both cloud and Docker self-hosted deployment without code changes.

metadata.name: thunderbolt
metadata.description: AI You Control: Choose your models. Own your data. Eliminate vendor lock-in.

summary.zh: Thunderbolt 是 Mozilla 开源的跨平台 AI 客户端，主打'AI You Control'理念。支持本地部署，兼容 Ollama、llama.cpp 等本地推理引擎及 OpenAI 兼容 API，彻底摆脱供应商锁定。提供桌面、移动端全覆盖，面向企业客户，支持私有化部署，强调数据主权与安全可控，目前处于安全审计阶段，即将企业就绪。
summary.en: Thunderbolt is Mozilla's open-source, cross-platform AI client championing 'AI You Control' with full vendor lock-in elimination. It supports local deployment, integrates with Ollama, llama.cpp and OpenAI-compatible APIs, ensuring data ownership. Available across desktop and mobile platforms, it targets enterprise on-premise deployment with enhanced security and privacy, currently undergoing security audit for production readiness.

metadata.name: huashu-design
metadata.description: Huashu Design · HTML-native design skill for Claude Code · Claude Code 里 HTML 原生的设计 skill · 高保真原型 / 幻灯片 / 动画 + 20 设计哲学 + 5 维评审 + MP4 导出 · Agent-agnostic

summary.zh: 华数设计是一款HTML原生的AI设计技能，可将文本描述直接转化为可交付的生产级设计稿。支持Claude Code等主流AI编程助手，3-30分钟内生成可点击的App原型、演讲幻灯片、60秒动画及信息图。核心亮点包括：20种内置设计哲学与5维评审体系确保专业品质；Motion Design引擎支持时间轴动画与MP4/GIF导出；HTML幻灯片可转为可编辑PPTX；Tweaks面板实现参数化实时调整。无需Figma插件，纯文本交互，输出印刷级排版与跨平台HTML文件。
summary.en: Huashu Design is an HTML-native AI design skill that transforms text prompts into production-ready deliverables within 3-30 minutes. Compatible with Claude Code and other AI agents, it generates clickable App prototypes, presentation slides, motion graphics, and infographics. Key features include: 20 built-in design philosophies with 5-dimension expert review system; Motion Design engine supporting timeline animation and MP4/GIF export; HTML slides convertible to editable PPTX; Tweaks panel for parametric adjustments. No Figma plugins needed—pure text interface delivers print-quality layouts and cross-platform HTML output.

metadata.name: daily-arXiv-ai-enhanced
metadata.description: Automatically crawl arXiv papers daily and summarize them using AI. Illustrating them using GitHub Pages.

summary.zh: 该工具通过 GitHub Actions 每日自动爬取 arXiv 论文，并利用 DeepSeek AI 生成中文总结，完全无需服务器。提供个性化高亮、跨设备访问及 SKILL 可插拔过滤系统，帮助研究者零成本追踪 cs.CV、cs.AI 等领域最新进展，日均成本仅 0.2 元，支持偏好导出与一键部署。
summary.en: This tool automatically crawls arXiv papers daily via GitHub Actions and generates Chinese summaries using DeepSeek AI, requiring zero server infrastructure. It offers personalized highlighting, cross-device compatibility, and a plug-and-play SKILL system for custom filtering, enabling researchers to track the latest advancements in cs.CV, cs.AI and other fields at near-zero cost (~0.2 CNY/day). Features include local preference storage, flexible date filtering, and seamless preference export for reproducible setups.

metadata.name: terminal
metadata.description: Terminal UI to get stuff done in the browser

summary.zh: Browser Use Terminal 是一个基于 Rust 的终端 UI 工具，用于让 LLM 代理自动化控制浏览器完成真实任务。它通过直接 CDP 连接操作真实 Chrome 会话，支持无头模式和云端执行，提供可交互的终端界面来观察、控制和恢复任务。核心优势在于 2倍成本效益和速度提升，适用于需要认证状态的企业 Web 应用自动化。
summary.en: Browser Use Terminal is a Rust-based TUI that enables LLM agents to automate browser tasks via direct CDP control. It leverages real Chrome sessions with existing login states, supports headless and cloud execution, and offers an interactive interface for task monitoring and intervention. The custom LLM harness achieves 2x cost reduction and performance gains, perfect for complex authenticated web workflows.

metadata.name: remove-ai-watermarks
metadata.description: AI watermark remover. CLI and Python library to strip visible and invisible AI watermarks (Gemini / Nano Banana sparkle, SynthID) and provenance metadata (C2PA, EXIF, IPTC) from images.

summary.zh: 这个仓库提供CLI和库，用于移除AI生成图像的可见和不可见水印。支持Gemini、DALL-E、Stable Diffusion等主流模型，采用反向alpha混合算法快速移除Gemini的sparkle logo，通过扩散模型再生消除SynthID等不可见水印，并剥离C2PA、EXIF等元数据。具备智能人脸保护和批量处理能力，可绕过社交媒体AI检测。
summary.en: This repository offers a comprehensive CLI and library solution for removing both visible and invisible AI watermarks from images generated by major models such as Google Gemini, OpenAI DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, and Midjourney. It employs a novel reverse alpha blending algorithm to deterministically remove the Gemini/Nano Banana sparkle logo in under 0.05 seconds without GPU requirements, using a three-stage NCC detector for dynamic positioning. For invisible watermarks including SynthID, StableSignature, and TreeRing, it utilizes diffusion-based regeneration at native SDXL resolution (~1024px) with controlled noise addition and denoising. The tool comprehensively strips AI metadata (C2PA manifests, EXIF, XMP, PNG text chunks), removes "Made with AI" labels that trigger social media flags, and features Smart Face Protection to prevent AI distortion. Additional capabilities include Analog Humanizer adding film grain to bypass AI classifiers and efficient batch processing for directories.

metadata.name: pdf-inspector
metadata.description: Fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction. Intelligently detects scanned vs text-based PDFs to enable smart routing decisions.

summary.zh: Firecrawl出品的高性能Rust库，智能识别PDF类型（文本/扫描/混合），自动跳过54%无需OCR的文档。200ms内完成文本提取、多列布局识别、表格检测，输出结构化Markdown。纯Rust实现，比OCR方案快数个量级，适合大规模PDF处理场景。
summary.en: A high-performance Rust library by Firecrawl that intelligently classifies PDFs (text-based/scanned/mixed) to bypass OCR for ~54% of documents. Processes text extraction, multi-column layouts, and table detection in under 200ms, outputting structured Markdown. Pure Rust implementation delivers orders of magnitude faster performance than OCR-based solutions, ideal for large-scale PDF processing.

metadata.name: xin-scan-domain-eu-org
metadata.description: 批量查询 eu.org 域名是否被注册，在茫茫域名中，寻找自己心仪的那一枚。

summary.zh: ScanDomainEuorg 是一款专注于 eu.org 域名批量查询的自动化工具。通过高效扫描技术，快速检测海量域名注册状态，已注册域名显示关联用户名，未注册显示 None。适用于域名投资者、个人开发者及企业品牌保护，帮助用户从海量域名中精准定位可注册的心仪域名，提升筛选效率。
summary.en: ScanDomainEuorg is a specialized automation tool designed for batch querying eu.org domain registration status. Leveraging efficient scanning technology, it rapidly checks massive domain lists, clearly displaying usernames for registered domains and None for unregistered ones. This tool is essential for domain investors, individual developers, and enterprises conducting brand protection, enabling users to precisely identify desirable available domains from vast candidates and dramatically improving domain research efficiency while saving significant time and effort.

metadata.name: comview
metadata.description: the best diff viewer ever made

summary.zh: comview 是一款专为终端设计的现代化 diff 查看器，可美化渲染 unified diff 输出。深度集成 git 与 GitHub CLI，支持实时 watch 模式自动刷新。提供完整的 Vim 风格快捷键、注释系统、主题切换和文本对象操作，让代码审查无需离开终端即可获得类 GUI 的流畅体验，显著提升开发效率。
summary.en: comview is a sophisticated terminal diff viewer that elegantly renders unified diffs with syntax highlighting and side-by-side view options. It deeply integrates with git and GitHub CLI, featuring a real-time watch mode for automatic updates. The tool provides complete Vim-style navigation, persistent comment storage in JSON format, customizable themes, and intuitive text object operations. Specifically designed for developers who live in the terminal, it eliminates the need for web-based tools by delivering a powerful, keyboard-driven code review experience that significantly enhances productivity and workflow efficiency.

metadata.name: voicebox
metadata.description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.

summary.zh: Voicebox 是一款开源本地AI语音工作室，提供语音克隆、多语言TTS和全局听写功能。支持7大引擎、23种语言，零样本克隆声音，具备后处理与表达性控制。完全离线运行保障隐私，集成故事编辑器与AI代理语音交互，是 ElevenLabs 与 WisprFlow 的开源替代方案。
summary.en: Voicebox is an open-source, local-first AI voice studio that enables voice cloning from seconds of audio and speech generation in 23 languages across 7 TTS engines. It provides zero-shot voice cloning, expressive speech with paralinguistic tags, post-processing effects, and unlimited-length content creation. Key features include global dictation hotkeys, multi-track timeline editing for podcasts, and voice-enabled AI agent interaction via local LLM integration. Running entirely offline ensures complete privacy, making it a comprehensive free alternative to ElevenLabs and WisprFlow.

metadata.name: 12-factor-agents
metadata.description: What are the principles we can use to build LLM-powered software that is actually good enough to put in the hands of production customers?

summary.zh: 12-Factor Agents 提出构建生产级LLM应用的12项核心原则，受经典12要素应用启发。针对当前AI智能体框架在生产环境中的不足，强调将软件工程最佳实践应用于LLM开发，而非简单提示词+工具循环。核心亮点包括上下文工程自主权、小型专注智能体设计，为开发可靠、可维护的面向客户AI应用提供系统性指导。
summary.en: 12-Factor Agents introduces 12 core principles for building production-ready LLM applications, inspired by the classic 12-factor app methodology. Addressing gaps in existing AI agent frameworks, it emphasizes applying software engineering best practices to LLM development rather than simplistic prompt-tool loops. Key highlights include owning your context window and designing small, focused agents. This guide provides systematic guidance for developing reliable, maintainable customer-facing AI applications that go beyond experimental prototypes to deliver real production value.

metadata.name: newsflow-oss
metadata.description: An AI-assisted newsroom workflow system for event tracking, evidence organization, approval chains, correction handling, and post-publication monitoring.

summary.zh: NewsFlow 是一款 AI 辅助的新闻编辑室工作流系统，专注于新闻生产中高成本、高责任的中间流程。系统通过 AI 智能体实现线索归并、证据结构化、风险审查、签发审批和发布后监测，建立完整的人机协同审核机制。采用 FastAPI+React 技术栈，支持自托管和二次开发，为新闻机构提供可审计、可追溯的数字化协作平台。
summary.en: NewsFlow is an AI-assisted newsroom workflow system focusing on the high-cost, high-responsibility intermediate processes of news production. It employs AI agents to handle lead clustering, evidence structuring, risk assessment, approval chains, and post-publication monitoring, establishing a comprehensive human-in-the-loop review mechanism. Built with FastAPI+React stack, it supports self-hosting and secondary development, providing news organizations with an auditable, traceable digital collaboration platform for editorial governance and fact-checking workflows.

metadata.name: ziwei-doushu
metadata.description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海夏《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据

summary.zh: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎基于倪海夏《天纪》体系，提供完整排盘算法、四化系统、1100+格局知识库及古籍原文。核心亮点是51.8万条命盘样本数据（5.5GB），可用于AI模型微调和RAG检索。技术栈采用TypeScript与Next.js 14，支持移动端适配，助力传统文化数字化与命理研究。
summary.en: This open-source Ziwei Dou Shu astrology engine implements Ni Haixia's "Tian Ji" system, featuring complete charting algorithms, four transformations, 1100+ pattern knowledge base, and classical texts. It provides 518,000 chart samples (5.5GB) for AI model fine-tuning and RAG retrieval. Built with TypeScript and Next.js 14, it enables traditional metaphysics research, AI training data generation, and digital divination applications with modern web technologies, including mobile adaptation and theme switching.

metadata.name: maptoposter-online
metadata.description: ✨❤️‍🔥Turn the cities you love into stunning designs

summary.zh: MapPoster Online 是一款基于浏览器的地图艺术生成工具，无需安装即可将全球城市地图转化为精美海报。采用 React 19 与 TypeScript 构建前端界面，Rust WASM 处理地图渲染，Bun 作为高性能运行时。支持亚洲、欧洲、美洲等数十个热门城市，提供即时预览与高清导出，是旅行纪念与城市美学创作的理想选择。
summary.en: MapPoster Online is a browser-based map art generator that transforms city maps into stunning posters without installation. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, it leverages Rust WASM for map rendering and Bun as the high-performance runtime. Supporting dozens of cities across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, it offers instant preview and HD export, ideal for travel memorabilia and urban aesthetic creation.

metadata.name: awesome-design-skills
metadata.description: List of 67 awesome DESIGN.md and SKILL.md design skill files for agentic tools like Claude Design, Google Stitch, Codex, Cursor, and other AI tools

summary.zh: 该仓库为Claude Code、Cursor等AI编程助手提供67个结构化设计系统技能文件。每个技能包含SKILL.md（AI可读的组件规范、可访问性约束、质量标准）和DESIGN.md（人类可读的设计意图）。通过TypeUI CLI一键集成，确保AI生成UI符合品牌规范、设计一致性与WCAG 2.2 AA标准，实现AI辅助开发中设计质量与效率的质的飞跃。
summary.en: A curated registry of 67 design system skill files specifically engineered for AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Each skill delivers structured instructions via SKILL.md (machine-readable component rules, accessibility constraints, quality gates) and DESIGN.md (human-readable rationale and maintenance notes). The TypeUI CLI enables one-command integration directly into projects, ensuring AI-generated UIs automatically adhere to brand guidelines, design consistency, and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance. This fundamentally transforms AI-assisted development by embedding design system intelligence into agent workflows, enabling rapid prototyping at scale while maintaining human oversight and quality control.

metadata.name: MediCareAI-Agent
metadata.description: Multi-Agent Autonomous Medical Collaboration System

summary.zh: MediCareAI-Agent 是一个多Agent自主医疗协作系统，采用患者驱动+AI辅助+医生验证模式。系统通过多路径RAG和外部知识分析实现智能诊断与个性化治疗规划，支持主动康复监测和异常告警。技术栈基于Python 3.12+FastAPI异步后端与React 19前端，兼容多LLM提供商，集成pgvector向量数据库，提供完整的医疗级生产部署方案。
summary.en: MediCareAI-Agent is a multi-agent autonomous medical collaboration system that reimagines healthcare through patient-driven, AI-assisted, and doctor-validated workflows. It enables intelligent diagnosis via multi-path RAG, personalized treatment planning, proactive rehabilitation monitoring, and seamless doctor collaboration. Built on Python 3.12+FastAPI async backend and React 19 frontend, it supports multiple LLM providers, integrates pgvector for medical knowledge retrieval, and delivers production-ready deployment with Docker.

metadata.name: humanize-text
metadata.description: Free open-source AI text humanizer to convert AI-generated content into undetectable, human-like writing. Bypass Turnitin, GPTZero, and all major AI detectors. No sign-up required. Try our unlimited free online tool

summary.zh: 开源AI文本人性化工具，采用DeepSeek大模型两次创造性重写结合Google与Niutrans多引擎翻译链，通过中文→日语→芬兰语→英语的远距离语言跳转，有效绕过Turnitin、GPTZero等主流AI检测器。5步标准管道保留原始写作风格，实现100%关键信息留存，专为学术写作与内容创作场景设计。
summary.en: Open-source AI text humanization toolkit that defeats Turnitin, GPTZero and all major AI detectors via a production-grade 5-step Standard Pipeline. Leverages DeepSeek LLM's creative rewriting at temperature 1.3 combined with multi-engine translation hops (Google Translate + Niutrans) across linguistically distant languages (Chinese→Japanese→Finnish→English). Preserves original writing style while achieving 100% key information retention, optimized for academic and content creation workflows.

metadata.name: Hydro0x01
metadata.description: Secure, production-grade IoT hydroponic automation system with ESP32, MQTT telemetry, and real-time dashboard

summary.zh: 这是一个生产级开源物联网水培自动化系统，基于ESP32硬件和MQTT协议实现pH、EC、温湿度等环境参数实时监测与智能控制。系统采用React+Node.js构建边缘优先的实时仪表板，通过InfluxDB存储时序数据，支持TLS加密通信和RSA签名OTA更新，填补了业余DIY与工业级自动化之间的空白。
summary.en: HydroponicOne is a production-grade open-source IoT automation system for hydroponic farming, built on ESP32 hardware and MQTT telemetry protocol. It enables real-time monitoring and automated control of critical parameters including pH, EC, water level, temperature, and humidity through smart relays for dosing pumps, lights, and ventilation. The system features an edge-first React dashboard with WebSocket communication, enterprise-grade security with TLS encryption and RSA-2048 signed OTA updates, and dual-database architecture (PostgreSQL for config, InfluxDB for time-series data). It bridges the gap between hobbyist DIY setups and expensive industrial automation solutions.

metadata.name: conflux
metadata.description: Connector for decentralised post-quantum secure network - VeilNet

summary.zh: VeilNet Conflux 是连接去中心化抗量子安全网络的节点软件，采用改进 WebRTC 栈实现点对点通信。核心特性包括基于污点（taint）的访问控制机制，节点需共享污点才能互联；支持 Terra 免费无区域 Realm 和 Conduit 互联网共享模式。通过优化 Exp3 路由算法和自动连接配对，提供低延迟、高吞吐的安全网络连接，适用于构建抗量子威胁的分布式通信基础设施。
summary.en: VeilNet Conflux is a node connector for decentralized post-quantum secure networks, utilizing a modified WebRTC stack for P2P communication. Key features include taint-based access control requiring shared taints for node connectivity, free regionless Terra Realm, and Conduit mode for internet sharing. Optimized with the Exp3 routing algorithm and automatic connection pairing, it delivers low-latency, high-throughput secure networking, ideal for building quantum-resistant distributed communication infrastructure.

metadata.name: openpencil
metadata.description: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool and the first to feature concurrent Agent Teams. Design-as-Code. Turn prompts into UI directly on the live canvas. A modern alternative to Pencil.

summary.zh: 全球首个开源AI原生矢量设计工具，首创并发Agent Teams协同架构，支持多模型智能调度与MCP服务。通过自然语言提示实时流式生成UI，提供Design-as-Code的JSON格式，实现跨平台AI驱动的设计到代码全流程。
summary.en: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent Agent Teams for parallel UI generation. Transforms natural language prompts into live canvas designs with streaming animation, offering Design-as-Code JSON format and MCP server integration for cross-platform AI-driven design-to-code workflows.

metadata.name: image-blaster
metadata.description: An image-to-world skillset for Claude.

summary.zh: image-blaster 是一款基于 Claude AI 的图像转3D世界工具，5分钟内从单张图片生成可探索的3D环境、动态物体模型和音效。集成 World Labs Marble、Hunyuan 3D 和 FAL 等模型，支持 Unity/Unreal/Blender 等主流平台，为游戏开发、影视场景和建筑可视化提供自动化3D内容创作能力。
summary.en: image-blaster is a revolutionary Claude AI-powered image-to-world skillset that transforms any single image into a fully realized 3D environment in under 5 minutes. The system intelligently orchestrates World Labs Marble for explorable Gaussian splat environments, Hunyuan 3D via FAL for textured mesh generation, and ElevenLabs for immersive sound effects. Designed for seamless integration with Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, and Three.js, it dramatically accelerates workflows in game development, film location scouting, architectural visualization, and robotics simulation.

metadata.name: InsForge
metadata.description: The all-in-one, open-source backend platform for agentic coding. InsForge gives your coding agent database, auth, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway to ship full-stack apps end-to-end.

summary.zh: InsForge 是专为 AI 编程代理打造的**开源一体化后端平台**，提供数据库、认证、存储、计算、托管及 AI 网关等全栈能力。通过 **MCP Server** 和 **CLI+Skills** 双模式，让 AI 代理能像资深后端工程师一样操作资源，实现应用开发、部署、调试的端到端自动化，极大提升 AI 编程效率与质量。
summary.en: InsForge is an **open-source, all-in-one backend platform** purpose-built for agentic coding. It equips AI coding agents with comprehensive capabilities including database, authentication, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway. Through dual interfaces of **MCP Server** (self-hosted/cloud) and **CLI+Skills** (cloud-only), agents can operate backend resources like professional engineers, enabling **end-to-end automation** of full-stack application development, deployment, and debugging, dramatically improving AI coding efficiency and quality.

metadata.name: motion-core
metadata.description: Curated Motion Core Svelte components

summary.zh: Motion Core 是一个专为 Svelte 5 设计的高级动画组件库，采用“复制-粘贴”架构而非传统依赖包。它通过 GSAP 和 OGL 驱动复杂的 WebGL 与时间轴动画，提供磁吸按钮、3D无限画廊等精美组件，确保 60fps 流畅体验。其 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具支持直接将组件代码添加到项目，实现零黑盒集成，同时充分利用 Svelte 5 Runes 的响应式能力。
summary.en: Motion Core is a curated collection of production-ready motion components for Svelte 5, emphasizing aesthetics and performance. It delivers complex WebGL and timeline animations through simple components, powered by GSAP and OGL for 60fps smoothness. Following a copy-paste architecture via a Rust-based CLI, it enables direct codebase integration without heavy dependencies, leveraging Svelte 5's Runes for modern reactivity.

metadata.name: HelloGML
metadata.description: 智谱清言网页版的 Cloudflare Worker 2API层，提供 OpenAI / Claude / Gemini 三种协议兼容接口，支持流式对话、Tools调用、AI 绘图、视频生成与多账号 Token 轮询。

summary.zh: 这是一个将智谱清言私有API转换为标准LLM接口的Cloudflare Worker服务。核心价值在于提供OpenAI、Claude、Gemini三协议兼容，支持流式对话、Tools调用、AI绘图与视频生成。通过动态Token轮询和自动补号机制，实现多账号资源池化与零维护，让任意兼容客户端无缝调用GLM系列模型能力。
summary.en: This Cloudflare Worker service converts ChatGLM's private streaming API into standardized LLM service interfaces, delivering seamless OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini protocol compatibility. Key features include streaming responses with reasoning content, dynamic token management with round-robin scheduling, automated token replenishment, and support for AI drawing, video generation, and function calling. The architecture separates authentication from resource tokens, enabling unified management of multiple accounts while providing zero-maintenance operation for any compatible client applications.

metadata.name: learning-beyond-gradients
metadata.description: Heuristic Learning Blog Post

summary.zh: 本仓库包含《Learning Beyond Gradients》博客文章及可复现实验代码。研究探索强化学习中超越梯度的启发式学习方法，在Atari、MuJoCo、VizDoom等多环境验证。提供完整Python实现、EnvPool集成、策略脚本及可视化结果，支持AI智能体训练与学术研究。
summary.en: This repository hosts the 'Learning Beyond Gradients' blog post and all associated reproducible artifacts. The research investigates heuristic learning approaches that transcend traditional gradient-based methods in reinforcement learning, with comprehensive experiments conducted across Atari, MuJoCo, and VizDoom benchmark environments. It delivers production-ready Python implementations leveraging EnvPool for high-performance simulation, complete policy scripts, sample-efficiency visualizations, checkpoint videos, and detailed reproduction commands. The project serves as a valuable resource for AI agent development, reinforcement learning research, and exploring novel heuristic optimization techniques.

metadata.name: ROMA
metadata.description: Recursive-Open-Meta-Agent v0.1 (Beta). A meta-agent framework to build high-performance multi-agent systems.

summary.zh: ROMA是一个递归开放元代理框架，专注于构建高性能分层多智能体系统。该框架通过元代理架构实现智能体的递归组合与层次化管理，支持复杂任务的自动分解与协同执行。核心价值在于简化多智能体系统的构建流程，提供可扩展的递归设计模式，适用于需要动态编排和高效协作的AI应用场景。技术亮点包括分层代理治理、递归任务分解和开放扩展机制，为构建下一代智能系统提供基础设施。
summary.en: ROMA is a Recursive Open Meta-Agent framework designed for building high-performance hierarchical multi-agent systems. It enables recursive composition and hierarchical management of agents through meta-agent architecture, supporting automatic decomposition and collaborative execution of complex tasks. The framework simplifies multi-agent system development with extensible recursive design patterns, ideal for AI applications requiring dynamic orchestration and efficient coordination. Key technical features include hierarchical agent governance, recursive task decomposition, and open extensibility mechanisms, providing robust infrastructure for building next-generation intelligent agent ecosystems with high scalability.

metadata.name: how-to-train-your-gpt
metadata.description: Build a modern LLM from scratch. Every line commented. Explained like we are five.

summary.zh: 这是一个从零构建现代大语言模型的教学项目，采用LLaMA 3架构风格，包含12章7500+行完全注释的代码。核心亮点是"像教五岁小孩一样解释复杂概念"，通过儿童级类比和逐行注释深入讲解RoPE位置编码、注意力机制、RMSNorm、SwiGLU等核心技术。提供18个独立主题解释器和完整句子前向传播演练，仅需Python基础即可理解LLM底层原理，适合想真正掌握Transformer架构的开发者。
summary.en: An interactive textbook for building a modern LLM from scratch using LLaMA 3-style architecture. Features 12 chapters with 7,500+ fully commented lines, 18 standalone topic explainers, and child-friendly analogies for complex concepts like RoPE, attention, and SwiGLU. Requires only basic Python knowledge, no ML prerequisites. Includes narrative walkthroughs tracing sentences through the entire model, making it ideal for engineers who want deep understanding of Transformer internals rather than just API usage.

metadata.name: Open-Generative-AI
metadata.description: Unrestricted Open-source alternative to AI video platforms — Free AI image & video generation studio with 200+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo). No content filters. Self-hosted, MIT licensed.

summary.zh: 开源AI媒体生成工作室，集成200+先进模型（Flux、Sora、Kling等），提供无过滤的图像视频创作环境。支持自托管与跨平台桌面应用，通过AI编码代理实现提示→生成→编辑→合成的全流程自动化，是商业AI平台的开源替代方案。
summary.en: Open-source AI media generation studio integrating 200+ state-of-the-art models (Flux, Sora, Kling) for unfiltered image/video creation. Features self-hosting, cross-platform desktop apps, and AI agent automation for end-to-end media pipeline orchestration. MIT-licensed alternative to commercial platforms.

metadata.name: get-shit-done
metadata.description: A light-weight and powerful meta-prompting, context engineering and spec-driven development system for Claude Code by TÂCHES.

summary.zh: 针对Claude Code的轻量级元提示与上下文工程系统，通过结构化提示管理和规范驱动开发流程，显著提升AI编程效率。核心价值在于将复杂提示工程标准化，优化大模型上下文窗口利用率，实现可复用的开发模式。适用于AI辅助开发场景，需注意项目已迁移至open-gsd/get-shit-done-redux。
summary.en: GSD (Get Shit Done) is a lightweight meta-prompting and context engineering framework built exclusively for Claude Code, designed to maximize AI programming efficiency. It introduces structured prompt management and specification-driven development workflows that standardize complex prompt engineering tasks. The system optimizes LLM context window utilization through dynamic context orchestration and enables reusable development patterns with prompt versioning capabilities. By enforcing spec-based validation, it ensures consistent AI behavior and high-quality output. This powerful tool transforms chaotic AI-assisted development into a systematic, productive process, reducing prompt sprawl and context management overhead. Note: This repository is archived; active development continues at open-gsd/get-shit-done-redux.

metadata.name: pretext
metadata.description: Fast, accurate & comprehensive text measurement & layout

summary.zh: Pretext 是一个纯 TypeScript 文本测量与布局引擎，通过绕过 DOM 测量彻底避免浏览器重排。它预计算文本分段和宽度，后续布局纯算术运算，支持多语言、RTL 和 emoji。适用于虚拟化列表、自定义布局、防止布局偏移及 AI 开发时的文本溢出验证，可渲染至 DOM/Canvas/SVG/SSR 多种环境。
summary.en: Pretext is a pure TypeScript text measurement and layout engine that eliminates expensive browser reflow by bypassing DOM measurements entirely. It precomputes text segmentation and character widths, then performs subsequent layout through pure arithmetic operations, supporting multilingual text, RTL languages, and emojis. Perfect for virtualization, custom masonry layouts, preventing layout shift, and AI-assisted development text overflow checks. Renders seamlessly to DOM, Canvas, SVG, and server-side environments.

metadata.name: How-To-Secure-A-Linux-Server
metadata.description: An evolving how-to guide for securing a Linux server.

summary.zh: 这个仓库提供全面的 Linux 服务器安全加固实践指南，涵盖 SSH 密钥与 2FA 认证、UFW 防火墙配置、Fail2Ban/CrowdSec 入侵防御、AIDE 文件完整性监控等核心模块。通过 Ansible Playbooks 实现自动化部署，结合纵深防御理念，为系统管理员和 DevOps 提供从基础加固到持续审计的一站式安全解决方案。
summary.en: This repository delivers a comprehensive, continuously updated guide for Linux server security hardening with actionable implementations. It systematically covers SSH hardening with key-based authentication and two-factor authentication, network security via UFW firewall and PSAD intrusion detection, application-layer protection using Fail2Ban and CrowdSec, and continuous monitoring through AIDE file integrity checks, Lynis auditing, and OSSEC HIDS. The guide emphasizes defense-in-depth strategies and provides production-ready Ansible Playbooks for automated deployment, making it an essential resource for system administrators, DevOps engineers, and security professionals seeking to implement robust server security from fundamentals to advanced threat detection.

metadata.name: machine-learning-visualized
metadata.description: ML algorithms implemented and derived from first-principles in Jupyter Notebooks and NumPy

summary.zh: 该项目通过 Jupyter Book 和 Marimo 构建交互式机器学习可视化平台，核心价值在于从第一性原理出发，使用 NumPy 纯 Python 实现神经网络、逻辑回归、PCA 等核心算法并配套数学推导。动态可视化训练过程，直观展示权重变化对损失函数的影响，是理解算法内部机制的顶级教学工具。
summary.en: This project builds an interactive ML visualization platform using Jupyter Book and Marimo. It implements core algorithms—neural networks, logistic regression, PCA, etc.—from first principles with NumPy, accompanied by mathematical derivations. Dynamic visualizations show training progression and weight-loss relationships, serving as a premier educational tool for understanding algorithmic internals.

metadata.name: AI_NovelGenerator
metadata.description: 使用ai生成多章节的长篇小说，自动衔接上下文、伏笔

summary.zh: AI小说生成器基于大语言模型实现多章长篇创作，核心解决长文本上下文连贯与伏笔管理难题。提供世界观构建、角色设计、智能分章生成功能，集成向量语义检索确保长期一致性，内置自动校对系统检测逻辑冲突。配备可视化工作台，支持本地知识库接入，适用于网文创作、剧本构思等场景。项目采用Python开发，兼容OpenAI/DeepSeek等API及Ollama本地部署方案。
summary.en: AI Novel Generator leverages large language models for multi-chapter long-form fiction creation, addressing context coherence and foreshadowing management in lengthy narratives. It features worldbuilding tools, character design, intelligent chapter generation with multi-stage processing, and vector-based semantic search for long-term consistency. The built-in proofreading system detects plot contradictions and logical conflicts. A visual workbench provides full GUI control, supporting local knowledge base integration. Built with Python, compatible with OpenAI/DeepSeek APIs and Ollama local deployment, ideal for web novel writing and creative scripting.

metadata.name: html-anything
metadata.description: ✨ The agentic HTML editor — your local AI agent writes the HTML, you ship it. 🚀 75 Skills × 9 Surfaces (magazine · deck · poster · XHS / tweet · prototype · data report · Hyperframes) 🛡️ Sandboxed preview · 📤 1-click to WeChat / X / Zhihu / HTML / PNG 🔑 Zero API key — Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Gemini / Copilot / OpenCode / Qwen / Aider.

summary.zh: HTML Anything 是一款本地优先的 AI 驱动 HTML 编辑器，无需 API 密钥即可调用 8 种主流编码代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor）自动生成生产级 HTML。内置 75 种可组合技能模板，覆盖杂志、海报、社交媒体卡片等 9 类输出场景，支持一键导出至微信、X、知乎及 PNG 格式，实现从内容生成到多平台发布的自动化闭环。
summary.en: HTML Anything is a local-first, agentic HTML editor that auto-generates production-ready HTML using 8 AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) without API keys. It offers 75 composable skill templates across 9 deliverable surfaces—including magazines, posters, and social media cards—with one-click export to WeChat, X, Zhihu, and PNG, streamlining end-to-end content creation and publishing.

metadata.name: OpenCLI
metadata.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.

summary.zh: OpenCLI 是一款将任意网站转换为命令行接口的自动化工具，核心在于让 AI 智能体通过已登录的浏览器操作网页（导航、填表、点击、数据提取）。内置 Bilibili、知乎等适配器，通过浏览器扩展与本地守护进程实现安全交互，支持自定义命令扩展，并集成本地工具与 Electron 应用，实现高效自动化与 AI 驱动交互。
summary.en: OpenCLI is an automation tool that converts any website into a command-line interface (CLI), enabling AI agents to operate websites via a logged-in browser for navigation, form filling, clicking, and data extraction. It provides built-in adapters for platforms like Bilibili and Zhihu, a browser extension with a local daemon, and allows custom command extensions. It also integrates local tools and Electron apps, serving as a versatile hub for human and AI-driven automation workflows.

metadata.name: platform
metadata.description: Huly — All-in-One Project Management Platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion)

summary.zh: Huly Platform 是开源一体化项目管理平台，替代 Jira、Linear 等工具。提供 Chat、CRM、HRM、ATS 等模块化应用，支持自托管与 API 驱动开发。基于 Node.js 全栈框架，采用 Docker 容器化部署，加速企业级业务应用构建，实现多团队协作与流程自动化。
summary.en: Huly Platform is an open-source all-in-one project management solution that replaces Jira, Linear, Slack, and Notion. It provides modular applications including Chat, CRM, HRM, and ATS with self-hosting capability. Built on a Node.js full-stack framework using Docker containerization, it accelerates enterprise business application development through API-driven integration and automated workflows for team collaboration.

metadata.name: deepteam
metadata.description: DeepTeam is a framework to red team LLMs and AI agents.

summary.zh: DeepTeam是开源的LLM红队测试框架，专为AI系统提供安全渗透测试。它通过模拟越狱、提示注入等50+攻击方式，检测AI代理、RAG和聊天机器人中的隐私泄露、偏见等漏洞。基于DeepEval构建，支持本地运行LLM-as-a-Judge评估，并提供生产环境防护护栏，助力AI系统安全加固。
summary.en: DeepTeam is an open-source red teaming framework designed for LLM systems, functioning as penetration testing for AI. It simulates over 50 attacks like jailbreaking and prompt injection to uncover vulnerabilities such as data leakage and bias in AI agents, RAG pipelines, and chatbots. Built on DeepEval, it runs locally with LLM-as-a-Judge metrics and offers guardrails for production security, strengthening AI system resilience.

metadata.name: guizang-ppt-skill
metadata.description: AI-agent Skill for generating polished HTML slide decks: editorial magazine and Swiss layouts, image prompts, social covers, and a WebGL/low-power presentation runtime.

summary.zh: 为AI Agent提供高质量HTML PPT生成能力，内置电子杂志与瑞士国际主义双视觉系统，支持单文件横向翻页演示、多平台封面生成及Codex配图流程。解决AI生成PPT的视觉质量控制难题，适用于个人风格演讲、产品发布及方法论展示，输出无需构建、可直接打开的HTML文件。
summary.en: An AI Agent skill for generating polished HTML slide decks with dual visual systems: editorial magazine and Swiss internationalist styles. Enables single-file horizontal presentations, multi-platform social covers, and Codex-integrated image generation. Solves visual quality control for AI-generated slides, ideal for personal talks, product launches, and methodology showcases with zero-build delivery.

metadata.name: pi
metadata.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI

summary.zh: Pi 是一个自扩展的 AI 编码 Agent 工具链，提供统一的 LLM API 抽象层，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等多模型提供商。包含交互式 CLI、终端 UI 库和 Slack 机器人，具备工具调用和状态管理能力。专为开发者设计，通过真实开源项目会话数据持续优化，实现生产级 AI 自动化编程。
summary.en: Pi is a self-extensible AI coding agent toolkit featuring a unified LLM API abstraction layer supporting multiple providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. It includes an interactive CLI, terminal UI library with differential rendering, web UI components, and Slack bot integration with robust tool calling and state management capabilities. Designed for developers, it enables production-grade AI automation programming and continuously improves through real-world open-source session data collection and sharing, with hardened supply-chain security for enterprise deployment.

metadata.name: GenericAgent
metadata.description: Self-evolving agent: grows skill tree from 3.3K-line seed, achieving full system control with 6x less token consumption

summary.zh: GenericAgent是一个极简的自进化智能体框架，仅3K行核心代码，通过9个原子工具实现系统级控制（浏览器、终端、文件系统等）。它自动将任务执行路径固化为技能，形成个人技能树，支持多模型与跨平台，上下文窗口小于30K，显著降低token消耗与幻觉，提升任务成功率。
summary.en: GenericAgent is a minimal self-evolving autonomous agent framework with only ~3K lines of core code. Through 9 atomic tools, it grants LLMs system-level control over browsers, terminals, filesystems, and more. It automatically crystallizes task execution paths into reusable skills, forming a personal skill tree. Supporting multiple models and cross-platform, it uses a <30K context window, reducing token consumption and hallucinations.

summary.zh: Oz Skills 是为 Warp AI 代理和 Oz 系统设计的可复用技能库，通过 Markdown 文件定义开发规范与工作流程。技能以 YAML 前置元数据 + 内容的形式存储于 `.agents/skills/` 目录，支持项目级和全局级自动发现加载。该仓库提供预制技能模板，实现 AI 代理的上下文感知能力，显著提升开发协作效率，支持社区贡献扩展。
summary.en: Oz Skills is a curated collection of reusable Agent Skills for Warp AI agents and Oz systems, defining development conventions and workflows through Markdown files. Skills are stored in `.agents/skills/` directories with YAML frontmatter and markdown content, supporting automatic discovery at both project and global levels. This repository provides pre-built skill templates that enable context-aware AI assistance, significantly improving development collaboration efficiency while allowing community contributions.

metadata.name: react-video-ascii
metadata.description: Video to ASCII React component.

summary.zh: react-video-ascii 是一个基于 WebGL2 的高性能 React 组件，可将视频实时转换为 ASCII 艺术。支持自定义字符集、亮度/饱和度调节及字形/亮度双渲染模式。内置鼠标悬停高亮/散射、点击波纹/扩散动画及加载揭示效果。适用于创意编码、艺术展示和网页特效场景，通过 GPU 加速确保流畅体验。
summary.en: react-video-ascii is a high-performance React component that converts videos to ASCII art in real-time using WebGL2 acceleration. It offers extensive customization including character sets, brightness/saturation controls, and dual rendering modes (shape/luminance). Features interactive mouse hover effects (brighten/scatter), click animations (ripple/spread), and reveal transitions. Ideal for creative coding, artistic displays, and web experiments with smooth GPU-accelerated rendering.

metadata.name: Horizon
metadata.description: 📡 Your own AI-powered news radar. Generates daily briefings in English & Chinese. | 用 AI 构建你专属的新闻雷达

summary.zh: AI驱动的新闻聚合雷达，自动抓取Hacker News、Reddit、RSS等多源资讯，通过Claude/GPT等模型进行去重、评分与摘要，生成个性化双语日报。支持自定义源、阈值与Feishu/邮件推送，保留人工筛选层，高效过滤信息噪音。
summary.en: Horizon is an AI-powered news radar that automatically aggregates content from Hacker News, Reddit, RSS, Telegram, Twitter/X, and GitHub releases. It uses Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or Ollama models to deduplicate, score (0-10), summarize, and enrich stories with background context and community discussions. The tool generates personalized bilingual daily briefings delivered via Feishu, email, or web, featuring customizable sources, thresholds, and human-in-the-loop curation to filter noise while preserving trusted content.

metadata.name: wx-cli
metadata.description: WeChat local data CLI with daemon architecture

summary.zh: wx-cli 是一款基于守护进程架构的微信本地数据命令行查询工具，实现毫秒级响应。通过持久化缓存解密数据库，仅在数据变更时重新加载，支持会话管理、消息搜索、联系人查询及统计导出。采用 Rust 编写，提供零依赖单二进制文件，跨平台支持 macOS/Linux/Windows。深度适配 AI 智能体，输出含元信息的结构化数据，支持一键集成至 Claude Code 等开发环境。所有数据处理均在本地完成，保障隐私安全，适用于自动化脚本与数据分析场景。
summary.en: wx-cli is a WeChat local data CLI tool with daemon architecture for millisecond-level responses. It persistently caches decrypted databases, reloading only when data changes, enabling efficient session management, message search, contact lookup, and statistical export. Built with Rust as a zero-dependency single binary, it supports cross-platform operation (macOS/Linux/Windows). Designed for AI agents, it outputs structured data with metadata for direct integration with tools like Claude Code. All processing remains local, ensuring privacy for automation and data analysis workflows.

metadata.name: CloakBrowser
metadata.description: Stealth Chromium that passes every bot detection test. Drop-in Playwright replacement with source-level fingerprint patches. 30/30 tests passed.

summary.zh: CloakBrowser 是一款源码级深度改造的隐身 Chromium 浏览器，通过 58 个 C++ 补丁从底层消除自动化指纹，完美绕过 Cloudflare Turnstile、reCAPTCHA v3 等 30+ 机器人检测系统。无缝兼容 Playwright/Puppeteer API，一行代码替换，内置类人行为模拟，为网页爬虫、数据采集和自动化测试提供终极反检测解决方案。
summary.en: CloakBrowser is a stealth Chromium browser with 58 source-level C++ patches that fundamentally eliminate automation fingerprints. It achieves a 0.9 reCAPTCHA v3 score and passes 30+ bot detection tests including Cloudflare Turnstile and FingerprintJS. Offering seamless Playwright/Puppeteer API compatibility with one-line code replacement, built-in human-like behavior simulation, and automatic binary updates, it delivers the ultimate anti-detection solution for web scraping, data collection, and automation tasks.

metadata.name: pierre
metadata.description: pierre’s open source code

summary.zh: 这是一个来自PIERRE COMPUTER COMPANY的开源元仓库，作为公司开源项目的中央枢纽。该项目采用TypeScript技术栈，目前托管了两个核心开发者工具：Diffs（专业的代码差异分析平台）和Trees（先进的树形结构可视化软件）。作为官方开源门户，它提供统一的代码分发、技术文档和全球开发者支持服务，体现了现代软件企业对于开放协作、透明开发和社区驱动创新的核心理念。
summary.en: This is an open-source meta-repository from PIERRE COMPUTER COMPANY, serving as a central hub for the organization's open-source initiatives and developer tools. Built with TypeScript, it currently hosts two core projects: Diffs (a sophisticated code diff analysis platform) and Trees (an advanced tree structure visualization software). As the company's official open-source portal, it provides unified code distribution, comprehensive documentation, and dedicated technical support channels for the global developer community, demonstrating modern software enterprises' commitment to open collaboration, transparent development practices, and community-driven innovation.

metadata.name: UI-TARS-desktop
metadata.description: The Open-Source Multimodal AI Agent Stack: Connecting Cutting-Edge AI Models and Agent Infra

summary.zh: UI-TARS-desktop是字节跳动开源的多模态AI智能体桌面应用，基于UI-TARS视觉模型实现GUI自动化操作。支持本地与远程计算机及浏览器控制，无缝集成MCP工具链，通过自然语言指令完成跨应用任务。提供CLI与Web UI双模式，具备流式响应、运行时调试和沙箱隔离等企业级特性，为生产力自动化提供端到端解决方案。
summary.en: UI-TARS-desktop is ByteDance's open-source multimodal AI agent desktop application powered by the UI-TARS vision model for GUI automation. It enables local and remote control of computers and browsers through natural language commands, seamlessly integrating with MCP tools for human-like task completion. Offering both CLI and Web UI interfaces, it features streaming responses, runtime performance statistics, Event Stream Viewer for debugging, and AIO Sandbox isolation. This enterprise-ready stack delivers a complete end-to-end solution for automating productivity workflows across desktop and web environments.

metadata.name: voice-pro
metadata.description: Gradio WebUI for creators and developers, featuring key TTS (Edge-TTS, kokoro) and zero-shot Voice Cloning (E2 & F5-TTS, CosyVoice), with Whisper audio processing, YouTube download, Demucs vocal isolation, and multilingual translation.

summary.zh: Voice-Pro是集YouTube视频下载、人声分离、语音识别、多语言翻译与TTS于一体的AI音频创作平台。基于Gradio构建，集成Whisper、F5-TTS、CosyVoice等前沿模型，支持零样本语音克隆与高质量配音，为创作者提供一站式多语言内容本地化解决方案，显著提升跨语言内容生产效率。
summary.en: Voice-Pro is an all-in-one AI audio creation platform that seamlessly integrates YouTube video downloading, vocal isolation, speech recognition, multilingual translation and text-to-speech capabilities. Built on Gradio with cutting-edge models including Whisper, F5-TTS, E2-TTS and CosyVoice, it enables zero-shot voice cloning and professional-grade dubbing. The platform provides creators and developers with a comprehensive solution for multilingual content localization, significantly enhancing cross-lingual content production efficiency.

metadata.name: phantom-motion
metadata.description: Phantom-Motion is an incredibly powerful, epic interactive dynamic visual storytelling generator. Its capabilities are limited only by the bounds of your imagination! 它是一个极其硬核的史诗级交互式动态视觉叙事生成器。它的实力只取决于你的想象力高低！

summary.zh: Phantom Motion 是一款基于 AI 的智能动态视觉叙事引擎，通过融合 GSAP 电影级运镜、Three.js GPGPU 粒子系统与 KaTeX 数学渲染，实现文本剧本到 60FPS 4K 商业视频的无缝转换。其 Audio-First 架构确保微秒级音画同步，Monocle 版式引擎与 WYSIWYG 交互套件支持所见即所得编辑，彻底革新传统影视制作流程。
summary.en: Phantom Motion is an AI-powered dynamic visual storytelling engine that transforms text scripts into 60FPS 4K commercial videos. It integrates Hollywood-grade GSAP camera work, Three.js GPGPU particle systems, and KaTeX math rendering with Audio-First architecture for microsecond audio-visual sync. The Monocle layout engine and WYSIWYG editing suite revolutionize traditional video production workflows.

metadata.name: cherry-studio
metadata.description: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants. Unified access to frontier LLMs

summary.zh: Cherry Studio 是一款 AI 生产力桌面应用，集成智能聊天与自主代理能力，内置 300+ 专业助手。通过统一接口无缝接入 GPT-4、Claude 等前沿大模型，支持多语言交互与上下文感知，覆盖文档处理、代码生成、研究分析等场景，实现智能化升级并显著提升工作效率。
summary.en: Cherry Studio is a comprehensive AI productivity desktop application that seamlessly integrates intelligent chat interfaces with autonomous agent capabilities, featuring over 300 specialized assistants for various domains. The platform provides unified access to leading large language models including GPT-4 and Claude, supports multilingual interactions with advanced context awareness, enables intelligent automation across document processing, code generation, and research analysis scenarios, and offers a user-friendly interface for both technical and non-technical users, significantly enhancing workplace productivity and operational efficiency through streamlined workflows.

metadata.name: mcp-chrome
metadata.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.

summary.zh: Chrome MCP Server是一款基于Chrome扩展的Model Context Protocol服务器，让AI助手直接控制用户现有浏览器。核心优势在于复用日常Chrome环境的登录状态与配置，实现隐私优先的本地自动化。提供20+工具支持截图、网络监控、书签管理等，内置SIMD加速的向量数据库实现智能语义搜索，跨标签页上下文感知，适用于复杂浏览器自动化与内容分析场景。
summary.en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol server that transforms your existing Chrome browser into an AI-controlled automation tool. Unlike Playwright-based solutions, it directly leverages your daily browser with preserved login states and configurations, ensuring privacy through local execution. It offers 20+ tools for screenshots, network monitoring, bookmark management, and more, plus SIMD-accelerated vector search for semantic content discovery. Cross-tab context awareness enables complex browser automation and intelligent content analysis for any LLM or chatbot client.

metadata.name: openwolf
metadata.description: Sharper context. Fewer tokens. Open-source middleware for Claude Code.

summary.zh: OpenWolf 是 Claude Code 的开源中间件，通过 6 个隐形 hook 脚本为其提供'第二大脑'。它构建项目文件索引、学习记忆和 token 账本，在读取文件前提供上下文信息，阻止重复读取，自动记录偏好与错误。实测可减少 80% token 消耗，平均节省 65.8%，且无需改变现有工作流。
summary.en: OpenWolf is an open-source middleware that acts as a 'second brain' for Claude Code, delivering sharper context and dramatically reducing token usage. Through 6 invisible hook scripts, it builds project file indexes with token estimates, accumulates learning memory from corrections, and maintains a comprehensive token ledger. By providing file context before reads, blocking duplicate accesses within sessions, and auto-documenting preferences and mistakes, it achieves up to 80% token reduction (averaging 65.8% across 132+ real-world sessions) with zero workflow changes for developers.

metadata.name: build-your-own-openclaw
metadata.description: A step-by-step guide to build your own AI agent.

summary.zh: 这是一个18步渐进式教程，从零构建生产级AI智能体。涵盖单智能体能力（工具、记忆、网络访问）、事件驱动架构、多智能体协作及生产化特性。每个步骤提供可运行代码与详细设计决策，使用LiteLLM支持多模型提供商，适合学习与实践。
summary.en: An 18-step progressive tutorial for building production-ready AI agents from scratch. Covers single-agent capabilities (tools, memory, web access), event-driven architecture, multi-agent collaboration, and production features. Each step includes runnable code and design decisions, using LiteLLM for multi-provider support, ideal for learning and practice.

metadata.name: Vibe-Trading
metadata.description: "Vibe-Trading: Your Personal Trading Agent"

summary.zh: Vibe-Trading 是港大开源的个人AI交易代理系统，通过单一命令赋予智能体完整交易能力。采用Python 3.11+与FastAPI后端、React 19前端，支持MCP协议实现模型交互。核心亮点包括Swarm集群容错恢复、影子账户模拟交易、Rich交互式CLI。提供API与MCP服务，支持实时任务协调与状态管理，为量化交易提供开箱即用的AI解决方案。
summary.en: Vibe-Trading is HKU's open-source personal AI trading agent system that empowers agents with comprehensive trading capabilities through a single command. Built with Python 3.11+ and FastAPI backend, React 19 frontend, it supports MCP for model context interaction. Key features include Swarm cluster fault tolerance recovery, shadow account simulation, Rich interactive CLI, and automated operations. It provides API and MCP services, enabling real-time task coordination and state management for quantitative trading with out-of-the-box AI solutions.

metadata.name: claude-ads
metadata.description: Comprehensive paid advertising audit & optimization skill for Claude Code. 250+ checks across Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft & Apple Ads with weighted scoring, parallel agents, industry templates, and AI creative generation.

summary.zh: 为Claude Code设计的付费广告审计AI技能，覆盖Google、Meta等8大平台，通过250+检查项在10-15分钟内完成原需4-6小时的人工审计。采用加权评分和并行代理技术，提供优先级行动方案与AI创意生成，支持跨平台部署，适用于PPC代理机构、企业内部营销团队及自由顾问。
summary.en: An AI skill for Claude Code that automates paid advertising audits across 8 platforms including Google and Meta. It performs 250+ checks in 10-15 minutes, replacing 4-6 hours of manual work. Features weighted scoring, parallel agents, prioritized action plans, and AI creative generation. Cross-platform compatible for PPC agencies, in-house marketers, and freelance consultants.

metadata.name: AutoHedge
metadata.description: Build your autonomous hedge fund in minutes. AutoHedge harnesses the power of swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution.

summary.zh: AutoHedge 是一个基于群体智能的多代理AI系统，可自动化构建对冲基金。系统采用Director、Quant、Risk Manager、Execution四层代理架构，实现从市场分析、策略生成到风险控制和交易执行的全流程自主化。目前支持Solana链上全自动交易，采用风险优先设计，提供结构化输出和企业级日志，适用于机构级量化交易场景。
summary.en: AutoHedge is an enterprise-grade autonomous hedge fund platform powered by swarm intelligence and multi-agent AI systems. It orchestrates specialized agents for market analysis, strategy generation, risk management, and trade execution in a risk-first pipeline. Currently supporting full autonomous trading on Solana, it features structured JSON outputs, comprehensive logging, and modular architecture for institutional-grade quantitative trading with minimal human intervention.

metadata.name: Sprite-Pipeline
metadata.description: 2D Sprite Sheet Creation Pipeline

summary.zh: 为独立游戏开发者提供AI动画转精灵图的生产级管线。通过FFmpeg帧提取、自动去背景、智能打包成256x256标准格式，内置浏览器审查工具与AI助手集成，实现从AI生成视频到游戏可用资源的可控生产流程，确保仅审核通过的资产进入项目。
summary.en: Provides indie game developers with a production-grade pipeline for converting AI-generated animations into sprite sheets. It extracts frames via FFmpeg, performs automatic matting, packs assets into standardized 256x256 formats, and includes a browser-based review tool with AI assistant integration, ensuring only approved outputs are promoted to game projects.

metadata.name: agent-rules-books
metadata.description: AGENTS.md rules / skills for AI coding agents: Codex, Cursor & Claude Code. Inspired by Clean Code, Refactoring, DDD, Clean Architecture and DDIA programming books.

summary.zh: 本仓库将经典软件工程著作（如Clean Code、DDD、DDIA）提炼为AI编程智能体（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex）可执行的规则集。提供full/mini/nano三版本适配不同上下文窗口，注入工程化思维与架构治理，提升AI生成代码的质量与可维护性。
summary.en: This repository distills classic software engineering books (Clean Code, DDD, DDIA) into executable rule sets for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex). It provides three versions (full/mini/nano) to fit different context windows, injecting engineering mindset and architecture governance into AI-generated code. The tool-agnostic Markdown format enhances code quality and maintainability while supporting editor-specific configurations for optimal AI-assisted development.

metadata.name: open-design
metadata.description: 🎨 The open-source Claude Design alternative. 🖥️ Local-first desktop app. 🖼️ Your coding agent becomes the design engine: prototypes, landing pages, dashboards, slides, images & video — real files, HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 export. 🤖 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini / OpenCode / Qwen & 20+ CLIs via BYOK.

summary.zh: Open Design 是开源、本地优先的 Claude Design 替代品，支持 16+ AI 编码代理（Claude Code/Cursor/Gemini 等）。提供 31 种可组合技能和 72 个品牌级设计系统，可生成 Web/桌面/移动原型、幻灯片、图像和视频，支持 HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 导出。BYOK 模式确保数据自主，沙盒预览保障安全，是 Figma 的开源替代方案。
summary.en: Open Design is an open-source, local-first alternative to Claude Design supporting 16+ AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, etc.). It offers 31 composable skills and 72 brand-grade design systems to generate web, desktop, and mobile prototypes, slides, images, and videos. Features include sandboxed preview, HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 export, and BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model for data sovereignty. A viable open-source replacement for Figma with multi-agent flexibility.

metadata.name: GEOFlow
metadata.description: Open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution system with AI tasks, RAG/semantic chunking, analytics, GEOFlow Agent and WordPress target publishing.

summary.zh: GEOFlow 是开源的 GEO 内容工程与多站点分发系统，通过 AI 生成、RAG 知识库、素材管理和任务自动化，实现可信内容资产的全链路管理。支持多模型调用、智能审核、SEO 优化和静态页面分发，适用于大规模内容生产与多渠道发布场景。基于 Laravel 和 pgvector，提供 Docker 一键部署方案。
summary.en: GEOFlow is an open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution system that orchestrates AI generation, RAG knowledge bases, material management, and task automation into a sustainable workflow. It enables teams to transform trusted resources into manageable, publishable, and trackable content assets across multiple channels. Key features include multi-model AI integration, intelligent review, SEO optimization, static page generation, and analytics. Built on Laravel with PostgreSQL and pgvector, it offers Docker Compose deployment for scalable content operations.

metadata.name: nanobot
metadata.description: Lightweight, open-source AI agent for your tools, chats, and workflows.

summary.zh: nanobot 是 HKUDS 开发的开源超轻量级 AI 智能体，核心设计精简且可读。它支持聊天通道、记忆管理和 MCP 协议，可无缝集成工具与工作流。内置 WebUI，提供跨轮次目标追踪和图像生成能力，支持多模型 fallback。从本地快速部署到长期运行的个性化智能体，适用于自动化任务和智能助手场景。
summary.en: nanobot is an open-source, ultra-lightweight AI agent developed by HKUDS, featuring a minimalist and readable core design. It supports chat channels, memory management, and the MCP protocol for seamless tool and workflow integration. With a built-in WebUI, it offers cross-turn goal tracking and end-to-end image generation, along with multi-model fallback support. Designed for easy deployment from local setups to long-running personal agents, it is ideal for automation tasks and intelligent assistant applications.

metadata.name: heti
metadata.description: 赫蹏（hètí）是专为中文内容展示设计的排版样式增强。它基于通行的中文排版规范而来，可以为网站的读者带来更好的文章阅读体验。

summary.zh: 赫蹏是专为中文网页内容设计的排版增强库，基于现代CSS与JavaScript实现。它提供网格对齐、中西文混排自动美化、标点挤压、竖排古文诗词版式等特性，支持简繁体与黑暗模式。通过简单的类名引入即可显著提升中文阅读体验，兼容主流样式重置方案，适配移动端。
summary.en: Heti is a specialized typography enhancement library designed for Chinese web content presentation, implemented with modern CSS and JavaScript. It delivers grid-aligned layout, automatic Chinese-Western text spacing, punctuation compression, pre-configured layouts for classical texts and poetry, vertical writing support, and seamless dark mode adaptation. The library supports both simplified and traditional Chinese while being fully responsive for mobile devices. With simple class name integration, it dramatically elevates Chinese reading experience and is compatible with popular CSS reset solutions.

metadata.name: chinese-copywriting-guidelines
metadata.description: Chinese copywriting guidelines for better written communication／中文文案排版指北

summary.zh: 该仓库提供全面的中文文案排版规范，系统性地统一中英文、数字间的空格规则，规范标点符号使用、全半角字符标准，以及专有名词正确大小写。旨在降低团队协作沟通成本，提升内容质量和网站专业气质。包含丰富实用示例和争议性案例讨论，并集成pangu.js等自动化工具实现规则检查。适用于网站、文档、UI界面等所有中文内容创作场景，是开发者、设计师和内容创作者的标准化必备参考指南。
summary.en: This repository provides comprehensive Chinese copywriting and typesetting guidelines, standardizing spacing between Chinese/English characters and numbers, proper punctuation usage, and correct capitalization. It aims to reduce team communication costs and enhance content quality. Includes practical examples, controversial edge cases, and integrates automation tools like pangu.js for rule enforcement. Essential for developers, designers, and content creators working with Chinese language content across websites, documentation, and UI interfaces.

metadata.name: cuimao-translator
metadata.description: 一键将英文PDF翻译为流畅中文的Claude Code技能

summary.zh: 萃猫翻译是Claude Code技能，专注英文PDF书籍高质量翻译。采用信达雅三阶段流程，提供速译/标准/精翻三种模式及五种文体风格。核心技术包括欧化中文六重检测、术语一致性管理和智能润色，实现逐句忠实且地道流畅的译文输出，适用于学术、文学、技术文档等专业场景。
summary.en: Cuimao Translator is a Claude Code skill for high-quality English PDF book translation. It employs a three-stage process (faithfulness-fluency-elegance) with three modes (Quick/Normal/Refined) and five style presets. Key technologies include six-layer Chinglish detection, terminology consistency management, and intelligent polishing, delivering sentence-by-sentence faithful yet natural Chinese translations for academic, literary, and technical documents.

metadata.name: VoxCPM
metadata.description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning

summary.zh: VoxCPM2是开源的Tokenizer-Free文本转语音系统，基于2B参数Diffusion自回归架构，训练于200万小时多语言数据。支持30种语言合成、自然语言驱动的声音创意设计、48kHz高保真声音克隆及实时流式生成。其端到端设计绕过离散标记化，实现更自然、更具表现力的语音合成，适用于多语言内容创作、个性化语音助手等场景。
summary.en: VoxCPM2 is an open-source tokenizer-free Text-to-Speech system built on a 2B-parameter diffusion autoregressive architecture trained on over 2 million hours of multilingual speech data. It enables 30-language synthesis, natural language-based voice design, controllable voice cloning, and ultimate cloning with 48kHz studio-quality output. The end-to-end model bypasses discrete tokenization for highly natural and expressive speech generation, supporting real-time streaming with RTF as low as 0.13 via vLLM acceleration, ideal for creative content production and personalized voice applications.

metadata.name: zap
metadata.description: Zap is an open, local-first terminal with first-class AI and agent support.

summary.zh: Zap 是一款开源的本地优先终端，深度集成 AI 与智能体能力。它支持接入任意 OpenAI 兼容端点及主流 AI 模型（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/DeepSeek/Ollama），内置 SSH 主机管理，可集成第三方 CLI 智能体。采用本地存储策略，密钥、历史记录和智能体状态默认保留在用户设备，提供隐私优先的现代化终端体验。
summary.en: Zap is an open-source, local-first terminal with native AI and agent integration. It supports any OpenAI-compatible endpoints and major AI providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/DeepSeek/Ollama), built-in SSH host management, and third-party CLI agents. With local storage for keys, history, and agent states by default, it delivers a privacy-focused modern terminal experience.

metadata.name: paperclip
metadata.description: Paperclip — search, read, and analyze 8M+ biomedical papers from the command line

summary.zh: Paperclip 是一款命令行工具，专为高效检索与分析 800 万+生物医学文献而设计。支持自然语言/正则搜索、并行 AI 阅读、SQL 查询及图表视觉分析，无缝集成 Unix 工具链。可作为 MCP 服务器赋能 AI 智能体，快速完成文献综述、监管文档查询等科研任务。
summary.en: Paperclip is a command-line tool for rapid search and analysis of over 8 million biomedical papers. It enables natural language/regex search, parallel AI reading, SQL queries, and vision-based figure analysis, integrating seamlessly with Unix tools. As an MCP server, it empowers AI agents to efficiently conduct literature reviews and regulatory document queries.

metadata.name: skills
metadata.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .claude directory.

summary.zh: 一套面向真实工程的AI智能体技能库，提供可组合的提示词模板，解决需求对齐、代码啰嗦、调试低效等痛点。支持任意大模型，集成GitHub/Linear，助力工程师高效协作而非vibe coding。
summary.en: A collection of composable AI agent skills for real engineering, solving misalignment, verbosity, and debugging inefficiencies. Works with any model, integrates with GitHub/Linear, and helps engineers collaborate effectively beyond vibe coding.

metadata.name: mapcn
metadata.description: Beautiful map components. 100% Free, Zero config, one command setup.

summary.zh: mapcn 是一个免费开源的 React 地图组件库，提供零配置、一键集成的地图解决方案。基于 MapLibre GL 构建，深度集成 Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 样式体系，支持主题感知、可组合组件、标记弹窗、路线绘制等核心功能，适用于快速开发美观的地图可视化应用。
summary.en: mapcn is a free, open-source React map component library that provides zero-config, one-command setup for beautiful map visualizations. Built on MapLibre GL and styled with Tailwind CSS, it seamlessly integrates with shadcn/ui design patterns. Key features include theme-aware light/dark mode adaptation, composable map components, rich markers with popups and tooltips, route/path drawing capabilities, and built-in controls—enabling rapid development of sophisticated map-based applications.

metadata.name: lazygit
metadata.description: simple terminal UI for git commands

summary.zh: lazygit 是用 Go 语言开发的终端 Git 客户端，为开发者提供简洁的交互式界面来执行 Git 命令。它通过可视化操作简化了提交、推送、分支管理等复杂流程，支持跨平台使用，显著提升版本控制效率，是开发者日常 Git 操作的效率利器。
summary.en: lazygit is a lightweight terminal UI for Git commands, developed in Go language. It provides developers with an intuitive interactive interface to simplify complex Git workflows including committing, pushing, branch management, and conflict resolution. This cross-platform tool dramatically enhances version control efficiency by visualizing repository states and enabling keyboard-driven operations. Designed for developers seeking productivity in daily Git usage, lazygit reduces command memorization overhead and streamlines the development process.

metadata.name: camofox-browser
metadata.description: Stealth headless browser for AI agents — bypass Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping. Drop-in Puppeteer/Playwright replacement.

summary.zh: camofox-browser 是基于 Camoufox（C++ 层修改的 Firefox 内核）构建的反检测浏览器服务，专为 AI 智能体设计。它通过底层指纹欺骗（WebGL、AudioContext、硬件并发数等）绕过 Cloudflare 和反爬机制，提供 REST API 接口。相比 Playwright，内存占用低至 40MB，支持可访问性快照（比 HTML 小 90%）、会话隔离和搜索宏，是 Puppeteer/Playwright 的直接替代方案。
summary.en: camofox-browser is a stealth headless browser service for AI agents, built on Camoufox—a Firefox fork with C++-level fingerprint spoofing. It bypasses Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping by patching navigator.hardwareConcurrency, WebGL, AudioContext, screen geometry, and WebRTC before JavaScript execution. Offering a REST API with 90% smaller accessibility snapshots than HTML, stable element refs, session isolation, search macros, and ~40MB idle memory, it serves as a drop-in replacement for Playwright/Puppeteer in AI automation and web scraping workflows.

metadata.name: Pentest-Swarm-AI
metadata.description: Autonomous penetration testing using a swarm of AI agents. Orchestrates recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting specialists with ReAct reasoning — supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes. Built with Go, Claude API, and 7+ native security tools.

summary.zh: Pentest Swarm AI是首个基于真实群体架构的开源渗透测试工具，通过AI代理群协同完成侦察、分类、利用和报告全流程。支持漏洞赏金、持续监控和CTF模式，集成nmap、sqlmap、Burp等7+原生安全工具，兼容Claude、Ollama等多种大模型，采用ReAct推理实现真正自主化的安全测试。
summary.en: Pentest Swarm AI is the first open-source penetration testing tool built on a real swarm architecture, orchestrating specialized AI agents for reconnaissance, classification, exploitation, and reporting. Supporting bug bounty programs, continuous monitoring, and CTF competitions, it integrates 7+ native security tools including nmap, sqlmap, Burp, and Metasploit. Built with Go and ReAct reasoning, it's compatible with Claude, Ollama, and other LLMs, enabling truly autonomous security testing through stigmergic multi-agent coordination.

summary.zh: CodeStable是面向严肃工程的AI编码工作流工具，通过结构化建模需求、架构、特性等软件核心要素，解决长期迭代中知识丢失与复杂度失控问题。采用人在环（Human-in-the-loop）设计，提供6大实体与3大流程，以命令行工具链实现AI与开发者高效协作，确保软件生命周期可追溯、可复用。
summary.en: CodeStable is an AI coding workflow tool for serious engineering that addresses knowledge loss and runaway complexity by structuring core software artifacts like requirements, architecture, and features. With a human-in-the-loop design, it provides 6 core entities and 3 processes, coupled with a CLI toolchain to enable efficient human-AI collaboration, ensuring traceability and reusability across the software lifecycle.

metadata.name: awesome-opensource-ai
metadata.description: Curated list of the best truly open-source AI projects, models, tools, and infrastructure. Daily updated.

summary.zh: 这是一个全面收录高质量开源AI项目的精选列表，涵盖核心框架、基础模型、推理引擎、AI代理、RAG、MLOps等14大类别。为开发者提供从研究到生产落地的完整技术栈导航，助力快速发现与集成前沿开源AI工具，推动AI技术民主化。
summary.en: A comprehensive curated list of high-quality truly open-source AI projects, models, tools, and infrastructure spanning 14 categories from core frameworks to production deployment. Covers the entire AI technology stack including foundation models, inference engines, agentic AI systems, RAG, MLOps, and AI safety tools. Serves as an essential developer resource for discovering, evaluating, and integrating cutting-edge open-source AI solutions, significantly lowering barriers to AI adoption and fostering innovation through open collaboration.

metadata.name: ART
metadata.description: Agent Reinforcement Trainer: train multi-step agents for real-world tasks using GRPO. Give your agents on-the-job training. Reinforcement learning for Qwen3.6, GPT-OSS, Llama, and more!

summary.zh: ART是基于GRPO算法的强化学习框架，用于训练多步智能体执行现实任务。它支持Qwen3.6、GPT-OSS、Llama等主流大模型，提供无服务器RL服务，可降低40%成本、加速训练并免去基础设施管理。开发者可轻松集成到Python应用，快速迭代智能体，提升可靠性。
summary.en: ART is an open-source reinforcement learning framework that employs Generalized Policy Gradient Optimization (GRPO) to train multi-step agents for real-world tasks. It supports popular large language models including Qwen3.6, GPT-OSS, and Llama. The framework provides a serverless RL backend via W&B Training, which cuts costs by 40%, accelerates training by 28%, and eliminates infrastructure management. With an ergonomic Python API, ART allows developers to quickly iterate on agent development, enhancing reliability through experience-based learning.

metadata.name: skyvern
metadata.description: Automate browser based workflows with AI

summary.zh: Skyvern 是基于 LLM 和计算机视觉的智能浏览器自动化平台，提供 Playwright 兼容 SDK 和无代码工作流构建器。通过视觉理解替代 XPath 定位，支持未知网站自动化、布局变更自适应，实现跨站点工作流批量执行，显著提升自动化鲁棒性。
summary.en: Skyvern automates browsers using LLMs and vision. Playwright SDK replaces XPath with visual understanding for resilient cross-site workflows.

metadata.name: Telegram-Media-Downloader
metadata.description: A script allowing you to download images and videos from Telegram web even if the group restricts downloading.

summary.zh: 该脚本是一款Telegram网页端用户脚本，可突破群组下载限制，实现图片、视频、GIF及音频等媒体的无损下载。支持私聊、频道及故事内容，通过注入页面解锁下载按钮，兼容主流浏览器及脚本管理器。无需后端服务，适用于需备份Telegram受限媒体资源的用户。
summary.en: This user script bypasses Telegram web's download restrictions to save images, videos, GIFs, and audios from chats, stories, and private channels. It injects into pages to unlock download buttons, compatible with major browsers via script managers like Tampermonkey. Lightweight and backend-free, it efficiently backs up restricted Telegram media content.

metadata.name: nodecrypt
metadata.description: 🔒True end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) chat system in web. 🔒真正的网页端到端加密聊天系统

summary.zh: NodeCrypt 是一个基于 Web 的真正端到端加密聊天系统，采用零知识架构确保服务器无法获取明文消息。系统使用三层安全体系：RSA-2048 身份验证、ECDH-P384 密钥协商和混合对称加密（AES-256 + ChaCha20）。基于 Cloudflare Workers 部署，无需数据库，支持匿名聊天和前向安全性，所有加密在客户端完成。
summary.en: NodeCrypt is a true end-to-end encrypted web chat system implementing zero-knowledge architecture where servers cannot access plaintext messages. It employs a three-layer security model: RSA-2048 for server authentication, ECDH-P384 for key negotiation, and hybrid symmetric encryption (AES-256-CBC for control messages, ChaCha20 for chat content). Built on Cloudflare Workers with Durable Objects and WebSocket, the system requires no database storage, supports anonymous communication, and provides forward secrecy. All encryption occurs client-side using Web Cryptography API, with room passwords as key derivation factors. The open-source implementation is verifiable through browser developer tools and network traffic analysis.

metadata.name: langextract
metadata.description: A Python library for extracting structured information from unstructured text using LLMs with precise source grounding and interactive visualization.

summary.zh: LangExtract是Google开源的Python库，基于LLM实现非结构化文本的结构化信息抽取。核心亮点：精确溯源定位、支持长文档并行处理、交互式HTML可视化、兼容云/本地模型，通过few-shot示例定义领域任务，无需微调即可适配临床笔记、报告等多场景。
summary.en: LangExtract is Google's open-source Python library for structured information extraction from unstructured text using LLMs. Key features: precise source grounding, long document optimization via parallel processing, interactive HTML visualization, flexible cloud/local model support, and domain adaptation through few-shot examples without fine-tuning.

metadata.name: playwright-mcp
metadata.description: Playwright MCP server

summary.zh: Playwright MCP是微软推出的Model Context Protocol服务器，通过Playwright可访问性树为LLM提供浏览器自动化能力。它摒弃截图方案，采用结构化快照实现确定性操作，适用于探索性测试、自愈脚本和长周期自治工作流。相比CLI工具，MCP模式更适合需要持久状态和深度页面推理的智能体场景。
summary.en: Playwright MCP is a Microsoft Model Context Protocol server that enables LLMs to automate browsers through Playwright's accessibility tree. It replaces screenshot-based approaches with structured snapshots for deterministic, vision-free interactions. Designed for exploratory automation, self-healing tests, and persistent autonomous workflows, it maintains continuous browser context at the cost of higher token usage. The server integrates seamlessly with MCP-compatible clients including VS Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Windsurf, providing a lightweight yet powerful bridge between language models and web automation with rich introspection capabilities.

metadata.name: skills
metadata.description: The open agent skills tool - npx skills

summary.zh: Vercel开源的AI智能体技能管理工具，支持54+主流编码助手。通过CLI一键安装GitHub/GitLab/本地技能包，支持项目级与全局部署，可精准指定目标智能体与技能，提供交互式与CI/CD友好模式。
summary.en: Vercel's CLI for AI agent skills. Installs prompts across 54+ coding assistants from GitHub/GitLab/local. Supports project/global scope & CI/CD.

metadata.name: llm_wiki
metadata.description: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。

summary.zh: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，采用增量编译模式构建自组织知识库，颠覆传统RAG每次查询重检索的机制。核心亮点包括：双阶段思维链文档摄入、多模态图像理解、四信号知识图谱、Louvain社区发现，以及本地API支持AI智能体调用。实现文档自动结构化为可追溯、可探索的互联知识网络。
summary.en: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop app that incrementally builds a persistent, self-organizing knowledge base from documents—compiling knowledge once instead of re-deriving on every query like traditional RAG. Key features include two-step Chain-of-Thought ingestion, multimodal image understanding, 4-signal knowledge graph, Louvain community detection, and local API for AI agent integration. Automatically transforms documents into interconnected, explorable knowledge networks with source traceability.

metadata.name: audiblez
metadata.description: Generate audiobooks from e-books

summary.zh: audiblez 利用 Kokoro-82M 高质量语音合成模型，将 EPUB 电子书自动转换为 M4B 有声书。支持中英法等9种语言，提供命令行与图形界面，跨平台运行。GPU 加速下5分钟完成《动物农场》转换，是个人制作无障碍阅读内容的理想工具。
summary.en: Audiblez converts EPUB e-books to M4B audiobooks using Kokoro-82M TTS model. Supporting 9 languages including Chinese and English, it offers CLI/GUI interfaces with cross-platform compatibility. With GPU acceleration, it processes 160K characters in 5 minutes, ideal for creating accessible content.

metadata.name: obscura
metadata.description: The headless browser for AI agents and web scraping

summary.zh: Obscura是用Rust编写的轻量级无头浏览器，专为AI智能体和网页爬虫设计。它内置V8引擎执行真实JavaScript，支持Chrome DevTools Protocol，完全兼容Puppeteer/Playwright API。相比Chrome，内存占用仅30MB（降低85%），启动瞬时，内置反检测功能，是自动化任务的理想选择。
summary.en: Obscura is a lightweight headless browser engine written in Rust, purpose-built for AI agents and large-scale web scraping applications.
