It executes real JavaScript through the V8 engine, fully supports Chrome DevTools Protocol, and serves as a drop-in replacement for both Puppeteer and Playwright. Compared to traditional headless Chrome, Obscura reduces memory usage by 85% to just 30MB, achieves instant startup, and features built-in anti-detection mechanisms. This combination of performance, compatibility, and stealth makes it ideal for scalable browser automation tasks.

metadata.name: free-coding-models
metadata.description: Find, benchmark and install in CLI 170+ FREE coding LLM models across 15+ providers in real time

summary.zh: 该工具解决了开发者在170+免费AI编程模型中选择的难题。它能实时并行测试15+提供商的模型，通过智能算法计算稳定性分数（综合p95延迟、抖动、峰值率和正常运行时间），并将最优模型一键集成到各种AI编程工具中，让开发者从选择到编码只需不到10秒。
summary.en: This powerful CLI tool solves developers' biggest pain point when using free AI coding models: uncertainty about which model is fastest and most stable at any given moment. It continuously benchmarks approximately 170 free or free-limited coding LLMs across 15 trusted providers in real-time, calculating a comprehensive Stability Score that evaluates p95 latency (30%), jitter/variance (30%), spike rate (20%), and uptime (20%). Once you select a model, it instantly configures your preferred AI coding environment—whether it's Continue, Cline, OpenHands, Aider, or dozens of others—getting you from question to coding in under 10 seconds.

metadata.name: warp
metadata.description: Warp is an agentic development environment, born out of the terminal.

summary.zh: Warp 是一款诞生于终端的智能体开发环境，深度集成 AI 编码助手并支持 Claude Code 等第三方 CLI 智能体。其 Oz 系统可自动化处理开源项目的 issue 管理、PR 审查等协作流程，提供实时智能体会话追踪与贡献者仪表板。采用 AGPL 开源协议，重塑开发者与 AI 协同编程体验。
summary.en: Warp is an agentic development environment born from the terminal, deeply integrating AI coding assistants and supporting third-party CLI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Its proprietary Oz system automates open-source project workflows including issue triage, PR reviews, spec writing, and community management. The platform provides real-time agent session tracking via build.warp.dev and comprehensive contributor dashboards. With OpenAI as founding sponsor and GPT-powered agentic workflows, Warp redefines developer-AI collaboration under AGPL open-source licensing while offering an MIT-licensed UI framework.

metadata.name: FlowPilot
metadata.description: Chrome扩展：支持Codex(自动开通plus账号) / kiro 注册、验证码获取、CPA/sub回调验证与自动恢复

summary.zh: FlowPilot是专注于ChatGPT账号全生命周期管理的Chrome自动化插件。它实现从注册、验证码处理、Plus支付到平台接入的完整自动化链路，支持多邮箱方案和支付渠道，具备智能重试与批量执行能力。适用于AI账号规模化运营场景，可高效处理数百账号的自动化流程。
summary.en: FlowPilot is a specialized Chrome extension for automated lifecycle management of ChatGPT accounts. It orchestrates complete workflows from registration, CAPTCHA handling, Plus payment processing to platform integration. The tool supports multiple email providers, payment gateways, and verification services, featuring intelligent retry mechanisms and batch execution capabilities. Designed for large-scale AI account operations, it enables efficient management of hundreds of accounts with high success rates and comprehensive record tracking.

metadata.name: undetectable-fingerprint-browser
metadata.description: Free open-source Multilogin/Incogniton/Kameleo alternative for fingerprint spoofing (Canvas/WebGL/User-Agent). Perfect for Selenium/Playwright/Puppeteer automation, web scraping, social media bots, ads verification, and multi-accounting based on chromium. Avoid bans, bypass anti-bot systems, and prevent tracking with customizable stealth browsing

summary.zh: Undetectable Fingerprint Browser 是一款基于 Chromium 的开源反检测浏览器，提供全面的指纹欺骗能力，覆盖 Canvas、WebGL、字体等关键维度。其独家一致性分析引擎确保所有欺骗字段逻辑自洽，有效绕过反机器人系统。内置自动化模块完美兼容 Playwright/Puppeteer，适用于网络爬虫、社交媒体多账号运营及广告验证等场景，是 Multilogin 等商业方案的开源替代。
summary.en: Undetectable Fingerprint Browser is an open-source anti-detection browser built on Chromium that delivers comprehensive fingerprint spoofing for Canvas, WebGL, fonts, and more. Its exclusive consistency analysis engine ensures logical alignment across all spoofed fields to effectively bypass anti-bot systems. With built-in automation modules fully compatible with Playwright/Puppeteer, it's ideal for web scraping, social media multi-account management, and ad verification, offering a powerful free alternative to commercial solutions like Multilogin.

metadata.name: agent-skills
metadata.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

summary.zh: Agent Skills 是为AI编程智能体打造的生产级工程技能库，将高级工程师的软件开发流程、质量门禁和最佳实践编码为标准化工作流。提供7个生命周期命令（/spec、/plan、/build等）和23个结构化技能，涵盖设计、开发到部署全流程。基于Markdown的提示工程实现自动化，支持Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini等多平台，确保AI代理在编码各阶段遵循一致的质量标准。
summary.en: Agent Skills is a production-grade engineering skill pack for AI coding agents that codifies senior engineers' development workflows, quality gates, and best practices into standardized processes. It provides 7 lifecycle slash commands (/spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /code-simplify, /ship) and 23 structured skills covering the entire development lifecycle from design to production. Built on Markdown-based prompt engineering, it enables automated enforcement of code quality standards across platforms including Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and GitHub Copilot.

summary.zh: 这个Python工具用于自动化破解阿里云滑动验证码。核心价值：通过OpenCV图像识别精准定位缺口位置，结合Selenium浏览器自动化模拟人类滑动轨迹，有效绕过阿里云验证码防护。应用场景：网络爬虫数据采集、自动化测试。技术亮点：集成ddddocr识别、undetected-chromedriver防检测、人类行为模拟算法，支持跨平台运行。
summary.en: This Python tool automates bypassing Alibaba Cloud slider captchas. Its core value lies in using OpenCV for precise gap detection and Selenium for human-like drag simulation to effectively circumvent Aliyun captcha protection. It is ideal for web scraping data collection and automated testing scenarios. Key technical highlights include integration with ddddocr for recognition, undetected-chromedriver for anti-detection, sophisticated human behavior simulation algorithms, and full cross-platform compatibility across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

metadata.name: docker-android
metadata.description: 🤖 A minimal and customizable Docker image running the Android emulator as a service.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供基于Alpine的最小化Docker镜像，用于将Android模拟器作为服务运行。支持KVM硬件加速和GPU加速（CUDA），可自定义Android版本与设备类型，内置ADB端口转发，兼容scrcpy远程控屏。专为CI/CD农场设计，提供无头运行模式，镜像体积可压缩至138MB（不含SDK），适用于自动化测试与远程Android开发场景。
summary.en: Repository provides a minimal Alpine-based Docker image that runs Android emulator as a service. Features KVM hardware acceleration and GPU support (CUDA), customizable Android versions/device types, built-in ADB port forwarding, and scrcpy compatibility for remote screen control. Designed for headless CI/CD farms, the image can be compressed to 138MB (SDK-free variant). Ideal for automated testing and remote Android development with optimized performance and network accessibility.

metadata.name: omi
metadata.description: AI that sees your screen, listens to your conversations and tells you what to do

summary.zh: Omi是开源的AI第二大脑，实时捕捉屏幕与对话内容，自动生成转录、摘要及行动项。跨平台支持macOS、iOS、Android及可穿戴设备，采用Swift/Rust/Flutter技术栈，集成Deepgram语音识别与LLM大模型，构建具备长期记忆的智能助手，已获30万+专业人士信赖。
summary.en: Omi is an open-source AI second brain that captures screen content and conversations in real-time, automatically generating transcripts, summaries, and action items. Built with Swift/Rust/Flutter for cross-platform support across desktop, mobile, and wearables, it integrates Deepgram speech recognition and LLMs to create a memory-capable AI assistant. The system processes audio via GPU-accelerated VAD and diarization, storing data in Firestore with Redis caching. Trusted by 300,000+ professionals, it offers a chat interface that remembers all user interactions.

metadata.name: AI-Video-Transcriber
metadata.description: Transcribe and summarize videos and podcasts using AI. Open-source, multi-platform, and supports multiple languages.

summary.zh: 开源AI视频转写工具，支持YouTube、TikTok、Bilibili等30+平台及本地音视频文件。采用字幕优先架构，无字幕时调用Faster-Whisper实现高精度语音识别，经AI优化后生成多语言摘要。支持任意OpenAI兼容API，Docker部署，适合内容创作者与研究者快速提取视频核心内容。
summary.en: An open-source AI-powered video and podcast transcription tool supporting 30+ platforms including YouTube, TikTok, and Bilibili, plus local audio/video file uploads. Its subtitle-first architecture extracts native subtitles instantly when available, using Faster-Whisper as fallback for high-accuracy speech recognition. The tool leverages any OpenAI-compatible API for intelligent text optimization, typo correction, and multi-language summarization. Built with FFmpeg for media processing and Docker support, it's ideal for content creators, researchers, and educators to efficiently convert multimedia content into structured, searchable text with AI-enhanced summaries.

metadata.name: ai-browser
metadata.description: 🤖 An AI-powered desktop automation agent built with Electron &   Next.js - Control your computer like manus, but as a native   desktop app, an ai browser!

summary.zh: 基于Electron与Next.js的AI桌面自动化浏览器，实现类Manus的计算机控制。核心特性：双模式交互（ChatAgent轻量对话/Deep Explore多智能体工作流）、多模态任务执行、可视化定时调度。支持DeepSeek/Qwen/Gemini等AI提供商，集成Tavily/Serper搜索与MCP服务。采用React 19+Zustand架构，提供原生桌面体验，适用于智能办公、研究分析与自动化场景。
summary.en: An AI-powered desktop automation browser built with Electron and Next.js that enables Manus-like computer control through a native application. Key features include dual-mode interaction (ChatAgent for lightweight conversations vs. Deep Explore for multi-agent workflows), multi-modal task execution, and visual scheduling. Supports major AI providers (DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemini, Claude) with integrated search engines (Tavily/Serper) and MCP services. Built on React 19+Zustand architecture, it delivers native desktop experience for intelligent office work, research analysis, and automation scenarios.

metadata.name: browser-harness
metadata.description: Browser Harness | Self-healing harness that enables LLMs to complete any task.

summary.zh: Browser Harness 是一个自愈式浏览器控制框架，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直连真实浏览器，让 LLM 自主完成任意网页任务。其核心创新在于动态生成缺失的辅助代码并持续学习优化，每次运行都自我改进。提供可复用的领域技能系统，支持从 LinkedIn 营销到电商下单等复杂自动化场景，架构精简仅千行代码。
summary.en: Browser Harness is a self-healing browser automation framework that connects LLMs directly to real browsers via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Its core innovation lies in dynamically generating missing helper code during execution and continuously learning from each run. The framework features a reusable domain skills system for complex tasks like LinkedIn outreach and e-commerce ordering. With a minimal architecture of ~1k lines, it enables autonomous web task completion without predefined scripts, representing a new paradigm in LLM-driven browser automation.

metadata.name: GitHub-CodeWiki-Jumper
metadata.description: 一键从 GitHub 跳转到 CodeWiki & DeepWiki & Zread 的油猴脚本 |  A one-click Tampermonkey script for jumping from GitHub to CodeWiki & DeepWiki & Zread

summary.zh: 该油猴脚本为 GitHub 仓库页面添加一键跳转至 CodeWiki、DeepWiki 和 Zread 的快捷入口，无缝集成原生 UI。核心价值在于打通代码托管平台与 AI 增强的代码知识图谱服务，显著提升开发者查阅开源项目时的理解效率，无需手动复制链接即可获取智能生成的代码文档与架构分析。
summary.en: This Tampermonkey script adds one-click jump links to CodeWiki, DeepWiki, and Zread directly on GitHub repository pages. It seamlessly integrates with the native UI, bridging code hosting platforms with AI-powered code intelligence services. The tool dramatically improves developer productivity by enabling instant access to AI-generated documentation and architecture analysis without manual link copying.

metadata.name: Kami
metadata.description: 👩‍🚒 Good content deserves good paper.

summary.zh: Kami是AI文档生成的设计约束系统，解决AI输出布局混乱、设计平庸的核心痛点。内置10种专业模板（财报、简历、PPT、落地页等），通过统一约束语言确保视觉一致性。深度支持中英日CJK语言，专为Claude等AI Agent设计，开箱即用，轻量高效，让AI文档达到可交付品质。
summary.en: Kami is a design constraint system for AI-generated documents, addressing inconsistent layouts and generic designs in AI outputs. It provides 10 professional templates (equity reports, resumes, slides, portfolios, landing pages) with unified constraints for visual consistency. Built for AI agents like Claude Code, it offers first-class English/Chinese support and best-effort Japanese/CJK. The lightweight system integrates seamlessly, enabling agents to produce production-ready, polished documents directly.

metadata.name: 2fa
metadata.description: Two Factor Authentication

summary.zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers的全球加速网络，提供安全便捷的两步验证密钥管理服务。支持TOTP/HOTP自动生成、二维码扫描/图片识别添加、AES-256加密存储，兼容Google Authenticator等多平台导入导出，具备PWA离线使用与WebDAV/S3远程备份能力，适用于个人与企业多设备场景。
summary.en: A secure two-factor authentication (2FA) key management service leveraging Cloudflare Workers for global acceleration. Features include automatic TOTP/HOTP generation, QR code scanning/image recognition for key addition, AES-256 encryption, and seamless import/export from platforms like Google Authenticator. With PWA offline support and remote backup via WebDAV/S3/OneDrive/Google Drive, it provides a unified solution across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

metadata.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
metadata.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.

summary.zh: 本仓库提供CLAUDE.md配置文件，用于优化Claude Code的AI编程行为。基于Andrej Karpathy对LLM编码陷阱的观察，提炼出四条核心原则：思考后编码、优先简化、精准修改、目标驱动执行，解决错误假设、过度复杂化、随意修改无关代码等问题，显著提升AI生成代码的准确性和简洁性。
summary.en: This repo provides a CLAUDE.md config file to optimize Claude Code's AI coding behavior. Distilled from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls, it implements four core principles: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, and Goal-Driven Execution to address wrong assumptions, overcomplication, and unintended edits, enhancing code accuracy and conciseness.

metadata.name: waoowaoo
metadata.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.

summary.zh: waoowaoo是首家工业级全流程AI影视生产平台，通过AI Agent实现小说到视频的全自动改编。支持剧本分析、角色场景生成、分镜制作、AI配音等好莱坞标准工作流，基于Next.js全栈框架与Docker容器化部署，为短剧和漫画视频创作提供可控、高效的生产解决方案。
summary.en: waoowaoo is the industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film and video production. It automates the entire workflow from novel text to finished videos, featuring AI script analysis, character/scene generation, storyboard production, and multi-voice synthesis following Hollywood-standard pipelines. Built on Next.js 15 full-stack framework with Docker containerization, MySQL database, and Redis queue system, it delivers an industrial-grade solution for short drama and manga video creation, enabling scalable, efficient, and consistent content generation for professional creators.

metadata.name: Awesome-AI4Med
metadata.description: A curated list of medical LLMs, multimodal systems, datasets, benchmarks, and more. 🏥

summary.zh: 本仓库是医疗人工智能领域的系统化资源大全，全面涵盖医学大语言模型、多模态医疗系统、专业数据集与权威评测基准。通过自动化提取海量论文与开源项目中的前沿模型和数据集，提供清晰、结构化且易于导航的集合，帮助研究人员和开发者快速追踪领域进展、精准定位所需资源，显著加速医学AI领域的创新与应用落地。
summary.en: A curated repository systematically organizing medical AI research resources, including medical large language models, multimodal systems, specialized datasets, and evaluation benchmarks. Through automated extraction of trending models and datasets from extensive research papers and open-source projects, it provides a clean, structured, and easily navigable collection. This comprehensive resource helps researchers and developers quickly track field advancements, precisely locate relevant resources, and accelerate innovation in medical artificial intelligence applications, significantly reducing the time needed to discover and utilize state-of-the-art medical AI technologies.

metadata.name: Recordly
metadata.description: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux

summary.zh: Recordly 是一款开源跨平台的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为产品演示、教程视频等场景设计。其核心亮点在于自动化后期处理：智能缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头叠加和样式化边框，无需专业剪辑即可生成 polished 视频。采用原生捕获技术（ScreenCaptureKit/WGC）保证性能，支持扩展插件，实现录制到编辑的一体化工作流。
summary.en: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor designed for product demos, tutorials, and walkthroughs. It automates post-production with AI-powered zoom suggestions, cursor polish, dynamic webcam overlays, and styled frames—eliminating manual editing. Built on native capture backends (ScreenCaptureKit/WGC) for performance, it features an extensible plugin system and seamless record-to-edit workflow.

metadata.name: ECC
metadata.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

summary.zh: ECC 是一个 AI 智能体性能优化系统，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等 AI 编程助手设计。系统提供技能管理、内存优化、安全扫描和研究优先开发框架，支持跨 harness 架构。从 Anthropic hackathon 胜出，经过 10+ 个月实战验证，支持 12+ 语言生态，可显著提升 AI 编程效率和质量。
summary.en: ECC is a production-ready AI agent harness performance optimization system designed for Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants. It provides comprehensive capabilities including skills management, instincts, memory optimization, continuous learning, security scanning, and research-first development framework. Winner of Anthropic hackathon, battle-tested over 10+ months across 12+ language ecosystems with cross-harness architecture, dramatically improving AI coding efficiency and code quality.

metadata.name: grok2api
metadata.description: Grok2API 是一个基于 FastAPI 构建的 Grok 网关，支持将 Grok Web 能力以 OpenAI 兼容 API 的方式转换。

summary.zh: 基于 FastAPI 构建的 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持流式对话、函数工具调用及文生图/视频功能。提供多账号池管理、额度同步和 Anthropic 协议兼容，内置 Admin 后台与 Web Chat 界面，支持 Docker/Vercel 部署，实现企业级 AI 能力统一管理。
summary.en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based gateway that converts Grok Web capabilities into OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling seamless integration with existing LLM applications. It supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, function tool calls, and text/image-to-video generation. Key features include multi-account pool management, quota synchronization, Anthropic protocol compatibility, and local media caching. The solution provides a comprehensive Admin backend and Web UI for management, supporting Docker, Vercel, and Render deployment for unified enterprise AI infrastructure.

metadata.name: NotionNext
metadata.description: Turn your Notion workspace into a fast, customizable website. Built with Next.js + Notion API, with multi-platform deployment and no self-hosted server required.

summary.zh: NotionNext是基于Next.js与Notion API构建的高颜值静态博客系统，支持Vercel等多种部署方案，实现零服务器成本的网站搭建。专为创作者设计，可将Notion页面无缝转化为博客内容，提供主题定制、SEO优化及自动化部署能力，大幅降低技术门槛。
summary.en: NotionNext is a visually appealing static blog system built with Next.js and Notion API, supporting multiple deployment options like Vercel for zero-server website setup. Designed for creators, it seamlessly transforms Notion pages into blog content with theme customization, SEO optimization, and automated deployment, significantly lowering technical barriers.

metadata.name: design-patterns-for-humans
metadata.description: An ultra-simplified explanation to design patterns

summary.zh: 本项目以极简方式解释软件设计模式，涵盖创建型、结构型、行为型三大类23种模式。通过生活化类比和PHP代码示例，将抽象概念具象化，帮助开发者快速理解并应用。核心价值在于降低学习门槛，提供实用指南而非理论堆砌，适合编程初学者和需要复习的开发者。
summary.en: This project delivers ultra-simplified explanations of software design patterns, encompassing 23 fundamental patterns across creational, structural, and behavioral categories. Through intuitive real-world analogies and practical PHP code samples, it demystifies abstract concepts and makes them stick. The repository serves as an accessible learning resource that emphasizes practical application over theoretical complexity. Designed for programming beginners and experienced developers seeking quick reference, it provides clear guidelines for tackling recurring software design problems effectively.

metadata.name: real-random-taxfree-address
metadata.description: 地址生成器:Random US tax-free state address generator with real OSM/USPS data — map-verified on Google Maps, supports global countries (HK, India, RU, etc.), multi-language (ZH/EN/RU/ES/PT), pure frontend, no server storage.

summary.zh: 这是一个纯前端的地址生成器，基于真实OSM/USPS数据生成美国免税州及多国地址，支持多语言且无需后端存储。核心亮点在于生成的地址可通过Google Maps验证，提供灵活的配置接口与模块化设计，适用于测试数据生成和隐私敏感场景。
summary.en: A pure frontend address generator using real OSM/USPS data to create US tax-free state and global addresses. Features Google Maps-verifiable outputs, multilingual support, and zero server storage. Designed for test data generation with configurable data paths and modular architecture.

metadata.name: developer-roadmap
metadata.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.

summary.zh: 这是一个社区驱动的开发者学习路线图项目，提供前端、后端、DevOps、AI工程师、数据科学等30+技术方向的交互式可视化学习路径。用户可点击节点查看详细内容，涵盖从入门到进阶的完整技能体系，帮助开发者清晰规划职业发展和技术成长方向。
summary.en: This community-driven project offers interactive visual learning roadmaps for developers across 30+ technical domains including frontend, backend, DevOps, AI engineering, and data science. Users can click nodes to access detailed content, covering complete skill paths from beginner to advanced levels, helping developers clearly plan career development and technical growth.

metadata.name: ppf-contact-solver
metadata.description: A contact solver for physics-based simulations involving 👚 shells, 🪵 solids, 🪢 rods, 🧱 rigid bodies and ⏳ sand.

summary.zh: ZOZO开源的高性能GPU接触求解器，专为布料、固体和绳索的物理仿真设计。采用FEM有限元方法与符号力雅可比，支持超1.8亿接触点的大规模并行计算，实现无穿透的精确模拟。提供Blender插件、Docker部署和Python API，适用于时尚电商、游戏特效等场景，单精度GPU加速确保高效稳定。
summary.en: ZOZO's high-performance GPU contact solver for physics simulation of shells, solids and rods. Leveraging FEM with symbolic force jacobians, it handles over 180M contacts in parallel with penetration-free accuracy. Features Blender integration, Docker deployment and Python APIs, ideal for fashion e-commerce and visual effects. Single-precision GPU acceleration ensures efficiency.

metadata.name: CodeWhale
metadata.description: Open-source, community-driven agent harness

summary.zh: CodeWhale 是一款深度集成 DeepSeek 模型的终端编码代理，专为开源和开放权重模型设计。它提供模型自动路由、实时推理流式展示、1M token 上下文窗口及完整开发工具链（文件操作、Shell、Git、网页搜索等）。通过键盘驱动的 TUI 界面，开发者可在终端内高效完成代码生成、编辑与自动化任务，所有操作均设有人工审批门控确保可控性。
summary.en: CodeWhale is a DeepSeek-first terminal coding agent purpose-built for open-source and open-weight models. It delivers automatic model routing, real-time streaming of reasoning blocks, 1M-token context windows, and a full-stack toolkit covering file operations, shell execution, Git integration, and web search. The keyboard-driven TUI allows developers to generate, edit, and automate code directly in the terminal, with approval gates providing essential human oversight and control.

metadata.name: chatgpt2api
metadata.description: ChatGPT官网接口纯协议的逆向实现，支持GPT-Image-2模型、文本模型，兼容OpenAI接口协议，在线批量生图/编辑图，号池管理，支持可编辑PPT/PSD文件逆向，支持导入CPA、sub2api号池 、支持接入Cherry  Studio、New Api 等软件

summary.zh: 本项目逆向ChatGPT官网接口，实现OpenAI兼容的图片生成与编辑API，支持gpt-image-2等模型。提供账号池管理、Docker自托管及在线画图功能，兼容Cherry Studio，适用于个人图像服务。
summary.en: ChatGPT2API is a reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official interfaces, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs for image generation and editing using models like gpt-image-2. It features account pool management with automatic quota refresh, multiple import methods including CPA and sub2api, proxy support, and Docker self-hosting. Includes an online drawing workbench and compatibility with tools like Cherry Studio and New API. Ideal for personal, non-commercial image generation and editing services with sustained account usage.

metadata.name: context-mode
metadata.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and   enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.

summary.zh: Context Mode 是面向 AI 编码代理的上下文优化工具。作为 MCP 服务器，它通过沙箱工具输出实现 98% 上下文减少，支持 15 个平台集成。利用 SQLite 追踪会话并以 FTS5/BM25 检索关键信息，倡导代码执行范式处理数据。集成 Claude、Cursor 等 IDE，已获微软、谷歌团队采用。
summary.en: Context Mode optimizes context windows for AI coding agents as an MCP server. It sandboxes tool outputs for 98% reduction, e.g., 315KB to 5.4KB. SQLite with FTS5 and BM25 ensures session continuity by indexing and retrieving relevant events on compaction. 'Think in code' via ctx_* tools lets agents script data processing instead of loading raw data. Supports 15 platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot via plugins and hooks. Adopted by Microsoft, Google, Meta teams.

metadata.name: taste-skill
metadata.description: Taste-Skill - gives your AI good taste. stops the AI from generating boring, generic slop

summary.zh: Taste-Skill 是一个开源反“slop”前端框架，专为AI智能体设计。通过可移植的SKILL.md技能文件，指导Cursor、Claude Code、Codex等代理生成优质界面，强化布局、排版、动效与间距，避免通用模板。该仓库提供多种风格技能（极简、粗犷等）、redesign审计、图像到代码流程，以及网页/移动端/品牌套件图像生成技能。支持npx skills add安装、可调设计参数（方差、动效、密度），兼容多框架与AI工具，助力打造高端非模板化前端。
summary.en: Taste-Skill is an open-source anti-slop frontend framework for AI agents. It provides portable SKILL.md files that guide coding agents like Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex to generate premium interfaces with refined layout, typography, motion, and spacing instead of generic boilerplate. The repo includes style-specific skills, redesign audits, image-to-code pipelines, and image-generation skills for web/mobile/brand reference boards. Installable via npx skills add with adjustable dials (variance, motion, density), it works across frameworks and AI tools to deliver high-quality, non-templated frontends.

metadata.name: namidb
metadata.description: Graph database native to the cloud. Embedded, multi-tenant, built on object storage.

summary.zh: NamiDB是一款基于对象存储的云原生图数据库引擎。它将节点和边以列式文件形式存于S3等桶中，桶为唯一真相源，支持Cypher查询。引擎支持嵌入式（如DuckDB）、HTTP服务器或云托管三种模式，利用S3条件写入实现多租户零协调架构。专为AI智能体构建知识图谱设计，成本可归零、备份简单，填补Kùzu归档后的空白。
summary.en: NamiDB is a cloud-native graph database built on object storage. It persists nodes and edges as columnar files in S3 buckets, with the bucket as the single source of truth. It supports Cypher queries and runs embedded like DuckDB, as an HTTP server, or in hosted cloud using the same engine. S3 conditional writes enable multi-tenancy without consensus layers. Ideal for AI agents needing knowledge graphs, it offers zero-cost scaling and simple S3 backups. It fills the gap after Kùzu's archiving.

metadata.name: seedance2-skill
metadata.description: skill to create best prompts for generating videos with seedance2.0

summary.zh: 该GitHub仓库提供针对字节跳动Seedance 2.0多模态AI视频生成模型的提示词撰写技能，专为Claude等AI智能体设计。核心包括输入约束、@引用语法、镜头语言、提示结构模式及多场景模板，覆盖广告、戏剧、MV和教育内容。基于官方文档，助力用户通过结构化提示工程高效生成高质量视频提示，提升AI视频创作的专业水平与效率。
summary.en: This repository provides specialized skills for AI agents to craft optimal prompts for ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 multimodal video generation model. It covers input constraints, @ reference syntax, camera language, prompt structures, and ready-to-use templates for ads, dramas, MVs, and educational content. Based on official docs, it enables efficient high-quality prompt engineering in tools like Claude Code and Cursor, boosting video output across creative and commercial scenarios.

summary.zh: Grok2API 基于 FastAPI 构建 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持聊天补全、图像编辑、视频生成及 Anthropic 接口。核心亮点包括多账号池管理、流式输出、工具调用、本地缓存与自动维护。提供 Docker 一键部署（含防 Cloudflare 方案）、内置 Admin 后台与 WebUI，适用于 AI 应用集成与多模态内容生成。
summary.en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based Grok gateway exposing web capabilities via OpenAI-compatible APIs for chat, image editing, video generation, and Anthropic endpoints. Key highlights: multi-account pooling, streaming, tool calling, local caching, auto-maintenance. Offers Docker deployment with anti-CF options, admin panel, and WebUIs. Ideal for AI app integration and multimodal tasks.

metadata.name: OpenKB
metadata.description: OpenKB: Open LLM Knowledge Base

summary.zh: OpenKB是开源CLI的LLM知识库系统，通过编译文档构建结构化wiki，支持PageIndex无向量长文档检索与推理。知识一次性持久化积累，自动生成摘要、概念页与交叉引用，优于传统RAG每次重算。兼容多LLM、多模态输入及Skill Factory蒸馏专家技能。适用于知识管理、学术研究与智能体构建场景。
summary.en: OpenKB is an open-source CLI system that uses LLMs to compile raw documents into a structured, interlinked wiki-style knowledge base. Powered by PageIndex for vectorless long-document retrieval and reasoning, it compiles knowledge once into a persistent wiki with automatic summaries, concepts, and cross-references—unlike traditional RAG. Supports multi-LLM via LiteLLM, multi-modality, query/chat, and Skill Factory for portable expert skills. Ideal for knowledge management, research, and AI agent development.

metadata.name: GlobalTraveling
metadata.description: 基于 LSPosed 框架的 Android 系统级虚拟定位与环境伪装模块。Fakelocation module based on LSPosed which is available to GMS.

summary.zh: Shadow是一款基于LSPosed框架的Android系统级虚拟定位与环境伪装模块。通过底层Hook系统服务与高德/腾讯地图SDK，实现GPS、基站、Wi-Fi的全维度位置模拟及指纹伪造，支持防跳回与GMS兼容。核心价值在于比传统Mock Location更强的隐蔽性，适用于隐私保护、应用测试与位置模拟场景，技术亮点为系统层劫持与随机环境生成。
summary.en: Shadow is an LSPosed-based Android module for system-level virtual location and environment spoofing. It hooks system services and map SDKs (Gaode/Tencent) to fake GPS, cell info, and Wi-Fi lists with anti-rebound features and GMS compatibility. Core value lies in superior stealth over traditional mock location via low-level file interactions. Ideal for privacy protection and app testing, with highlights in system-layer hooking and random fingerprint generation.

metadata.name: Hide-My-Applist
metadata.description: An Xposed module to intercept applist detections

summary.zh: Hide My Applist是一款Xposed模块，用于拦截应用列表检测并隐藏指定应用或拒绝查询请求。核心在于保护root Android设备隐私，防止root工具被检测及列表用于指纹识别。提供测试功能验证效果，利用Xposed hook实现精准拦截。
summary.en: Hide My Applist is an Xposed module designed to intercept application list detections on Android devices. It hides specific apps or rejects app list requests to prevent the detection of root-related applications, such as Fake Location, thereby avoiding exposure of rooted status. It also protects against apps collecting app lists for fingerprinting or malicious purposes. Ideal for rooted Android users, it offers various hiding methods and testing tools to verify effectiveness. The technical highlight lies in its use of Xposed hooking mechanisms for precise interception and enhanced privacy protection.

metadata.name: hermes-proficiencies
metadata.description: Hermes Agent proficiencies: shareable operating-attribute skills for human SOPs/playbooks, agent skill/tool-SOP building, safe publishing, and tidy workspace hygiene.

summary.zh: 该仓库为Hermes AI代理提供可共享熟练度技能，聚焦操作纪律。核心包括人类SOP与playbook创建、代理技能与工具SOP构建（含契约与防护）、安全发布审查及工作区卫生管理。强调运行时行为、审查循环和制品区分，提升代理在真实压力下的可靠性和安全性，避免数据泄露与文件混乱。适用于AI代理开发与自动化场景。
summary.en: Hermes Proficiencies is a collection of shareable skills designed for the Hermes AI agent to instill operational discipline. It includes proficiencies for crafting human-facing SOPs and playbooks, building agent skills and Tool SOPs with invocation contracts and guardrails, conducting thorough publishing reviews to prevent private data leaks, and enforcing workspace hygiene to keep files organized. These skills promote runtime behavior, review loops, and clear distinctions between human and agent artifacts, making the agent more reliable, safe, and effective in real-world development and automation scenarios.

metadata.name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
metadata.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.

summary.zh: 《AI工程从零开始》是开源AI工程课程，含473课、20阶段、约320小时。从数学基础到多智能体系统与生产，覆盖Python等多语言。核心是每算法从原始数学手工构建，再用框架对比，每课产出提示、技能、代理或MCP服务器等可复用产物。填补工具使用与专业准备差距，帮助深入掌握AI internals，免费MIT许可，配网站与技能集成，适合开发者实战学习与构建系统。
summary.en: AI Engineering from Scratch is a comprehensive open-source curriculum with 473 lessons across 20 phases (~320 hours). It spans math foundations to deep learning, transformers, LLMs built from scratch, agent engineering, multi-agent swarms, production, and ethics. Learners implement algorithms from raw math in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia before frameworks. Every lesson ships reusable artifacts: prompts, skills, agents, MCP servers. Emphasizes deep understanding over API calls. Free MIT license with website and agent skills for personalized paths.

summary.zh: Obsidian Digital Garden 插件将 Obsidian 知识库转化为精美数字花园网站。支持选择性发布（仅 dg-publish: true 笔记公开），保护隐私。全面兼容 Dataview、Canvas、Excalidraw、Mermaid 等功能，提供搜索、图谱、反向链接导航及主题/CSS 定制。基于 Eleventy 静态生成，通过 Vercel/Netlify 一键部署或 Forestry 托管，实现零成本、完全可控的知识分享与持续迭代。
summary.en: The Obsidian Digital Garden plugin transforms Obsidian vaults into beautiful, customizable digital garden websites. It enables selective publishing via 'dg-publish: true' frontmatter for privacy control. It supports extensive Obsidian features including Dataview queries, Canvas, Excalidraw, Mermaid diagrams, plus advanced navigation like search, graphs, and backlinks. Customization includes themes, CSS variables, and custom components. Powered by Eleventy for static sites, it offers seamless deployment to Vercel/Netlify or managed hosting via Forestry.md, giving users full ownership of their evolving knowledge base.

metadata.name: SkillOpt
metadata.description: SkillOpt is a text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents through trajectory-driven edits, validation-gated updates, and deployable best_skill.md artifacts.

summary.zh: SkillOpt是微软的文本空间优化器，为冻结LLM代理训练可复用自然语言技能。通过轨迹驱动编辑、验证门控更新，模拟神经网络训练（epochs、mini-batch、学习率），不修改模型权重，输出best_skill.md。支持SearchQA、ALFWorld等多基准，适用于自进化代理技能场景。技术亮点包括轨迹分析、迭代优化与可复用部署。
summary.en: SkillOpt is a Microsoft text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents. It uses trajectory-driven edits, reflection, bounded updates, and held-out validation gates, mirroring neural network training with epochs, minibatches, learning rates, and gates—but entirely in text space without weight changes. It produces deployable best_skill.md artifacts and shows strong gains across benchmarks like SearchQA, ALFWorld, DocVQA, and others. Ideal for self-evolving, transferable agent skills in QA, tool-use, math, and embodied tasks.

metadata.name: gsd-core
metadata.description: Git. Ship. Done - Core

summary.zh: GSD-Core是轻量级元提示与上下文工程系统，专为Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码工具设计。通过六命令循环（初始化、讨论、规划、并行执行、验证、交付）解决上下文腐烂，实现规范驱动开发。支持跨平台npm安装，生成原子提交与干净Git历史，适用于独立开发者和小团队。已获亚马逊、谷歌等工程师信赖，是AI辅助可靠交付的执行框架。
summary.en: GSD-Core is a lightweight meta-prompting, context engineering, and spec-driven development system for AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more. It solves context rot with a six-command loop: initialize or map codebases, discuss phases, plan with verification, execute in parallel sub-agents using fresh contexts, verify, and ship with clean Git history. Ideal for solo builders and small teams. Cross-platform via npm, trusted by engineers at Amazon, Google, Shopify, and Webflow.

metadata.name: PDFMathTranslate-next
metadata.description: PDF scientific paper translation with preserved formats - 基于 AI 完整保留排版的 PDF 文档全文双语翻译，支持 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等服务，提供 CLI/GUI/Docker

summary.zh: PDFMathTranslate-next是一款基于AI的PDF科学论文翻译工具，能完整保留原文排版、公式、图表及注释，支持Google、DeepL、Ollama、OpenAI等多种翻译服务。提供CLI、GUI和Docker三种部署方式，适用于学术研究者进行双语对照阅读与分析。依托BabelDOC框架实现高保真格式翻译，显著提升科研效率。
summary.en: PDFMathTranslate-next is an AI-powered tool for translating scientific PDF papers while fully preserving layout, formulas, charts, and annotations. It supports multiple services including Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI, offering CLI, GUI, and Docker interfaces. Ideal for researchers to read and analyze academic documents bilingually. Built on BabelDOC for high-fidelity format retention, boosting research efficiency.

metadata.name: BabelDOC
metadata.description: Yet Another Document Translator

summary.zh: BabelDOC 是 PDF 科学论文翻译与双语对照库。它基于大语言模型实现高质量翻译，同时精准保留 PDF 布局、公式和表格。提供 CLI、Python API 和在线服务，支持嵌入其他程序或自部署。适用于学术研究者翻译外文论文，集成 Zotero 等工具。核心亮点包括布局分析、术语提取和复杂文档兼容处理。
summary.en: BabelDOC is a specialized library for translating PDF scientific papers with bilingual comparison. It uses large language models for high-quality translations while precisely preserving original PDF layout, formulas, and tables. It provides CLI, Python API, and online services for embedding into applications or self-deployment. Ideal for academic researchers translating papers, with Zotero integrations. Key highlights include layout analysis, term extraction, and robust format handling.

metadata.name: engineering-handbook
metadata.description: Open-source High-Level System Design and Data Structure & Algorithm handbook. CC BY-SA 4.0, Free Forever.

summary.zh: handbook-academy/engineering-handbook 是开源工程手册仓库，包含两本CC BY-SA 4.0免费手册。HLD手册159章、719 Mermaid图、3100+引用，系统覆盖高阶系统设计、分布式系统与基础设施（从TCP/IP到LLM服务）；DSA手册120章、226图、多语言LeetCode解法，专注数据结构算法与面试实践。内容规模相当于数千页教科书，提供系统化深度学习与职业准备资源。
summary.en: The handbook-academy/engineering-handbook repository hosts two sibling open-source engineering handbooks under CC BY-SA 4.0. The HLD Handbook delivers 159 chapters on high-level system design, distributed systems, and modern infrastructure with 719 Mermaid diagrams and 3,100+ citations. The DSA Handbook covers 120 chapters of data structures and algorithms, including multi-language LeetCode solutions and interactive widgets. Together they provide massive, free curricula equivalent to thousands of pages for deep engineering learning and interview preparation.

summary.zh: 暂无描述。

metadata.name: science-skills
metadata.description: GDM Science Skills to speed up agentic scientific workflows with better grounding and higher token efficiency. Integrate insights from AlphaGenome, AFDB, UniProt and 30+ other databases and tools.

summary.zh: google-deepmind/science-skills 是 Google DeepMind 推出的科学技能集合，旨在加速 AI 智能体的科学工作流。它集成 AlphaGenome、AFDB、UniProt 等 30+ 数据库和工具，提供结构化指令、脚本资源，提升事实 grounding 和 token 效率。技能 spanning 基因组学、结构生物学、化学信息学及文献检索等领域，与 Google Antigravity 深度集成，助力高效科研任务。
summary.en: The google-deepmind/science-skills repo delivers a bundle of agent skills from Google DeepMind to enhance scientific workflows for AI agents. It integrates over 30 databases and tools like AlphaGenome, AFDB, and UniProt, offering structured instructions and scripts for better grounding and token efficiency. Covering genomics, structural biology, cheminformatics, and literature search, these skills are optimized for the Google Antigravity platform, improving reliability and enabling efficient scientific automation.

summary.zh: EdgeTunnel (Refactored) 是 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级隧道代理工具，支持 VLESS 和 Trojan 协议。模块化 ESM 架构支持 Wrangler 部署、KV 配置与订阅生成。核心价值为工程化 Serverless 代理方案，易扩展二次开发。适用于网络代理与边缘计算场景，性能依托全球边缘网络。
summary.en: EdgeTunnel (Refactored) is a lightweight tunnel proxy tool on Cloudflare Workers supporting VLESS and Trojan protocols. It uses a modular ESM architecture for easy Wrangler CLI deployment, local debugging, and Git version control. Configuration is managed via Cloudflare KV, with automatic subscription link generation for clients like Clash and Sing-box. The core value is an engineering-friendly, extensible Serverless proxy solution ideal for developers to learn Worker development and WebSocket communication. It leverages global edge network for performance in secure tunneling and proxy scenarios.

metadata.name: obsidian-second-brain
metadata.description: Cross-CLI skill for Obsidian: turn your vault into a living AI-first second brain across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Hermes, and Pi. 44 commands - self-rewriting notes, local+hybrid semantic search, key-less web research, /obsidian-architect codebase docs, and scheduled agents that maintain the vault while you sleep.

summary.zh: obsidian-second-brain 将 Obsidian vault 转变为跨 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 和 OpenCode 四 CLI 的活 AI 第二大脑。43 命令实现笔记自重写、自动知识合成、实时网络/X/YouTube 研究、/obsidian-architect 代码文档化、Google Calendar 集成及反幻觉机制。基于 Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式，vault 自我更新并调和矛盾，助力构建不断进化的个人知识系统。
summary.en: obsidian-second-brain transforms your Obsidian vault into a living AI-first second brain across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. With 43 commands, it delivers self-rewriting notes that update existing pages and auto-reconcile contradictions, following Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Features include live research from web/X/YouTube, /obsidian-architect for codebase docs, keyless research, Google Calendar integration, scheduled agents, role presets, and anti-hallucination tools, enabling autonomous knowledge compounding.

metadata.name: reg-factory
metadata.description: gmail注册

summary.zh: reg-factory 是一套全自动注册流水线：批量自注册 Outlook 邮箱，再用同一邮箱在 ChatGPT/Grok/Claude 上注册账号并导出直登 Cookie。核心采用比特浏览器实现指纹隔离、Clash Verge 代理节点切换绕过区域与 Cloudflare 限制，结合接码打码服务完成验证。基于 Python + Playwright 构建，适用于 AI 服务批量测试与账号管理场景。
summary.en: reg-factory is a fully automated registration pipeline: batch self-register Outlook emails, then use them to create accounts on ChatGPT/Grok/Claude and export direct-login cookies. It uses BitBrowser for fingerprint isolation, Clash Verge for proxy switching to bypass geo-blocks and Cloudflare, plus SMS/captcha services. Built on Python + Playwright, ideal for bulk AI service testing and account management.

metadata.name: book-to-skill
metadata.description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.

summary.zh: 该工具将技术书籍PDF等文档转化为Claude Code技能。通过生成SKILL.md、章节文件、术语表、模式和速查表，实现无幻觉的精准引用与学习。按需加载章节优化资源。应用场景包括技术学习、工作参考和知识管理。技术亮点是多格式支持和结构化知识集成到AI工作流。
summary.en: book-to-skill transforms technical books and documents such as PDFs and EPUBs into structured Claude Code skills. It creates a SKILL.md with core mental models and chapter index, plus on-demand chapter files, glossary, patterns, and cheatsheet. This setup allows accurate, hallucination-free referencing and studying directly in Claude workflows. Ideal for technical professionals who want to retain and apply book knowledge on the job without searching PDFs or relying on potentially inaccurate AI responses. Key advantages include support for various formats, efficient token management via lazy loading, and seamless integration as a custom skill.

metadata.name: scientific-agents
metadata.description: Expert-thinking AGENTS.md profiles that teach AI agents to reason like senior scientists and engineers.

summary.zh: 该仓库收集503个专家级AGENTS.md配置文件，针对物理、生物、化学、工程等科学与工程领域，教导AI代理像资深从业者一样框架问题、选用工具数据库、评估证据、排查故障模式并规范报告。基于领域深度研究构建，采用开放AGENTS.md标准，兼容Cursor、Claude Code、OpenAI Codex等工具。核心价值是将通用AI转变为领域专精AI科学家，提升科研准确性与专业性，适用于数据分析、实验设计、方法起草和同行评审等场景。
summary.en: This repository curates 503 expert AGENTS.md profiles for scientific and engineering professions, teaching AI agents to reason like senior practitioners by encoding domain-specific problem framing, tool and database selection, evidence evaluation, failure mode detection, and reporting standards. Research-grounded and built to pass field-expert validation, they leverage the open AGENTS.md standard for seamless integration with Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other tools. The core value lies in transforming generalist AI into specialized AI scientists, enhancing precision in research workflows across physics, biology, chemistry, medicine, and engineering.

metadata.name: workout-cool
metadata.description: 🏋 Modern open-source fitness coaching platform. Create workout plans, track progress, and access a comprehensive exercise database.

summary.zh: Workout.cool 是一个现代开源健身教练平台，支持创建个性化训练计划、追踪健身进度，并提供包含详细说明与视频演示的全面运动数据库。基于 Next.js 16、Prisma ORM 和 Feature-Sliced Design 架构构建，具备 Docker 自托管、多语言支持及 Stripe 集成，旨在为健身开源社区提供可靠、可维护的自托管解决方案。
summary.en: Workout.cool is a modern open-source fitness coaching platform for creating personalized workout plans, tracking progress, and accessing a comprehensive exercise database with detailed instructions and video demos. Built on Next.js 16, Prisma ORM, and Feature-Sliced Design architecture, it supports Docker self-hosting, i18n, and Stripe integration, reviving reliable tools for the fitness open-source community.

metadata.name: web-to-app
metadata.description: A native Android application that converts any website URL into a standalone Android App.

summary.zh: WebToApp是一款原生Android应用，支持将网站URL、HTML项目或服务器端应用（如Node.js、PHP、Python、Go、WordPress）一键转换为可安装APK，完全在设备上完成构建、签名与安装。无需PC、IDE或远程服务器。亮点包括双WebView引擎（系统+ GeckoView）、本地服务器运行时、Chrome MV3扩展支持、28向量指纹伪装、AI编码代理及GitHub模块市场。适用于移动Web转App、快速原型开发、无PC场景及隐私增强应用生成。
summary.en: WebToApp is a native Android app that converts any website URL, HTML projects, or server-side apps (Node.js, PHP, Python, Go, WordPress) into standalone installable APKs entirely on-device. No PC, IDE, or build servers needed. Key features include dual browser engines (WebView + GeckoView), local server runtimes, Chrome MV3 extension support, 28-vector fingerprint spoofing, an AI coding agent for app/module generation, a GitHub-backed module market, and APK modification tools. Ideal for mobile web-to-app conversion, rapid prototyping, running web/server apps on Android, and privacy-focused custom apps.

summary.zh: VoHive是面向EC20 4G模组的代理管理平台，支持短信收发、多卡eSIM管理、网卡绑定代理、多Bot控制及VoWiFi功能。支持一键安装与Docker部署，兼容ModemManager。适用于多模组代理与短信服务场景，亮点是设备绑定代理与运维自动化。
summary.en: VoHive is an integrated management and proxy platform for Quectel EC20 4G modules. It enables SMS sending and receiving via web or bots, multi-SIM card management, eSIM profile add/switch/delete, SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies strongly bound to device network cards, remote control using Telegram, Feishu or QQ bots, and VoWiFi activation with simulated outgoing calls. The platform supports easy one-click installation on Linux or Docker deployment and is compatible with ModemManager. It is suitable for scenarios involving multiple modems for SMS services and proxy pools. Its technical highlight lies in hardware-level device binding for proxies and automation in operations.

metadata.name: TencentDB-Agent-Memory
metadata.description: TencentDB Agent Memory delivers fully local long-term memory for AI Agents via a 4-tier progressive pipeline, with zero external API dependencies.

summary.zh: TencentDB Agent Memory 为 AI Agent 提供完全本地的长期记忆解决方案，采用 4 层渐进式管道（L0 Conversation→L1 Atom→L2 Scenario→L3 Persona）实现符号化短期记忆与分层长期记忆。拒绝平铺向量存储，通过 Mermaid 符号图与异构存储（DB+Markdown）实现渐进披露与全 traceable 召回。集成 OpenClaw/Hermes 后，Token 消耗最高降 61.38%，任务通过率相对提升 51.52%，PersonaMem 准确率从 48% 升至 76%。适用于长程 Agent 任务与个性化体验，零外部 API 依赖。
summary.en: TencentDB Agent Memory delivers fully local long-term memory for AI Agents via a 4-tier progressive pipeline (L0 Conversation → L1 Atom → L2 Scenario → L3 Persona), combining symbolic short-term memory with layered long-term memory. It rejects flat vector storage, using Mermaid symbol graphs and heterogeneous storage (DB + Markdown) for progressive disclosure and full traceability. When integrated with OpenClaw/Hermes, it cuts token usage by up to 61.38%, boosts task success by up to 51.52% relatively, and raises PersonaMem accuracy from 48% to 76%. Ideal for long-horizon agent tasks and personalization, with zero external API dependencies.

summary.zh: Sprite Lab是一款纯浏览器端工具，专为图像背景去除与精灵图自动切割设计。无需上传或AI模型，利用Canvas API实现多通道alpha抠图消除边缘光晕，并通过连通像素扫描智能检测帧。支持动画预览、帧排除及ZIP导出（含manifest），全部本地处理，保障隐私与离线可用。适用于2D游戏开发和动画资产准备。
summary.en: Sprite Lab is a fully client-side web tool for automatic background removal and spritesheet slicing. Using only the HTML Canvas API, it detects backdrops like green screens or checkerboards and applies multi-pass alpha matting to eliminate edge halos. Connected pixel analysis enables intelligent frame detection without grids. Features include animation previews, frame exclusion, and ZIP exports with manifests. Everything runs locally with no uploads, AI, or servers—ideal for 2D game asset preparation.

metadata.name: QMAI
metadata.description: 青幕AI写作软件，解决长篇小说写作问题，解决小说角色性格不统一，防止人设崩坏。

summary.zh: 青幕AI写作（QMAI）是长篇小说记忆型AI写作桌面系统。核心通过章节摄取、混合检索引擎与角色认知系统构建记忆，灵魂文档统一风格，多维审查确保质量。适用于网文作者，解决人设崩坏与遗忘问题，支持本地跨平台存储。
summary.en: QMAI is a memory-based AI desktop writing system for long novels. It features chapter ingestion, hybrid retrieval, and context assembly for persistent memory. Role soul system ensures style consistency and tracks character cognition, with multi-dimensional reviews to prevent collapse. Ideal for web novel authors to solve forgetting and inconsistency issues, with local cross-platform storage.

metadata.name: learn-world-model
metadata.description: Learn everything about world model

summary.zh: 本GitHub仓库是Datawhale的《Learn World Models》开源课程，系统介绍世界模型从直觉到构建的全流程。包括历史演进、VAE编码、RSSM动态、架构对比、规划算法及评估指标等内容，并提供VAE训练、RSSM构建、Dreamer智能体等实践项目。强调动手实现模拟、规划与评估系统，适合AI智能体开发者和强化学习研究者学习。
summary.en: This Datawhale GitHub repository presents the 'Learn World Models' course, offering a structured path from intuition to implementation of world models in AI. It covers historical evolution, VAE encoding, RSSM dynamics, architecture patterns, planning algorithms, and evaluation metrics. Five lectures and five projects enable building VAE encoders, RSSM models, Dreamer agents, and evaluation dashboards. The highlight is combining theory with hands-on practice for simulation, planning, and assessment systems, ideal for AI agent developers and reinforcement learning researchers.

summary.zh: Modern Web Guidance 是 Google Chrome 团队支持的 AI 编码代理技能，提供 SKILL.md 文件与 CLI 工具，将现代 Web 平台专家知识、最佳实践和 API 模式直接注入 AI 代理上下文。帮助代理采用高性能、可访问、安全的原生 API 替代过时方案，覆盖 102 项现代特性及 128 个真实用例，支持 Cursor、Claude 等工具集成，提升 Web 应用开发质量与效率。
summary.en: Modern Web Guidance, supported by the Google Chrome team, is an agent skill (SKILL.md) with a CLI that injects web platform expertise, best practices, and modern API patterns into AI coding agents. It guides agents to use high-performance, accessible, and secure native APIs instead of legacy patterns, covering 102 modern features and 128 real-world use cases across UX, CSS, performance, accessibility, and built-in AI. It integrates with tools like Cursor, Claude, and Gemini for better web development.

metadata.name: weread-exporter
metadata.description: 微信读书全本导出工具 — Playwright + Canvas Hook 提取完整书籍内容为 Markdown

summary.zh: 微信读书全本导出工具，通过Playwright自动化浏览器并Hook Canvas fillText方法，拦截渲染文本，结合y坐标拆分双页内容，按坐标重建段落并清理格式，导出为Markdown。适用于个人学习研究，需有效微信读书账号权限。技术亮点包括持久化登录、双页处理及文本重建，支持章节独立输出与元数据保存，解决网页版无法直接复制的问题。
summary.en: weread-exporter exports complete WeRead books to Markdown by using Playwright to automate Chromium and hooking CanvasRenderingContext2D.fillText to capture canvas-rendered text. It splits double-page renders via y-coordinate detection, reconstructs paragraphs from (x,y) coordinates, and cleans formatting. Designed for personal study with valid account access, it features persistent QR login, per-chapter Markdown files, metadata JSON, and optional raw data. Addresses web version copy restrictions with ~20-30s per chapter speed.

metadata.name: genomi
metadata.description: Local-first, open-source Claude Science alternative, before Claude Science is a thing. Turn your AI agent into personal DNA expert.

summary.zh: Genomi 是开源 AI 代理运行时，将 AI 代理转变为个人 DNA 专家。它提供本地私有工作空间，包括 Active Genome Index 存储变异数据、公共遗传证据查询、探索记忆和报告工具，实现证据支持的 DNA 问题解答。基因组数据完全本地保留，支持 MCP 兼容主机如 Claude，解析原始 DNA 文件，回答健康风险、药物反应、遗传特征等问题，并随研究自更新。保障隐私的个性化基因组分析。
summary.en: Genomi is an open-source AI agent runtime that turns your AI agent into a personal DNA expert. It provides a private local workspace with an Active Genome Index for variants, public genetics evidence queries, exploration memory, and report tools for evidence-backed answers. Genome data stays on-device. Compatible with MCP hosts like Claude, it parses raw DNA files, enables local querying on health risks, medication responses and traits, and self-updates with latest research for secure, personalized genomic insights.

metadata.name: Sing-box
metadata.description: 既然来了，就留下你的Star吧！Serv00 | CT8 | Hostuno | VPS | 游戏机 | sing-box(reality + hy2 + vmess-argo +tuic5)四合一无交互一键安装脚本(已适配Alpine)，支持纯V6 vps，丰富的分流服务, 可添加anytls,socks5,ss-2022等协议

summary.zh: sing-box多协议代理一键安装脚本，支持VLESS-reality、VMess-ws-tls(Argo)、Hysteria2、Tuic5等协议，适配VPS、Serv00、CT8、Alpine等环境。集成哪吒探针、Argo隧道与订阅管理，提供无交互部署、端口自定义与分流服务，适合快速搭建代理节点与网络加速场景。
summary.en: One-click installation script for sing-box multi-protocol proxy, supporting VLESS-reality, VMess-ws-tls (Argo), Hysteria2, Tuic5. Compatible with VPS, Serv00, CT8, Alpine and more. Integrates Nezha monitoring, Argo tunnels and subscription features for automated deployment, custom ports and traffic routing in proxy and acceleration use cases.

metadata.name: aimili-vpngate
metadata.description: aimili-vpngate是一个借助vpngate.net让Linux用干净ip出站的代理工具。

summary.zh: AimiliVPN是基于VPNGate开放协议的纯Python零依赖VPN代理网关。专为Linux VPS设计，内置响应式Web管理界面，支持智能并发测速、多路由模式（自动漂移、固定国家/IP）和本地SOCKS5/HTTP代理服务。一键部署实现干净IP出站，适用于科学上网、脚本代理及自动化任务。核心亮点包括实时日志、系统诊断和零外部依赖。
summary.en: AimiliVPN is a pure Python, zero-dependency VPN proxy gateway based on the official VPNGate protocol. Designed for Linux VPS, it features a responsive web management interface, intelligent concurrent speed testing, multiple routing modes (smart auto-failover, fixed country or IP), and local SOCKS5/HTTP proxy. One-click deployment enables clean IP outbound for scientific internet access and script proxying. Highlights include real-time logs, system diagnostics, and no external dependencies.

summary.zh: 这是一个专为128MB以上低内存服务器设计的Sing-box代理部署工具，基于Node.js实现自动化管理。精简保留TUIC、Hysteria2和VLESS+XTLS+Reality三种协议，支持UUID与Reality密钥自动生成持久化、每日00:03定时重启清除缓存、TCP/UDP端口共用及订阅链接自动生成。简化部署流程，适合个人在资源受限VPS上快速搭建高性能代理节点，提升稳定性和易用性。
summary.en: A lightweight Sing-box multi-protocol proxy deployment tool optimized for low-memory servers (128MB+ RAM). Powered by Node.js for automation, it supports TUIC, Hysteria2, and VLESS+XTLS+Reality protocols with auto-generated persistent UUIDs and Reality keys, daily scheduled restarts at 00:03 Beijing time for cache clearing, TCP/UDP port sharing, and automatic subscription link generation. Simplifies setup on resource-constrained VPS for reliable personal proxy nodes.

metadata.name: agent-orchestrator
metadata.description: Agentic orchestrator for parallel coding agents — plans tasks, spawns agents, and autonomously handles CI    fixes, merge conflicts, and code reviews.

summary.zh: Agent Orchestrator 是并行 AI 编码代理的编排层。它规划任务并生成代理，每个代理在独立 Git 工作树中运行，拥有专用分支和 PR。代理可自主修复 CI 失败、解决合并冲突和处理代码审查。支持 Claude Code、Codex、Aider 等 AI 代理，tmux、Docker 等运行时，以及 GitHub、Linear 等跟踪器。CLI 工具实现跨平台部署，助力大规模开发自动化与自改进 AI 系统。
summary.en: Agent Orchestrator acts as the orchestration layer for parallel AI coding agents. It plans tasks and spawns agents, each operating in its own git worktree with a dedicated branch and PR. The agents autonomously handle CI fixes, merge conflicts, and code reviews. It supports various AI agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Aider, multiple runtimes like tmux and Docker, and trackers such as GitHub and Linear. The CLI tool facilitates cross-platform use for automated large-scale development and self-improving AI systems.

summary.zh: Isoflow 是基于 React 的开源网络图绘制组件，提供拖放编辑器、可扩展图标系统（支持 AWS/Azure 等云插件）和代码/图片导出功能。作为 MIT 许可的开源核心项目，社区版适用于 IT 基础设施可视化、云架构设计与网络拓扑规划场景。技术亮点在于灵活的插件机制与 React 组件的易集成性，助力快速构建专业网络文档。
summary.en: Isoflow is an open-source React component for drawing network diagrams. It features a drag-and-drop editor, extensible icon system with plugins for AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and export options to code or images. As an MIT-licensed open-core project, the Community Edition is ideal for architecture visualization, infrastructure planning, and network topology scenarios. Highlights include plugin extensibility and seamless React integration.

metadata.name: brooks-lint
metadata.description: AI code reviews grounded in 12 classic engineering books — decay risk diagnostics with book citations, severity labels, and 6 analysis modes including full-sweep auto-fix

summary.zh: brooks-lint是一款基于《人月神话》等12本经典工程书籍的AI代码审查工具。它诊断代码中的6种衰退风险，输出带书籍引用、严重性标签和修复建议的结构化发现。支持PR审查、架构审计、技术债务评估、测试套件审查及全扫自动修复等6种模式。作为Claude Code插件和Codex CLI技能集成，提供一致、可追溯的代码质量评估。适用于软件开发团队提升可维护性、降低技术债务，超越传统linter和纯AI审查。
summary.en: brooks-lint is an AI-powered code review tool grounded in twelve classic engineering books including The Mythical Man-Month and Refactoring. It diagnoses code across six decay risks such as Cognitive Overload and Change Propagation, producing structured findings with book citations, severity labels, and actionable remedies. Featuring six analysis modes including PR reviews, architecture audits, tech debt assessments, test suite reviews, and full-sweep auto-fix, it integrates as a Claude Code plugin and Codex CLI skill. This delivers consistent, traceable code quality insights superior to plain LLMs or traditional linters, ideal for software teams improving maintainability and reducing technical debt.

metadata.name: supervision
metadata.description: We write your reusable computer vision tools. 💜

summary.zh: Supervision 是 Roboflow 的开源 Python 计算机视觉库，专注提供可复用 CV 工具。它通过 Detections 对象实现多模型输出统一处理，支持标注可视化、跟踪计数、数据集管理和基准测试。模型无关设计集成主流框架，亮点在于高度可定制工具与高效数据流程，适用于实时视频分析与应用开发场景。
summary.en: Supervision is Roboflow's open-source Python library for computer vision, providing reusable tools for building CV applications. It features a unified Detections object for integrating outputs from models like Ultralytics and Transformers, along with customizable annotators, object tracking, zone counting, dataset conversion between YOLO/COCO/Pascal VOC, and performance benchmarking. Model-agnostic by design, it emphasizes efficient post-processing and cross-framework compatibility, enabling developers to focus on real-time video analysis and application development.

metadata.name: ni-mail
metadata.description: 极简 Cloudflare Worker，接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取

summary.zh: ni-mail 是一个极简 Cloudflare Worker，通过 Email Routing 接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取。使用 KV 存储最多 50 封邮件，postal-mime 解析为结构化 JSON，支持 API Key 鉴权和多自定义域名，附件仅存 metadata。无需数据库、前端或 JWT，部署简单，适合自动化脚本获取邮件内容，实现轻量级邮件集成。
summary.en: ni-mail is a minimalist Cloudflare Worker that receives private domain emails via Cloudflare Email Routing and exposes them through a simple HTTP API. It stores up to 50 emails in KV, parses them with postal-mime into structured JSON, supports API key auth and multiple custom domains, and keeps only attachment metadata. No database, frontend or JWT needed; ideal for automation scripts fetching emails in a lightweight, serverless setup.

metadata.name: supercookie
metadata.description: ⚠️ Browser fingerprinting via favicon!

summary.zh: Supercookie 通过 favicon 缓存机制实现浏览器持久指纹追踪，为访客分配独特且难以清除的 ID。该 ID 在隐身模式、清除缓存、重启系统或使用 VPN/AdBlocker 后仍有效。项目仅用于教育演示，旨在揭示 favicon 跟踪的隐私风险。技术亮点包括跨会话持久性、实时 API 演示及 Node.js/Docker 部署，适用于隐私安全研究与开发者警示。
summary.en: Supercookie demonstrates persistent browser fingerprinting via favicon caching, assigning unique, hard-to-clear IDs to visitors. The ID survives incognito mode, cache clears, browser restarts, VPNs, and ad blockers. Built for educational purposes only, it highlights privacy risks from favicon tracking. Key features include cross-session persistence, live demo APIs, and easy deployment with Node.js and Docker, ideal for security research and awareness.

metadata.name: swot
metadata.description: Identify email addresses or domains names that belong to colleges or universities. Help automate the process of approving or rejecting academic discounts.

summary.zh: JetBrains/swot 仓库维护全球教育机构邮箱域名列表，用于自动验证学生和教师身份并授予 JetBrains 工具免费许可证。核心价值是简化学术折扣审批流程，支持全球高校用户获取专业开发工具。应用场景覆盖学生免费授权与教育机构验证。技术亮点包括层级目录结构存储域名、子域名自动包含、滥用域名黑名单及严格准入规则，确保数据准确可靠。
summary.en: JetBrains/swot maintains a hierarchical list of academic email domains to verify eligibility and grant free JetBrains tool licenses to students and teachers worldwide. Core value lies in automating academic discount approvals for global educational users. Application scenarios include student/teacher license verification. Technical highlights feature structured directory storage, subdomain inclusion, abused domain blacklist, and strict inclusion criteria for authenticity.

metadata.name: whichllm
metadata.description: Find the local LLM that actually runs and performs best on your hardware. Ranked by real, recency-aware benchmarks, not parameter count. One command, run it instantly.

summary.zh: whichllm 是一款命令行工具，自动检测 GPU/CPU/RAM，从 Hugging Face 筛选适配模型，基于 LiveBench、Chatbot Arena 等真实多源基准进行 recency-aware 排名，而非参数量或 VRAM 简单匹配。支持 GPU 模拟、升级对比、模型规划、聊天启动及 JSON 输出，一条 uvx 命令即可运行。核心价值是证据驱动的本地 LLM 推荐，帮助用户在硬件限制下选出性能最优模型。
summary.en: whichllm is a CLI tool that auto-detects hardware (GPU/CPU/RAM) and ranks the best-fitting local LLMs from Hugging Face using aggregated real-world benchmarks like LiveBench and Chatbot Arena, with recency awareness rather than size or VRAM heuristics. It supports GPU simulation, upgrade comparisons, model planning, chat launching, and JSON output. Run instantly via one uvx command. Delivers evidence-graded recommendations for optimal performance on specific hardware.

metadata.name: Understand-Anything
metadata.description: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.

summary.zh: Understand Anything 通过多智能体流水线分析代码库，结合 Tree-sitter 结构解析与 LLM 语义理解，构建文件、函数、类及依赖的交互式知识图谱。支持结构视图与业务领域视图切换，提供语义搜索、引导游览、影响分析和多语言支持。兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 编码工具，帮助开发者快速掌握大型代码库架构与业务逻辑，加速 onboarding 与代码探索。
summary.en: Understand Anything uses a multi-agent pipeline combining tree-sitter parsing and LLMs to turn any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph of files, functions, classes, and dependencies. It offers structural and business domain views, semantic search, guided tours, and impact analysis. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and more, it helps developers quickly understand complex projects, aiding onboarding and AI-assisted coding.

metadata.name: design.md
metadata.description: A format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents. DESIGN.md gives agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system.

summary.zh: DESIGN.md 是 Google Labs 开源的视觉身份描述格式规范，专为编码代理设计。通过 YAML 前置元数据定义设计令牌（颜色、排版、间距等），结合 Markdown 散文阐述设计理念，提供持久结构化的设计系统理解。核心价值确保 AI 生成 UI 的一致性与准确性。适用于 AI 辅助前端开发、设计系统跨工具迁移场景。技术亮点融合机器可读令牌与人类可读说明，支持 lint 校验 WCAG 对比、版本 diff 等工具。
summary.en: DESIGN.md is a Google Labs open-sourced format specification for describing visual identities to coding agents. It combines YAML front matter for machine-readable design tokens (colors, typography, spacing) with Markdown prose explaining the rationale. This provides agents with a persistent, structured understanding of design systems for consistent UI generation. Ideal for AI-assisted frontend development and design system portability. Key highlights include WCAG contrast linting, version diffing, token references, and the hybrid machine-human readable format.

metadata.name: Clone-Wars
metadata.description: 100+ open-source clones of popular sites like Airbnb, Amazon, Instagram, Netflix, Tiktok, Spotify, Whatsapp, Youtube etc. See source code, demo links, tech stack, github stars.

summary.zh: Clone Wars是一个GitHub开源仓库，收录100多个流行网站和应用的开源克隆与替代项目，包括Airbnb、Instagram、Netflix、Spotify等。提供源码、演示链接、技术栈及星标数据，专为学习设计。分带教程的克隆表和普通克隆/替代表，展示React、Next.js、Firebase、Django等多种技术栈。核心价值是curated学习资源，帮助开发者通过实际项目掌握全栈开发、构建作品集并探索开源替代方案。
summary.en: Clone Wars is a curated GitHub repository featuring 100+ open-source clones and alternatives to popular sites like Airbnb, Instagram, Netflix, and Spotify. It includes source code links, demos, tech stacks, and star counts for learning web development. Divided into a tutorials table for guided full-stack projects and a clones/alternatives table distinguishing UI clones from functional alternatives. Showcasing technologies such as React, Next.js, Firebase, and more, it enables developers to explore implementations of popular features, enhance skills through practical examples, and find open-source substitutes. Perfect for self-learners and portfolio building.

metadata.name: better-icons
metadata.description: Skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving icons

summary.zh: Better Icons 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的 MCP 服务器和 CLI 工具，支持从 150 多个图标集合中搜索检索 20 万以上图标。它帮助 Cursor、Claude 等 AI 编码代理准确获取图标 SVG，避免 token 浪费和样式不一致，支持多框架导出、项目文件同步、自动学习用户偏好及批量/相似图标检索，有效提升 AI 辅助开发效率。
summary.en: Better Icons is a specialized MCP server and CLI tool for AI agents, enabling search and retrieval of over 200,000 icons from 150+ collections. It assists coding assistants like Cursor and Claude in accurately fetching icons and SVGs, avoiding token waste on inline code. Key capabilities include auto-learning preferences, direct project file syncing, batch retrieval, cross-collection similar icons, and exports for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid plus raw SVG.

metadata.name: TranslateBooksWithLLMs
metadata.description: Translate full-length books and documents with Ollama, OpenAI (comptatible), Gemini, Mistral, Poe or OpenRouter. Preserves formatting. Resumes where you left off. No file size limits.

summary.zh: 该桌面应用利用Ollama、OpenAI、Gemini等LLM翻译书籍、字幕和文档，支持EPUB、SRT、DOCX、TXT格式。智能分块处理任意长度文件，严格保留格式、样式与结构，支持断点续传。提供本地隐私部署与云端API选项，跨平台易用，适合长篇内容多语言处理与本地化场景。
summary.en: TranslateBooksWithLLMs is a cross-platform desktop app that leverages LLMs like local Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini and others to translate full-length books, subtitles and documents. It supports EPUB, SRT, DOCX and TXT formats with perfect preservation of structure and styling, uses intelligent chunking for unlimited file sizes while maintaining context, and features automatic checkpoints for resuming translations. Offers both offline local processing and cloud APIs via a simple local web interface.

metadata.name: nodejs-argo
metadata.description: nodejs-argo是一个强大的Argo隧道部署工具，专为PaaS平台和游戏玩具平台设计。它支持多种代理协议（VLESS、VMess、Trojan等），并集成了哪吒探针功能

summary.zh: nodejs-argo是一个专为PaaS平台和游戏玩具平台设计的Argo隧道代理部署工具，支持VLESS、VMess、Trojan等多种协议，并集成哪吒探针功能。基于Node.js实现，支持环境变量配置的固定/临时隧道、订阅生成及自动保活，适用于个人代理节点搭建。核心亮点包括多协议兼容、哪吒监控集成及npm模块化部署。
summary.en: nodejs-argo is a powerful Argo tunnel deployment tool designed for PaaS and game toy platforms. It supports multiple proxy protocols including VLESS, VMess, and Trojan, with integrated Nezha probe functionality. Built on Node.js, it enables easy configuration via environment variables for fixed or temporary tunnels, subscription generation, and auto keep-alive, ideal for personal proxy node setup on cloud platforms. Key highlights include multi-protocol support, Nezha monitoring, and npm package deployment.

summary.zh: AetherGate Pro 是企业级高可用 VPN 与代理网关管理工具，专为 Linux VPS 设计。通过网络命名空间（netns）隔离技术，避免主机接口污染和 SSH 断连问题。支持单端口混合 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理，自动抓取 VPNGate 节点并过滤欺诈风险，配备玻璃拟态仪表盘与自愈看门狗，实现稳定可靠的代理服务，适用于代理网络工程师构建企业级网关。
summary.en: AetherGate Pro is an enterprise-grade, high-availability VPN and proxy gateway manager for Linux VPS. It uses network namespace (netns) isolation to eliminate SSH disconnections and routing conflicts on the host. It features a single-port mixed SOCKS5/HTTP proxy, auto VPNGate scraping with fraud filtering, a glassmorphic dashboard, and self-healing watchdog for seamless, reliable proxy services tailored for network engineers.

metadata.name: quant-mind
metadata.description: QuantMind is an intelligent knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance.

summary.zh: QuantMind是面向量化金融的智能知识提取与检索框架，将论文、新闻、报告等非结构化内容转化为语义知识图谱。采用两阶段架构：提取阶段通过多模态解析、领域特定LLM和智能代理实现结构化、标签化与去重；检索阶段支持嵌入向量、RAG、多跳推理等场景。适用于对冲基金、机构投资者快速探索因子策略与市场洞见，提升研究效率并挖掘Alpha。获NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop接受。
summary.en: QuantMind is an intelligent knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance. It transforms unstructured content such as papers, news, reports, and SEC filings into a semantic knowledge graph. Built on a decoupled two-stage architecture, the extraction stage uses multi-modal parsing, domain-specific LLMs, tagging, and agentic workflows for structuring and deduplication; the retrieval stage enables embeddings, RAG, DeepResearch multi-hop reasoning, and knowledge-aware generation. Ideal for hedge funds and research teams to accelerate factor and risk model discovery. Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop.

metadata.name: Telegram-Drive
metadata.description: Turn your Telegram account into an unlimited, secure cloud storage drive. an Open-source desktop app built with Tauri, Rust, and React.

summary.zh: Telegram Drive是一款开源跨平台桌面应用，利用Telegram API将账号转化为无限安全的云存储驱动。基于Tauri、Rust和React构建，提供熟悉的文件资源管理器界面，支持Saved Messages和Channels作为文件夹。核心亮点包括高性能虚拟滚动、媒体流式播放、内置PDF查看器、拖放上传、密码保护分享链接、本地REST API支持AI集成、代理及VPN优化。隐私优先，数据与密钥本地存储，无第三方服务器。兼容Windows、macOS、Linux及Android平台。
summary.en: Telegram Drive is an open-source cross-platform desktop app that turns your Telegram account into unlimited, secure cloud storage. Built with Tauri, Rust, and React, it provides a familiar file explorer using Saved Messages and Channels as folders. Highlights include high-performance virtual scrolling, media streaming, built-in PDF viewer, drag-and-drop, password-protected shareable links, local REST API for AI integration, proxy/VPN optimization, and privacy focus with all data local and no third-party servers. Supports Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.

metadata.name: AI-Visual-Prompt-Cookbook
metadata.description: Curated collection of reusable JSON prompt templates & style references for AI image generation. Updated daily.

summary.zh: 该仓库精选68个可复用的JSON提示模板库，专为AI图像生成提供结构化视觉风格参考。每个style.json封装提示模板、变量、风格锚点与示例，支持ChatGPT、Claude等LLM即插即用，实现一致、可迭代的图像输出。涵盖涂鸦、海报、拼贴、编辑等类别，解决一次性文本提示难以复用的问题。每日更新，附预览与目录，适合设计师与内容创作者构建专业视觉工作流。
summary.en: This repo curates 68 reusable JSON prompt templates for consistent AI image generation. Each style.json packages visual design references into structured prompts with variables, fidelity anchors, and examples for plug-and-play use in LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude. It solves inconsistent one-off prompts by enabling repeatable styles across doodle, poster, collage, editorial, and travel themes. Updated daily with previews and catalog; ideal for designers seeking reliable, high-quality visual outputs in multimodal workflows.

metadata.name: drawio-skill
metadata.description: Generate draw.io diagrams from natural language — 6 presets, vision self-check + up to 5-round refinement, codebase-to-diagram, 10,000+ official shapes & 321 AI/LLM brand logos. Exports PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG.

summary.zh: drawio-skill 是一款 AI 驱动的技能，将自然语言描述转化为专业的 draw.io 图表。它支持 6 种预设类型（ERD、UML、序列、架构、ML/深度学习、流程图）、代码库（Python/JS/Go/Rust）结构可视化、10,000+ 官方形状搜索及 321 个 AI/LLM 品牌 logo。集成视觉自检与最多 5 轮迭代精炼，自动修复布局问题，支持 PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG 导出。与 Claude、Cursor 等多种 AI 代理兼容，适用于软件架构设计、代码可视化及系统文档生成场景。
summary.en: drawio-skill is an AI agent skill that converts natural language into professional draw.io diagrams. It offers 6 presets (ERD, UML, Sequence, Architecture, ML/Deep Learning, Flowchart), codebase visualization for Python/JS/Go/Rust via Graphviz auto-layout, search across 10,000+ official shapes, and 321 AI/LLM logos. Features vision self-check with up to 5 rounds of refinement, auto-fixes layout issues, and exports to PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor and other agents, ideal for architecture design, code analysis, and LLM app documentation.

metadata.name: NLPBook
metadata.description: A comprehensive book on neural networks and large language models in NLP

summary.zh: NiuTrans/NLPBook仓库发布《Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models》一书，由童晓、朱靖波撰写。系统覆盖机器学习与神经网络基础、词向量、RNN/CNN、Seq2Seq、Transformer，以及大模型的预训练、生成、提示工程、对齐与推理等前沿内容。提供各章节及完整免费PDF下载，基于arXiv论文扩展，适合NLP研究者、学生和开发者学习使用，并有中、日、法等多语言翻译版本。
summary.en: The NiuTrans/NLPBook repository presents the book 'Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models' by Tong Xiao and Jingbo Zhu. It comprehensively covers ML and neural network foundations, word vectors, RNN/CNN, Seq2Seq, Transformers, plus LLM topics including pre-training, generative models, prompting, alignment, and inference. Free PDF chapters and full book are available, expanded from arXiv papers. Ideal educational resource for NLP researchers, students, and practitioners, with translations into multiple languages.

metadata.name: sing-box
metadata.description: 最好用的 sing-box 一键安装脚本 & 管理脚本，自动创建 REALITY 协议；支持 TUIC，Trojan，Hysteria2 等所有常见的协议

summary.zh: 233boy/sing-box 是 sing-box 的最佳一键安装与管理脚本，支持 VLESS-REALITY 默认及 TUIC、Trojan、Hysteria2、Shadowsocks 等所有常见协议。核心价值在于高效自动化部署与管理：一键添加/更改配置、自动 TLS、多配置并行运行、零学习成本。适用于 Linux 服务器快速搭建安全代理服务，实现网络隐私保护与访问优化。技术亮点包括 BBR 启用、Caddy 伪装集成、兼容 sing-box 命令，设计强调高效率与极易用。
summary.en: The 233boy/sing-box repo offers the ultimate one-click installation and management script for sing-box. It supports VLESS-REALITY by default and all common protocols including TUIC, Trojan, Hysteria2, Shadowsocks 2022, and various WS/H2/QUIC variants with TLS. Core value is high-efficiency automation for multi-config operation, one-click protocol addition and config changes, auto TLS, and BBR activation. Ideal for quickly deploying secure proxy servers on Linux for privacy protection and network optimization. Highlights include zero learning curve, Caddy fake site integration, full sing-box command compatibility, and powerful shortcuts.

metadata.name: Introduction-to-Autonomous-Robots
metadata.description: Introduction to Autonomous Robots

summary.zh: 本仓库提供MIT出版社《自主机器人导论：机制、传感器、执行器与算法》教材的LaTeX源代码。该书聚焦自主机器人计算原理，涵盖机制、传感器、执行器和算法。采用CC-BY-NC-ND许可，允许非商业教学用途并需署名。可通过LaTeX或Overleaf编译PDF，印刷版见亚马逊。是机器人教育与研究的重要资源。
summary.en: The repository provides the LaTeX source for the MIT Press textbook 'Introduction to Autonomous Robots: Mechanisms, Sensors, Actuators, and Algorithms'. It focuses on the computational principles of autonomous robots, covering mechanisms, sensors, actuators, and algorithms. Licensed under CC-BY-NC-ND for non-commercial use like teaching with attribution. Users can compile the PDF via LaTeX or Overleaf; print edition available on Amazon. An essential resource for robotics education and research.

metadata.name: opendataloader-pdf
metadata.description: PDF Parser for AI-ready data. Automate PDF accessibility. Open-source.

summary.zh: OpenDataLoader PDF 是开源 PDF 解析器，专注 AI 就绪数据提取与 PDF 无障碍自动化。支持 PDF 转 Markdown、带边界框 JSON 和 HTML，基准测试整体准确率 0.907、表格 0.928 排名第一。采用确定性本地模式 + 混合 AI/OCR 模式，处理多栏、扫描文档、复杂表格。提供 Python/Node.js/Java SDK，首创开源端到端自动标记生成 Tagged PDF，支持 PDF/UA 合规。适用于 RAG/LLM 管道与无障碍合规场景。
summary.en: OpenDataLoader PDF is an open-source PDF parser focused on AI-ready data extraction and PDF accessibility automation. It converts PDFs to Markdown, JSON with bounding boxes, and HTML, ranking #1 in benchmarks with 0.907 overall and 0.928 table accuracy. Features deterministic local mode plus hybrid AI/OCR for multi-column layouts, scanned docs, and complex tables. Offers Python, Node.js, and Java SDKs; first open-source end-to-end auto-tagging to Tagged PDF for PDF/UA compliance. Ideal for RAG/LLM pipelines and accessibility remediation.

metadata.name: improve
metadata.description: Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute.

summary.zh: improve 是一个 AI 代理技能，利用最强模型深度审计任意代码库，生成自包含的 Markdown 实施计划供廉价模型执行。核心价值在于智能分工：高智能模型负责 Recon 映射仓库栈与规范、多类别并行审计、Vet vetting 与优先级排序，执行交由低成本模型。计划含验证门、硬边界、停止条件与漂移检测，支持分支审计、execute 审查、GitHub issues 集成及 reconcile 闭环。适用于代码优化、安全审计、性能提升与功能规划场景，提升多模型代理工作流效率。
summary.en: improve is an agent skill that uses the most capable models to audit any codebase and produce self-contained Markdown implementation plans for cheaper models to execute. Core value lies in intelligent division of labor: powerful models handle recon (mapping stack, conventions, verification commands), parallel multi-category audits (security, perf, tech debt, direction), vetting, and prioritization; execution is offloaded. Plans include verification gates, hard boundaries, STOP conditions, and drift checks. Supports focused/branch audits, isolated worktree execution with review, GitHub issue publishing, and reconciliation. Ideal for efficient codebase maintenance in multi-model AI agent ecosystems.

metadata.name: awesome-gpt-image-2
metadata.description: Prompt as Code | GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库，470+ 个案例逆向工程，20+ 套工业级模板，并提炼出Skills，持续更新中

summary.zh: 该仓库是GPT-Image2的Prompt as Code工业级提示词引擎与模板库，逆向工程506+案例，涵盖UI、Poster、产品等13类场景，提炼20+工业模板与Agent Skills。配套网站支持提示浏览、复制、筛选与测试生成，助力专业AI图像生成与自动化工作流，持续更新。
summary.en: The awesome-gpt-image-2 repository provides an industrial-grade Prompt as Code engine and template library for GPT-Image2. It features over 506 reverse-engineered cases across 13 categories including UI, posters, products, and photography, plus 20+ industrial templates and Agent Skills. A companion website enables browsing, copying prompts, filtering by style or scene, and testing generations. Designed for professional AI image generation, automation workflows, and agent integration with ongoing updates.

metadata.name: hyperagent-public-skills
metadata.description: Free skills from the Hyperagent team

summary.zh: Hyperagent团队的免费公开技能仓库，提供JSON格式的AI代理技能。涵盖粘土动画视频生成、品牌书制作、数据可视化、设计系统参考（如Muller-Brockmann）和商业模拟等场景。每个技能包含详细步骤、工具集成（Veo、Gemini、FFmpeg）和避坑指南，基于AI大模型实现复杂工作流。核心亮点是实战验证的提示工程与管道设计，确保高质量、一致性输出。适用于内容创作者和团队的自动化应用。
summary.en: The repository provides free skills from the Hyperagent team as JSON-defined AI agent skills for specialized workflows. Skills cover claymation podcast video generation, brand book creation, data visualization, design systems (e.g., Muller-Brockmann, Vignelli), and business simulations. Each includes detailed step-by-step instructions, integrations with AI models (Veo, Gemini), FFmpeg processing, transcription, and troubleshooting tips. Core value lies in battle-tested prompt engineering and robust multi-step pipelines for high-quality creative automation. Ideal for content creators and teams using AI agents.

summary.zh: AegisFlow 是本地运行的 GLM Coding 支付运营后台，支持多账号导入、套餐同步、腾讯验证码自动 OCR 识别与链路处理、预览下单签单生成二维码及定时任务启动。基于 FastAPI 后端与 Node.js 构建，集成内置 Python 代理池，实现全自动化支付流程，适合本地多账号管理和运营效率提升。
summary.en: AegisFlow is a locally running payment operations backend for GLM Coding, supporting multi-account import/sync, automatic Tencent captcha OCR recognition and processing chains, order preview/signing for QR code generation, and scheduled task launching. Built with FastAPI backend and Node.js, featuring built-in Python proxy pool for fully automated payment workflows, ideal for local multi-account management and operational efficiency.

metadata.name: en-zh-translation-polish
metadata.description: 英译汉翻译润色 · English→Chinese translate & polish skill (英中对照)

summary.zh: 该仓库是一个专为AI智能体打造的英译汉翻译润色skill，基于叶子南翻译理论工程化7阶段流水线（文本定档、脱壳重构、病症诊断、音韵打磨、标点规范等）。核心价值在于消除翻译腔、按软硬文本调节归化尺度，默认产出逐段英中对照，并内置参考表与自动化脚本。适用于科技、法律、文学等多类专业文本的高质量翻译与润色任务。
summary.en: This repository provides an AI agent skill for polished English-to-Chinese translation. It engineers advanced translation theory into a structured 7-stage pipeline focused on eliminating translationese, adapting domestication to text type (hard/soft), and defaulting to bilingual对照 outputs. Includes diagnostic reference tables, rhythm polishing, and punctuation normalization scripts. Ideal for high-quality E2C tasks in technical, legal, literary, and general domains within agent workflows.

metadata.name: CORTEX-AI-SUPER-RAG
metadata.description: CORTEX RAG is an enterprise retrieval and knowledge assistant that helps teams find accurate answers from company data with citations, permission-aware retrieval, and fast deployment

summary.zh: Cortex RAG是一款完全本地的超级RAG系统。支持上传PDF/DOCX/TXT等文档，通过Streamlit界面提问，集成上下文检索、RAG-Fusion、GraphRAG、CRAG、神经重排序、HyDE等九大技术，结合BM25+FAISS+NetworkX知识图谱，实现精准检索、相关性验证、实时推理与来源引用。基于Ollama本地大模型，无需API密钥或云服务，配备语义缓存和多轮对话记忆，保障隐私。适用于敏感文档智能分析、离线知识库构建及个人问答场景。
summary.en: Cortex RAG is a fully local, privacy-first super RAG engine. Upload PDFs, DOCX or TXT files via Streamlit and ask questions. It integrates nine advanced techniques—Contextual Retrieval, RAG-Fusion with RRF, GraphRAG on NetworkX, Corrective RAG, Neural Reranking, HyDE, live reasoning streaming, semantic caching, and chat memory—plus hybrid search (BM25 + FAISS). Powered by Ollama local LLMs, it retrieves, cross-checks, reasons, and cites sources entirely on-device. No API keys, cloud uploads, or subscriptions.
