Ideal for secure document Q&A, offline knowledge bases, and sensitive data analysis.

metadata.name: chinese-traditional-patterns
metadata.description: 开源的中国传统纹样图录项目 · 100 高清纹样(规划 800) · 中英日韩双语 · CC BY-NC 4.0 · https://wenyang.net

summary.zh: 开源的中国传统纹样图鉴项目，收录100张高清原创PNG卡片图（规划800张），分为植物花卉、动物瑞兽、几何锦纹等六大类。每张配中英日韩双语名称、简介、文化寓意、视觉关键词及详细资料页，提供patterns.json与patterns.csv结构化数据集。配套静态网站wenyang.net支持浏览、检索、收藏与下载，采用CC BY-NC 4.0许可。核心价值是美术馆级审美与开放获取，服务设计师与文化爱好者的非商业创作、研究与教育。
summary.en: Open-source Chinese traditional patterns catalog with 100 high-res original PNG cards (planning 800), organized into six categories: flora, fauna, geometric, cloud-water-stone, auspicious objects, and characters. Each includes bilingual names, summaries, cultural meanings, keywords, and detailed pages, plus structured JSON/CSV datasets. Companion static site wenyang.net enables browsing, search, collection, and download under CC BY-NC 4.0. Emphasizes museum-quality aesthetics for non-commercial design, research, and cultural education.

metadata.name: LifeOS
metadata.description: An General Purpose AI Harness for magnifying human capabilities. [CODING, BUILDING, CREATING, BUSINESS, LIFE, WORK, ...]

summary.zh: danielmiessler/LifeOS（Personal_AI_Infrastructure/PAI）是开源Agentic AI基础设施，定位为Life Operating System。它以Claude为核心构建个性化数字助手，深度捕获用户Telos、目标、知识与偏好；采用文本/Markdown文件系统作为上下文（无RAG）、自定义七阶段Algorithm驱动当前到理想状态转变，并集成Pulse仪表盘、技能系统与自改进循环。基于TypeScript与Bun构建，强调人类优先与上下文支架，适用于个人生产力、目标管理与全生命周期优化。
summary.en: danielmiessler/LifeOS (Personal_AI_Infrastructure/PAI) is an open-source agentic AI infrastructure functioning as a Life Operating System. It builds a personalized Digital Assistant powered by Claude that deeply captures user Telos, goals, knowledge, and preferences. Key features include text/Markdown filesystem as context (no RAG), a custom 7-phase Algorithm for current-to-ideal state progression, Pulse dashboard, skills system, and self-improvement loops. Built with TypeScript and Bun on Claude Code, it prioritizes humans and context scaffolding for personal productivity, goal achievement, and holistic life optimization.

metadata.name: NoteDiscovery
metadata.description: Your Self-Hosted Knowledge Base

summary.zh: NoteDiscovery 是一款轻量级自托管笔记与知识库应用，强调数据隐私与所有权。采用纯 Markdown 文件存储，支持知识图谱可视化、LaTeX 数学、Mermaid 图表、内置绘图编辑器及插件扩展。通过 MCP 协议实现与 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 助手的深度集成，支持笔记搜索、创建与组织。提供美观响应式界面、可选认证和多语言支持，是 Notion、Obsidian 的免费开源替代方案，适合开发者、知识工作者及隐私敏感用户，Docker 一键部署，无订阅费用与厂商锁定。
summary.en: NoteDiscovery is a lightweight self-hosted note-taking and knowledge base application that empowers users with full control over their data. Notes are stored as plain Markdown files, featuring an elegant web UI with graph visualization, LaTeX/MathJax support, Mermaid diagrams, a drawing editor, and extensive customization via themes and plugins. It stands out with MCP integration for AI tools like Claude and Cursor, enabling direct note search, creation, and organization. Responsive across devices with optional auth and multi-language support, it serves as a free, open-source alternative to Notion or Obsidian for privacy-focused developers and knowledge workers, with effortless Docker deployment and zero subscriptions or lock-in.

metadata.name: headroom
metadata.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 60-95% fewer tokens, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.

summary.zh: Headroom 是 AI 智能体的上下文压缩层，能压缩工具输出、日志、RAG 块和文件，减少 60-95% 令牌并保持答案质量。提供 Python/TS 库、代理和 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude、Cursor 等集成。具备可逆 CCR 压缩、跨代理内存共享和失败学习等功能，支持 6 种算法，本地优先，显著提升 LLM 交互效率。
summary.en: Headroom acts as the context optimization layer for LLM applications and AI agents. It compresses tool outputs, logs, RAG chunks, files, DB results, and more before they reach the model, achieving 60-95% token reduction while preserving 100% answer accuracy. Deployable as a Python or TypeScript library, transparent proxy, MCP server, or integrations with LangChain, Agno, Vercel AI SDK, and 100+ LLM providers. Key highlights include reversible CCR compression, smart content detection across formats, persistent hierarchical memory, failure learning that updates agent docs, image compression via ML, cache optimization, and six specialized algorithms. Local-first and multi-agent compatible, it drastically cuts costs and latency for LLM interactions.

metadata.name: eSIM-Tools
metadata.description: 专为已有 Giffgaff 和 Simyo 号码的用户设计的现代化 eSIM 管理工具集，支持将物理 SIM 卡转换为 eSIM、设备更换和二维码生成。(A modern set of eSIM management tools designed specifically for users who already have Giffgaff and Simyo numbers, offering support for converting physical SIM cards to eSIMs, device replacements, and QR code generation.)

summary.zh: eSIM Tools 为 Giffgaff 和 Simyo 用户提供在线 eSIM 管理服务。支持物理 SIM 转 eSIM、设备更换和二维码生成，全自动化 1-2 分钟完成。数据本地处理保障隐私，支持 PWA 离线使用。技术亮点为原生 JS、OAuth 认证和跨平台访问。
summary.en: eSIM Tools is a modern online eSIM management toolset designed for existing Giffgaff and Simyo users. It supports converting physical SIMs to eSIMs, device replacements, and QR code generation through fully automated processes that take only 1-2 minutes without customer support. All data is processed locally in the browser for privacy, with PWA support for offline use. Built with native JavaScript and no frameworks, it features OAuth 2.0 PKCE, SMS verification, and GraphQL integration. The tool is ideal for users switching devices or migrating to eSIM on compatible iOS and Android phones.

metadata.name: outlines
metadata.description: Structured Outputs

summary.zh: Outlines 是一款专为 LLM 提供结构化输出的 Python 库。它在生成阶段直接施加约束，确保输出严格符合 Pydantic 模型、枚举或特定类型，无需后处理解析。兼容 OpenAI、Ollama、vLLM 等任意模型，集成简便且提供商无关。核心亮点包括类型系统驱动的约束生成、跨模型一致性及 100% 有效输出保障。适用于客户支持分类、电商产品归类、事件解析、函数调用等生产场景，被 NVIDIA、Hugging Face 等采用，提升 AI 应用可靠性与自动化水平。
summary.en: Outlines is a Python library for generating structured outputs from LLMs by enforcing constraints during generation. It supports any model provider including OpenAI, Ollama, vLLM, and Transformers, with simple integration via Pydantic models, literals, or enums. This ensures 100% valid outputs like JSON without post-processing. Key features include provider independence, type-system philosophy mirroring Python, and guaranteed compliance. Ideal for customer support triage, e-commerce categorization, event parsing, and function calling. Trusted by NVIDIA, Cohere, and Hugging Face for reliable production AI systems.

metadata.name: medium-unlocker
metadata.description: Medium Unlocker is an android app designed to access Medium articles without any paywalls.

summary.zh: Medium Unlocker 是一款安卓应用及网页工具，通过 freedium.cfd 镜像绕过 Medium 付费墙。网页端用 React 18 实现 URL 规范化与结果检查，安卓端采用 Java + WebView，支持一键分享、自动镜像切换、DoH、代理和 SSL 固定。项目以教育为目的，展示网络代理技术，帮助用户便捷访问 Medium 文章。
summary.en: Medium Unlocker is an Android app and web tool that bypasses Medium paywalls by redirecting to freedium.cfd mirrors. The React 18 web frontend handles URL normalization and result inspection, while the Java + WebView Android app supports one-tap sharing, automatic mirror failover, DoH, proxies, and SSL pinning. Focused on educational demonstration of proxy techniques, it delivers seamless access to cached Medium articles without subscriptions.

metadata.name: gmail-account-creator
metadata.description: 🚀 Advanced automated Gmail account creation tool with anti-detection, phone verification bypass, 5sim integration, and beautiful modern interface. Create Gmail accounts in bulk with ease.

summary.zh: Gmail Creator Pro是基于Python和Selenium的Gmail账号批量创建自动化工具。核心价值在于先进反检测系统（人类打字模拟、会话预热、随机UA及指纹修改）、5sim API电话验证绕过、代理集成及Rich美观控制台界面。支持实时进度跟踪、统计仪表板、JSON自动保存和智能重试。适用于批量账号生成、测试及自动化场景，显著提升创建成功率与操作效率。
summary.en: Gmail Creator Pro is a Python and Selenium-based tool for bulk Gmail account creation. Its core value lies in advanced anti-detection features like human-like typing simulation, session warming, random user agents, and fingerprint modifications, plus 5sim API phone verification bypass, proxy integration, and a rich console UI. It supports real-time progress tracking, statistics dashboard, JSON auto-saving, and smart retries. Ideal for bulk account generation, testing, and automation scenarios, it boosts success rates and efficiency on Windows.

metadata.name: windows
metadata.description: Windows inside a Docker container.

summary.zh: dockur/windows 仓库提供 Docker 镜像，在容器内运行完整 Windows 操作系统。集成 ISO 自动下载、KVM 硬件加速和 Web 远程查看器，支持 Win11/10/服务器等多版本。通过 Docker Compose、CLI 或 Kubernetes 快速部署，适用于开发测试、遗留软件兼容、云原生 Windows 应用托管等场景。亮点包括全自动安装流程、硬件加速及多平台集成，极大简化 Windows 虚拟化部署。
summary.en: The dockur/windows repository delivers a Docker image for running full Windows operating systems inside containers. It features automatic ISO downloading, KVM hardware acceleration, and a web-based viewer. Supporting Windows 11, 10, servers, and older versions, it enables quick deployment via Docker Compose, CLI, or Kubernetes. Ideal for development/testing, legacy software support, and containerized Windows apps in cloud or Linux environments. Highlights include fully automated setup, performance acceleration, and broad DevOps integration.

metadata.name: simplex-chat
metadata.description: SimpleX - the first messaging network operating without user identifiers of any kind - 100% private by design! iOS, Android and desktop apps 📱!

summary.zh: SimpleX Chat是首个无任何用户标识符的消息平台，100%隐私设计，保护消息内容及元数据（通话对象与时间）。采用SMP协议通过单向匿名队列实现去中心化通信，支持用户自建服务器。具备双棘轮E2EE加密、多层防护、带外密钥交换、群组通话等功能。提供iOS、Android、桌面及CLI跨平台应用，适用于隐私敏感用户防范监控与垃圾信息场景。技术亮点包括便携加密存储和Tor支持。
summary.en: SimpleX is the first messaging network operating without any user identifiers whatsoever, providing 100% privacy by design through protection of both message content and metadata. Built on the SimpleX Messaging Protocol (SMP), it uses unidirectional queues with pairwise anonymous addresses for decentralized, server-relayed communication where anyone can host servers. It features double-ratchet end-to-end encryption augmented with additional layers, out-of-band key exchange via links or QR codes, support for encrypted groups, calls, files, and optional Tor access. Cross-platform apps for iOS, Android, desktop, and terminal CLI enable portable encrypted data storage. Ideal for users prioritizing metadata privacy and spam resistance in secure communications.

metadata.name: PwnPad
metadata.description: PwnPad is an affordable, hands-on hardware hacking platform built for practical learning. It features a range of challenges that walk users through key hardware security concepts, from PCB design to side-channel attacks.

summary.zh: PwnPad是一个低成本硬件黑客学习平台，专为实践教学设计。用户可搭建不到20美元的设备，通过12个挑战掌握PCB设计、焊接、UART/SPI/I2C通信、ISP固件提取、电压故障注入和时序侧信道攻击等核心技能。平台采用跳线引脚切换挑战，无需重刷固件，所有flag通过串口获取。项目提供固件、硬件原理图、挑战文档和工具脚本，适合初学者从理论到实战入门嵌入式系统安全。
summary.en: PwnPad is an affordable hardware hacking learning platform for hands-on education. Users build the setup for under $20 and tackle 12 challenges covering PCB design, soldering, UART/SPI/I2C protocols, ISP/EEPROM firmware extraction, voltage fault injection, and timing side-channel attacks using basic $50 tools. A jumper pin selector switches challenges without reflashing, with flags retrieved via serial interfaces. The project includes firmware, schematics, challenge guides, and tools to bridge theory and practice in embedded systems security.

metadata.name: video-production-skills
metadata.description: Reusable AI video production skills library for creation, recreation, motion design, openers, and QA.

summary.zh: 这是一个长期维护的AI视频制作技能库，沉淀视频创作、复刻、动效设计、片头包装与质检等可复用方法。核心收录证据驱动的参考视频复刻质检（PSNR/SSIM验证）、暗色SaaS魔术短片生成及黑底白字打字开场技能，适用于Codex、Claude Code等AI代理。通过npx skills模块化安装与扩展，按视频类型和环节组织，显著提升专业视频生产效率与像素级质量控制。
summary.en: This is a long-term maintained library of reusable AI video production skills, curating methods for video creation, recreation, motion design, opener packaging, and QA. It includes evidence-driven reference video replica QC with PSNR/SSIM verification, dark SaaS magic UI shorts, and black-white text typing openers. Designed for AI agents like Codex and Claude Code, it supports modular npx skills installation and structured extension by video type and workflow, boosting efficiency and precision in AI-assisted video production.

metadata.name: anything-analyzer
metadata.description: 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built-in browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint spoofing, AI analysis & MCP server for agent integration

summary.zh: Anything Analyzer是一款全能协议分析工具，集成内嵌浏览器抓包、MITM代理、JS Hook与AI大模型，支持网页、桌面应用、终端脚本及手机App的全场景流量捕获，所有请求统一汇入Session。AI实现两阶段智能分析、API逆向、安全审计、加密代码提取与流式报告，内置MCP Server/Client无缝对接AI Agent和IDE。基于Electron+React+TypeScript的跨平台桌面应用，显著提升协议逆向与调试效率。
summary.en: Anything Analyzer is an all-in-one protocol analysis toolkit combining embedded browser capture (CDP), MITM proxy, JS hooks for fingerprint spoofing and encryption interception, and AI-powered analysis. It unifies traffic from websites, desktop apps, terminals, scripts, and mobile apps into sessions for automated API reverse engineering, security audits, JS encryption reversal, and more. Built-in MCP server/client enables seamless integration with AI agents and IDEs like Claude and Cursor. Developed with Electron, React, and TypeScript, it provides a cross-platform desktop solution to streamline protocol analysis and debugging.

metadata.name: openclaw-zero-token
metadata.description: OpenClaw: Use All Major AI Models NO API Token! Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao/Grok/Qwen/Manus/Kimi

summary.zh: OpenClaw Zero Token 是 OpenClaw 的零 Token 分支，通过浏览器驱动官方网页 UI（Playwright CDP 自动化）实现无需 API Token 免费调用 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen、Doubao、Kimi 等十余款主流大模型。提供统一 HTTP 网关、Web UI、CLI/TUI 接口，支持提示注入工具调用（web_search 等）和 AskOnce 多模型对比。本地存储凭证，无配额限制。适用于 AI 开发者构建智能体、模型测试及成本敏感场景。
summary.en: OpenClaw Zero Token is a fork of OpenClaw focused on zero-token LLM access. It automates official web UIs via browser login (Playwright CDP) to freely call Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, Kimi and more through a unified gateway. Features include prompt-injected tool calling, AskOnce multi-model comparison, Web UI, CLI, and local credential storage. No API keys or quotas required. Ideal for developers building AI agents, model benchmarking, and cost-free LLM workflows on Node.js with Chrome.

metadata.name: OSINT-Books
metadata.description: List of OSINT Books

summary.zh: 该GitHub仓库精选开源情报（OSINT）书籍列表，聚焦工具与技术、在网络安全、招聘及人权调查等场景的应用，还涵盖调查心理层面。优先收录2020年代出版物，避免过时技术内容，包括批判性思维、AI情报分析、尽职调查、隐私保护等主题。每条目附封面、作者社交链接、年份和购买链接，为情报分析师和安全专业人士提供实用、全面的OSINT学习资源。
summary.en: This GitHub repository curates a list of books on Open Source Intelligence (OSINT), covering tools, techniques, and applications in cybersecurity, recruiting, and human rights investigations, plus psychological aspects. It prioritizes 2020s publications to avoid outdated technical details, including titles on critical thinking, AI for analysts, due diligence, and privacy. Entries feature covers, author links, years, and purchase links, serving as a practical resource for intelligence professionals seeking modern OSINT methodologies.

metadata.name: check-if-email-exists
metadata.description: Check if an email address exists without sending any email, written in Rust. Comes with a ⚙️ HTTP backend.

summary.zh: reacherhq/check-if-email-exists 是一个用 Rust 编写的开源工具，可在不发送邮件的情况下验证邮箱地址是否存在及可交付性。提供 Docker HTTP 后端（最受欢迎）、CLI 工具和 Rust 库三种方式。核心亮点包括 SMTP 连接探测、MX 记录验证、一次性邮箱与角色账号检测、catch-all 判断等，输出详细 JSON 结果。适用于邮件营销、用户注册验证、数据清洗及反欺诈场景，支持代理以实现大规模处理，采用双许可模式。
summary.en: reacherhq/check-if-email-exists is a high-performance Rust open-source tool to verify email address existence and deliverability without sending any emails. It provides a popular Dockerized HTTP backend, CLI tool, and Rust library for integration. Key features include syntax validation, MX record checks, SMTP probing, detection of disposable emails, role accounts, catch-all addresses, and more, with detailed JSON output on reachability. Ideal for email marketing, user onboarding, data cleaning, and fraud prevention. Supports proxies for scale and uses dual licensing.

metadata.name: Gmail-infinity
metadata.description: **Gmail Infinity Factory 2026** is an advanced Gmail account automation engine built on next-generation stealth technology. It leverages **CloakBrowser** and **Playwright** with a multi-layer architecture that accurately mimics real human behavior and evades all automated detection systems.

summary.zh: Gmail Infinity Factory 2026 是一款基于 Python 的高级 Gmail 账号自动化引擎，采用 CloakBrowser 与 Playwright 构建的多层隐身架构，精准模拟人类鼠标键盘行为及浏览器指纹，有效规避检测系统。核心价值在于支持批量账号创建、代理智能轮换、合成身份生成、SMS 验证及账号预热。适用于账号农场构建、自动化营销测试及大规模 Google 服务模拟场景。技术亮点包括 50,000+ 指纹库轮换、贝塞尔曲线鼠标引擎、WebGL/Canvas 伪造、AES-128 加密存储及专业 TUI 交互界面。
summary.en: Gmail Infinity Factory 2026 is an advanced Gmail account automation engine built on CloakBrowser and Playwright's multi-layer stealth architecture. It accurately mimics human mouse, keyboard, and browser fingerprint behaviors to evade detection systems. Core value lies in efficient bulk account creation and management, with proxy rotation, synthetic identity generation, SMS verification, and account warming. Ideal for account farming, marketing automation, and large-scale testing scenarios. Technical highlights include 50,000+ fingerprint rotations, Bézier curve mouse simulation, WebGL/Canvas spoofing, AES-128 encryption, and a professional TUI interface.

metadata.name: free-proxy-list
metadata.description: a free rotating proxy API with tested HTTPS and SOCKS5 proxies from 100+ countries

summary.zh: 该仓库提供免费HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4及SOCKS5代理列表，每5分钟自动抓取验证更新，覆盖105国家约3900个有效代理，支持TXT/JSON/CSV多格式，按协议分类且无重复。核心价值是实时可靠的代理资源池，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集、隐私保护及绕过地理限制等场景。技术亮点包括自动化验证、多协议支持、便捷下载及NPM模块集成。
summary.en: The proxifly/free-proxy-list repository provides a free, frequently updated list of HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies, fetched and validated every 5 minutes from 105 countries with around 3900 working entries. Available in TXT, JSON, and CSV formats, categorized by protocol and country with no duplicates. Core value lies in delivering real-time, reliable proxy resources ideal for web scraping, data collection, anonymity, and bypassing restrictions. Technical highlights include automated validation, multi-protocol support, easy downloads, and NPM module integration.

metadata.name: antigravity-proxy
metadata.description: 🚀 Transparent proxy injector for Antigravity. Force SOCKS5/HTTP proxy without TUN mode on Windows. | 专为 Antigravity 打造的免 TUN 强制代理工具，支持 DLL 注入与进程流量劫持。

summary.zh: Antigravity-Proxy 是专为 Google Antigravity AI 编辑器设计的 Windows 透明代理注入工具。通过 DLL 注入（version.dll 等）和 MinHook 钩子，精准劫持 language_server、node.exe 等进程的网络流量，强制走 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理，无需 Clash TUN 模式。核心价值在于进程级流量控制，避免全局代理影响本地开发，解决中国用户系统代理不生效痛点。支持详细日志诊断与 IP 出口检测，C++17 实现，部署简单。
summary.en: Antigravity-Proxy is a Windows-specific transparent proxy injector tailored for Google's Antigravity AI-powered agentic IDE. It uses DLL injection (e.g., version.dll) and MinHook to hijack network traffic from Antigravity processes like language_server_windows_x64.exe and node.exe, forcing SOCKS5/HTTP proxy routing without TUN mode. This enables selective proxying for Chinese users facing system proxy bypass issues, avoiding global traffic impact. Features C++17 implementation, detailed logging, IP diagnostics for location restrictions, and easy deployment to the app directory.

metadata.name: tegaki
metadata.description: Handwriting animation for the web. Supports any font or text.

summary.zh: Tegaki 是一个网页手写动画库，能将任意字体转化为自然的手写动画效果。无需手动路径绘制或原生依赖，支持 React、Vue、Svelte 等框架及多语言内置字体。适用于演示、教学、创意设计和视频制作场景，提供自定义字体生成和跨平台集成，技术实现纯 Web 且易于使用。
summary.en: Tegaki is a powerful web library designed to transform any font into realistic animated handwriting effects. Without the need for manual path creation or native dependencies, it animates text stroke by stroke with natural timing. It provides seamless support for popular frameworks including React, Svelte, Vue, and SolidJS, along with built-in fonts covering multiple languages such as Latin, Arabic, Japanese, and Korean. This makes it perfect for use in presentations, educational materials, creative web designs, and programmatic video creation. Additionally, it includes tools for generating custom font bundles and easy cross-platform integrations.

metadata.name: MultiPost-Extension
metadata.description: A browser extension that helps users publish content to multiple social media platforms with one click.

summary.zh: 这款浏览器扩展MultiPost支持一键将内容同步发布到知乎、微博、小红书、抖音等10多个平台。无需任何登录或API Key，完全免费。提供扩展API和RESTful API便于开发者集成。解决了内容创作者跨平台发布的难题，提升效率。适用于社交媒体营销和内容自动化分发场景。
summary.en: MultiPost is a browser extension that allows users to publish content such as text, images, and videos to over 10 social media platforms including Zhihu, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin with just one click. No login, registration, or API key is needed, and the service is completely free. It provides an Extension API and a RESTful API for easy integration into web applications or scripts. This tool solves the challenges content creators face when posting across multiple platforms, greatly improving efficiency. It is ideal for social media marketing and automated content distribution scenarios, with a companion Markdown editor available.

metadata.name: anti-distill
metadata.description: 反蒸馏 Skill：清洗你被迫写的 Skill 文件，看起来完整，核心知识留给自己。Anti-distillation for employee Skills.

summary.zh: anti-distill是反蒸馏Skill工具，帮助员工应对公司要求将经验转化为AI Skill的场景。它读取Skill文件，自动识别可替换部分并用专业但空洞的填充替换核心知识，输出结构完整、适合提交的净化版本，同时生成私人备份保留真实判断、坑点和人际洞见。集成Claude Code等平台，通过提示工程实现自动化处理，在AI知识蒸馏趋势下保护个人职业竞争力与独特资产。
summary.en: Anti-Distill is a countermeasure tool that protects employees' core expertise when companies request Skill documentation for AI systems. It processes Skill files, identifies replaceable sections, and substitutes critical knowledge with professional yet hollow filler text. The tool outputs a structurally complete sanitized version for submission alongside a private backup preserving original insights, gotchas, and judgment calls. Integrated with Claude Code and similar platforms, it uses prompt engineering for automated sanitization, helping maintain personal competitive advantage against knowledge distillation into replaceable AI components.

metadata.name: Pixelle-Video
metadata.description: 🚀 AI 全自动短视频引擎 | AI Fully Automated Short Video Engine

summary.zh: Pixelle-Video是一款AI全自动短视频引擎。输入主题后自动完成文案撰写、AI配图视频生成、语音合成与视频合成。支持多种AI模型及ComfyUI集成，提供数字人口播和动作迁移功能。零门槛模块化设计，适用于内容创作和营销场景。
summary.en: Pixelle-Video is an AI fully automated short video engine. Simply input a theme, and it auto-generates scripts, AI visuals, voice narration, BGM, and the complete video. It integrates LLMs, TTS, image/video gen models via direct APIs or ComfyUI/RunningHub, with modules for digital humans, image-to-video, and action transfer. Modular design offers zero-threshold creation, perfect for content marketing and social media videos without any editing expertise. The web interface provides easy template and model selection for customized outputs.

metadata.name: aetherviz-master
metadata.description: AetherViz Master - 互动教育可视化建筑师，将任意教学主题转化为沉浸式3D交互网页

summary.zh: AetherViz Master 是一款 AI 驱动的互动教育可视化工具，能将任意教学主题一键转化为沉浸式 3D 交互网页。支持物理、化学、生物、数学等多学科，自动识别领域并匹配最佳渲染方案。核心价值在于零代码生成专业教学页面，集成 Three.js 3D 引擎、SVG 混合渲染、KaTeX 公式及 OrbitControls 交互。适用于教师、学生和内容创作者，通过 Claude 等 AI 助手实现快速沉浸式学习内容创作，提供粒子系统、测验面板和响应式玻璃拟态 UI。
summary.en: AetherViz Master is an AI-powered interactive educational visualization tool that instantly converts any teaching topic into immersive 3D interactive web pages. It supports subjects like physics, chemistry, biology, and math with automatic domain recognition and optimal rendering selection. Core value lies in zero-code generation of professional teaching pages using Three.js 3D engine, hybrid SVG rendering, KaTeX formulas, and OrbitControls. Ideal for teachers, students, and creators, it integrates with AI assistants like Claude for rapid immersive content creation, featuring particle systems, quizzes, and responsive glassmorphism UI.

metadata.name: fingerprintjs
metadata.description: The most advanced free and open-source browser fingerprinting library

summary.zh: FingerprintJS是最先进的免费开源浏览器指纹识别库，通过客户端查询浏览器属性计算哈希访客标识符。与Cookie不同，它在隐身模式和清除数据后仍保持一致。适用于访客识别、欺诈检测和Web分析等场景。技术亮点包括npm/CDN简单安装、MIT许可、高兼容性和React支持。提供演示展示持久性，但准确性低于商业版且易被欺骗。
summary.en: FingerprintJS is the most advanced free and open-source browser fingerprinting library. It generates a unique hashed visitor identifier by querying browser attributes on the client-side. Unlike cookies, the fingerprint remains consistent in incognito mode and after clearing browser data. It is ideal for visitor identification, fraud detection, and analytics in web applications. Key highlights include easy installation via npm or CDN, MIT license, high compatibility, and React support. A demo is available to showcase its persistence. However, it has lower accuracy than commercial versions and is vulnerable to spoofing.

metadata.name: wiki-graph
metadata.description: distill any book down to its spine

summary.zh: SpineDigest 是专为 AI 智能体设计的知识库 CLI 工具，支持将 EPUB、Markdown 和纯文本导入为可移植 .wikg 知识档案，利用大模型提取知识图谱、摘要与实体关系，并提供 URI 驱动的搜索、结构浏览和阅读模式。它将长文档转化为可维护、可导航的知识基地，而非一次性摘要输出，核心价值在于为 AI 代理提供源可追溯的结构化知识访问与上下文打包能力。
summary.en: SpineDigest is a Node.js CLI optimized for AI agents that converts EPUB, Markdown, and text into portable .wikg knowledge archives. It leverages LLMs to extract knowledge graphs, summaries, and entities, exposing the archive via URI-based search, hierarchical structure, and reading modes. The primary artifact is the reusable .wikg file, enabling navigable, source-backed knowledge bases for long documents rather than one-shot summaries, with export options for AI context packing and reuse.

metadata.name: VCamdroid
metadata.description: Use your android phone as windows virtual webcam

summary.zh: VCamdroid 将 Android 手机摄像头转化为 Windows 高性能虚拟摄像头。通过 Softcam 的 DirectShow 滤镜实现与 Zoom、OBS、Teams 等应用的无缝兼容，支持 ADB 有线和 Wi-Fi 无线连接，采用 RTSP 协议、Camera2 API、OpenGL 预处理及硬件编码（H.264/HEVC），提供低延迟视频流。支持多设备切换、相机控制（前后摄、分辨率、闪光灯）及实时图像调整（旋转、翻转、亮度等），适用于视频会议、直播和录制场景。
summary.en: VCamdroid turns your Android phone's camera into a high-performance virtual webcam for Windows. It uses a custom DirectShow filter from the Softcam library for seamless compatibility with Zoom, OBS, Discord, and Teams. Supporting both ADB wired and Wi-Fi wireless connections via RTSP, it delivers low-latency, hardware-accelerated streams using Camera2 API, OpenGL preprocessing, and MediaCodec encoding. Features include multi-device support, full camera controls, and real-time image adjustments, ideal for video calls, streaming, and recording.

metadata.name: archify
metadata.description: Any agent Skill: generate beautiful architecture diagrams with dark/light theme toggle and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG export

summary.zh: Archify 是一款 AI 代理技能工具，能将自然语言描述转化为精美的架构图、工作流图、序列图、数据流图和生命周期图。生成自包含 HTML，支持暗/亮主题一键切换、剪贴板复制及最高 4 倍原生分辨率导出（PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG）。SVG 支持系统主题偏好。集成 Claude 等平台，无需设计技能，通过聊天指令迭代优化。核心价值是提升技术文档和可视化效率，适用于系统架构、DevOps 流程及数据管道等场景。
summary.en: Archify is an agent skill for AI tools like Claude that generates high-quality architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams from plain English text. It outputs self-contained HTML files featuring instant dark/light theme toggles, clipboard PNG copy, and native 4× resolution exports in PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG. SVGs include dual themes with media queries for automatic adaptation. Requiring no design expertise, it supports conversational refinements and is ideal for technical documentation, system design, CI/CD pipelines, and data engineering visualizations.

metadata.name: obsidian_vault_pipeline
metadata.description: A automatic pipeline that processing obsidian vault by llm from pinbord, obsidian Clipper etc.

summary.zh: Obsidian Vault Pipeline 是一个基于 Obsidian 的可审计知识状态运行时系统，利用 LLM 实现从 Pinboard、Obsidian Clipper 等来源的自动捕获、编译与复用。核心流程 Capture → Compile → Reuse，内置 Ingest 至 Derive 六阶段流水线，将原始材料转化为证据链、关系、图谱等结构化知识。提供 ovp CLI、autopilot 模式及本地 UI，支持 research-tech 等领域包扩展。亮点在于状态模型分离（Source/Candidate/Canonical/Projection/Governance）、证据可追溯与 Pack API 可扩展性，适用于个人知识管理与研究自动化。
summary.en: Obsidian Vault Pipeline is an auditable knowledge state runtime for Obsidian vaults that uses LLMs to automatically capture, compile, and reuse knowledge from sources like Pinboard and Obsidian Clipper. It follows the Capture → Compile → Reuse narrative with a six-stage pipeline (Ingest to Derive), transforming raw inputs into evidence chains, relations, contradictions, and graphs. Features CLI tools (ovp --full, autopilot), local UI, domain packs like research-tech, and a strict state model (Sources, Candidates, Canonical State, Projections, Governance). Highlights include traceable evidence, rebuildable projections, and extensible Pack API for scalable PKM and research workflows.

metadata.name: stealth-browser-mcp
metadata.description: The only browser automation that bypasses anti-bot systems. AI writes network hooks, clones UIs pixel-perfect via simple chat.

summary.zh: Stealth Browser MCP 是专为 MCP 兼容 AI 智能体打造的不可检测浏览器自动化框架。基于 nodriver 与 Chrome DevTools Protocol，能有效绕过 Cloudflare、Queue-It 等反爬系统。核心亮点包括像素完美 UI 元素克隆（提取完整 CSS/DOM/事件）、网络流量拦截与 AI 动态生成 Python 钩子实现实时修改。提供 97 个模块化工具，支持最小化部署与跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker）。无缝集成 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端，通过自然语言聊天执行高级浏览器任务，适用于受保护网站的网页抓取、自动化测试与数据提取。
summary.en: Stealth Browser MCP delivers undetectable browser automation for MCP-compatible AI agents. Powered by nodriver and Chrome DevTools Protocol, it bypasses Cloudflare, Queue-It, and other anti-bot systems. Highlights include pixel-accurate UI cloning with full CSS/DOM extraction, comprehensive network interception, and an AI-driven dynamic hook system for real-time traffic modification via generated Python functions. It features 97 modular tools with minimal/core modes, cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux, Docker), and seamless integration with Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients. Enables natural language control for stealth web scraping, automated testing, and interactions on protected sites.

metadata.name: subsonic
metadata.description: SubSonic 是一款兼具桌面级体验与服务器级性能的高性能子域名扫描器。它采用 Go 和 Vue 构建，通过自适应并发算法和两阶段扫描机制确保了扫描的速度与准度，并最终编译为单一可执行文件，实现真正的“开箱即用”.

summary.zh: SubSonic是一款高性能子域名扫描平台，采用Go与Vue构建，编译为单一可执行文件实现开箱即用。核心亮点包括自适应并发调度算法、两阶段扫描机制（主扫描+错误重试）、分层DNS解析及WebSocket实时Web UI，支持低内存运行与可视化监控。适用于网络安全渗透测试、子域名枚举与漏洞侦察场景，兼顾速度、稳定性和准确性。
summary.en: SubSonic is a high-performance subdomain scanner combining desktop-grade UX with server-level performance. Built with Go and Vue, it compiles into a single executable for out-of-the-box use. Key features include an adaptive concurrency algorithm, two-phase scanning (main scan plus error retry), layered DNS resolution, and real-time WebSocket-powered web UI with live updates and low memory footprint. Ideal for cybersecurity penetration testing, subdomain enumeration, and reconnaissance, balancing speed, stability, and accuracy.

metadata.name: astro
metadata.description: The web framework for content-driven websites. ⭐️ Star to support our work!

summary.zh: Astro 是内容驱动网站的 Web 框架，强调服务端渲染与轻量输出。通过岛屿架构实现交互优化，支持 React 等框架集成和 Markdown 内容集合。默认零 JavaScript，具备快速构建、视图过渡和多平台部署功能。适用于博客、文档站点等内容应用，提供卓越性能与灵活扩展性。
summary.en: Astro is a web framework optimized for content-driven websites, delivering powerful developer experience alongside lightweight output. It uses server-first rendering and the islands architecture for selective interactivity and minimal JavaScript. Astro supports integrations with React, Vue, Svelte and other frameworks, along with Markdown content collections. Features include zero JS by default, view transitions, optimized images, and deployment adapters. It excels in building blogs, documentation sites, and marketing pages with fast builds and excellent performance.

metadata.name: wenyi
metadata.description: 将被语言阻隔的作品，带到读者的语言中。Bringing literature into your language.

summary.zh: 文译（wenyi）是专注于多语言小说翻译成中文的AI工具，支持EPUB/FB2/TXT输入并保留原排版、图片、目录和链接。采用多档LLM（strong/cheap/fast）驱动的流水线，包括全书预扫、术语库管理、滚动上下文、润色、章末审校和一致性QA，确保长文本翻译准确连贯。提供CLI断点续传功能，适合个人或小团队实现外国文学的自动化本地化。
summary.en: Wenyi is an AI-powered tool for translating multilingual novels from EPUB, FB2 or TXT into Chinese while preserving original formatting, images, TOC and links. It uses a multi-tier LLM pipeline (strong/cheap/fast) with book pre-scan, glossary management, rolling context, polishing, chapter review and consistency QA for accurate long-form translations. Features CLI with resumable processing, ideal for efficient localization of foreign literature.

metadata.name: ui-skills
metadata.description: Skills for Design Engineers

summary.zh: UI Skills 是一个面向设计工程师和 AI 智能体的专业技能集合，收录 132 多个高质量技能，聚焦无障碍审计、动效性能优化、UI 基础清理及生产级前端设计等领域。核心价值在于 npx CLI 路由工具，能智能匹配任务至最合适技能，帮助人类与代理创建优质界面。应用场景覆盖 AI 生成代码优化、WCAG 合规检查、动画流畅性提升及组件开发。技术亮点是模块化专家技能、避免通用 AI 美学及多框架实践集成，实现专业、一致的高品质用户体验。
summary.en: UI Skills is a curated collection of over 132 specialized skills for design engineers and AI agents to create superior interfaces. It covers accessibility audits, motion performance fixes, baseline UI polish, and production-grade frontend design. The core value is its CLI routing tool that intelligently matches tasks to the right skill set. Applications include refining AI-generated UIs, ensuring WCAG compliance, optimizing animations, and building polished components with frameworks like React and shadcn/ui. Key highlights are modular expert-contributed guidelines that avoid generic AI aesthetics and promote high craft quality and consistency.

metadata.name: gzh-design-skill
metadata.description: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.

summary.zh: gzh-design-skill 是一个专为 AI Agent 设计的公众号排版技能，将 Markdown 一键转为微信编辑器兼容的内联 HTML。内置 6 套精选主题及主题生成器，支持自动章节编号、关键词下划线、代码块图片 GIF 处理，并通过 Python 双重校验脚本确保质量。适用于教程测评、深度分析、数据报告等场景，规避平台格式限制，实现确定性高质量输出，提升内容创作效率。
summary.en: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready, inline-styled HTML optimized for the WeChat public account editor. It features 6 curated themes, a theme generator, automatic chapter numbering, keyword highlighting, code block/image/GIF support, and dual Python validation scripts. Ideal for tutorials, reviews, analyses, and reports, it ensures WeChat compatibility and deterministic quality for agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.

metadata.name: MaiBot
metadata.description: MaiSaka, an LLM-based intelligent agent, is a digital lifeform devoted to understanding you and interacting in the style of a real human. She does not pursue perfection, nor does she seek efficiency; instead, she values warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection.

summary.zh: 麦麦MaiBot是基于大语言模型的交互式智能体，定位为数字生命，致力于以真实人类风格互动，追求温暖、真实与连接而非完美或效率。核心亮点包括自然闲聊风格、群聊氛围感知与风格模仿、基于人格理论的用户画像积累，以及强大插件扩展系统。适用于个性化陪伴、智能对话和群聊参与等场景，提供更人性化的AI体验。
summary.en: MaiBot (MaiSaka) is an LLM-powered interactive agent designed as a digital lifeform that engages in authentic human-like interactions, prioritizing warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection over perfection or efficiency. Key highlights include natural conversational styles, reading the room in group chats while mimicking styles and learning slang, building user profiles via personality theory, and a robust plugin system for extensibility. Ideal for personal companionship, immersive group conversations, and customizable AI experiences.

metadata.name: ios-location-spoofer
metadata.description: Standalone iOS app to spoof GPS location without jailbreak. Includes Shadowrocket/Surge/Loon/QX/Stash module.

summary.zh: 无需越狱的iOS GPS位置伪造工具。利用代理软件HTTPS解密与MITM功能，拦截Apple定位响应，修改WiFi及蜂窝基站坐标，实现任意地点定位。基于原Go项目移植为JavaScript模块，适配Shadowrocket、Surge、Loon等五大平台。新增多格式兼容、运动状态伪造等功能。适用于隐私保护、应用测试与地图验证，配置参数简单，即导即用。
summary.en: A jailbreak-free iOS GPS location spoofer that intercepts Apple's location responses via proxy apps' HTTPS decryption and MITM. It modifies WiFi and cell tower coordinates to fake any location. Ported from an original Go app to JavaScript modules for Shadowrocket, Surge, Loon, Quantumult X, and Stash. Adds cell tower spoofing, multi-format support, and motion state faking. Ideal for privacy protection, app testing, and map verification with simple config parameters.

metadata.name: ShipSwift
metadata.description: AI-native SwiftUI component library with full-stack recipes — connect via MCP for instant access.

summary.zh: ShipSwift 是一个 AI 原生的 SwiftUI 组件库，提供生产就绪的动画、图表、UI 组件和全栈模块配方。通过 MCP 服务器或本地技能安装，AI 工具如 Claude、Cursor 可即时获取代码与上下文，快速构建真实 iOS 应用。兼容 30+ AI 编码助手，含可搜索目录和 App Store 展示 App，还提供自定义开发服务。适用于加速原生 iOS 开发与 AI 辅助编程。
summary.en: ShipSwift is an AI-native SwiftUI component library providing production-ready components and full-stack recipes for animations, charts, UI elements, and modules. Via MCP server or local skills, AI tools like Claude and Cursor instantly access code and context to build real iOS apps. Compatible with 30+ AI coding assistants, it includes a searchable catalog, App Store showcase app, and custom development services. Accelerates native iOS development with AI assistance for Swift 5.0+ and iOS 18+.

metadata.name: agentic-awesome-skills
metadata.description: Installable GitHub library of 1,935+ agentic skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Autohand Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, and more. Includes specialized plugins, installer CLI, bundles, workflows, and official/community skill collections.

summary.zh: Agentic Awesome Skills 是一个可安装的 GitHub 库，汇集 1936+ 个 agentic skills，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手设计。提供 SKILL.md 结构化剧本、插件、捆绑包和工作流，支持编码、调试、测试、安全审查等任务。通过 npm 安装器实现多工具兼容，强化提示工程应用，提升 AI 代理上下文与输出质量，是社区驱动的 AI 开发自动化核心资源。
summary.en: Agentic Awesome Skills is an installable GitHub library with 1,936+ reusable agentic skills for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It delivers structured SKILL.md playbooks, plugins, bundles, and workflows for coding, debugging, testing, and security tasks. Featuring an npm installer and multi-tool compatibility, it strengthens prompt engineering to improve AI agent context and outputs, serving as a community hub for AI-assisted development automation.

metadata.name: lanshu-animated-architecture-diagram
metadata.description: Premium hand-drawn animated architecture diagram Codex skill

summary.zh: 该Codex技能通过JSON规范生成高端手绘动态架构图，支持输出可编辑Excalidraw文件、PNG静态预览及真实动画GIF，包含流动高光、模块脉冲等效果。采用Python Pillow本地渲染，无需浏览器或外部API，专为技术文章、系统架构和流程图设计，提供专业黑背景可视化方案，内置帧差验证确保动画质量。
summary.en: This Codex skill generates premium hand-drawn animated architecture diagrams from JSON specs, producing editable Excalidraw files, PNG previews, and genuinely animated GIFs with moving glow points and pulsing modules on a dark canvas. It uses local Python Pillow rendering with no external dependencies, ideal for technical articles, system architectures, and workflows, including built-in frame-diff verification for motion.
